jobs.title: DRAM Firmware Architect
jobs.description:
Position Summary
About Samsung Semiconductor India Research (SSIR)
Samsung Semiconductor India Research; Bangalore (SSIR) is largest overseas research & development centers for Samsung Semiconductor. SSIR is organized into verticals aligned with the business divisions of Samsung Semiconductor, which includes System LSI, Memory.
Memory business is one of the flagship and most profitable businesses within Samsung Semiconductor. Memory business boasts of being the world first in many technology & product areas. The Memory division at SSIR (MST) is a key partner for Samsung Korea R&D and has critical responsibilities for many products being developed within Samsung Memory business.
The MST Software team works on firmware development for Flash based products (Solid State Drives, UFS, eMMC, MicroSD) and Client Software to enable Samsung products in market. In addition, this team is also responsible for research on new storage technologies and bringing new concepts to memory products. Teams in India, Korea and US work together to achieve overall Memory business goals. We explore new technologies in a broad spectrum of areas ranging from emerging Non-Volatile Memory (Storage Class Memories), Low-Latency System designs, Interface protocols and standards, Device Drivers & OS components, Open Ecosystem & Platforms.
Role and Responsibilities
Roles and Responsibilities
We are seeking a highly experienced Firmware Architect to join our dynamic team developing next-generation memory and storage solutions. This role requires an individual with a deep understanding of firmware and embedded software development for ARM-based multi-core and multi-processor memory or storage devices. Knowledge of CXL and DRAM is optional, but PCIe expertise is a significant advantage coupled with strong technical expertise in embedded systems. The Firmware Architect will play a pivotal role in shaping the architectural direction of firmware development, mentoring junior engineers, and fostering a collaborative development environment.
Experience – {8 – 14 } years of experience Firmware Development
Architectural Leadership: Lead the architecture and design of firmware for CXL-based memory devices and ensure alignment with hardware and software requirements.
Firmware Development: Develop and validate high-performance firmware for FPGA/ASIC-based products. Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability of the codebase.
Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor junior engineers, develop subject matter experts within the team, and foster technical excellence.
Documentation & Standards: Create high-quality design documents, adhere to industry standards, and follow robust documentation practices.
Cross-Team Interaction: Collaborate closely with hardware and software teams to align development efforts.
Process Adherence: Champion software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including Agile methodologies, to deliver quality products on time.
Debugging & Optimization: Utilize tools such as JTAG debuggers, logic analyzers, and exercisers to debug and optimize firmware.
Skills Required
Essential:
8 –14 years of firmware development experience for CXL, PCIe, or storage/memory devices.
Proficiency in C and C++ programming.
Hands-on experience with FPGA/ASIC-based products.
Expertise in any Embedded RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
Strong knowledge of Operating system programming concepts.
In-depth understanding of ARM architecture for embedded devices.
Hands on experience in developing secure firmware/bootloaders for ARM or RISC-V based systems.
Proficiency with debugging tools and techniques (e.g., JTAG, logic analyzers).
Ability to comprehend and implement specifications, standards, and datasheets.
Proven track record of architecting firmware with a modular design approach, leveraging abstraction layers to ensure scalability, maintainability, and reusability.
Preferred:
Knowledge of Linux Kernel internals/programming, memory management, NUMA subsystem, device drivers and interaction with ACPI/UEFI tables.
Familiarity with DDR5/4 specifications and memory controllers.
Understanding of PCIe & CXL protocols.

Qualifications

Role and Responsibilities
Design & maintain UVM‑based verification environments for high‑speed serial IP blocks (e.g.,56G/112G/224G Gbps SERDES, PCIe Gen4/5, Ethernet MAC/PHY,) and security IP (AES/SHA engines, ECC, secure‑boot, root‑of‑trust).
Develop comprehensive test plans and coverage models that capture protocol corner cases, timing jitter, eye‑diagram constraints, and security threat scenarios.
Create reusable UVM components (agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and protocol checkers) that can be shared across multiple serial and security projects.
Implement constrained‑random traffic generators with data‑pattern, error‑injection, and latency‑stress capabilities to validate link reliability and security robustness.
Integrate formal verification and assertion‑based checking (SVA) to capture protocol violations, key‑exchange errors, and timing violations early in the flow.
Run and maintain regression suites on industry‑standard simulators (VCS, Xcelium, Questa) and CI pipelines; monitor functional coverage, protocol coverage, and security‑feature coverage.
Collaborate closely with design, architecture, and security teams to refine specifications, resolve bugs, and drive design for testability (DfT) and low‑power considerations.
Mentor junior verification engineers, enforce coding standards, and contribute to the IPD verification methodology library.
Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and compliance verification (e.g., PCI‑SIG, IEEE Ethernet, NIST crypto standards).
Required Skills & Experience
System Verilog & UVM, Formal Verification expertise – 5–6 years of hands‑on verification on complex IP, with strong understanding of class‑based verification, randomization, coverage, and SVA.
High‑speed serial protocol knowledge – Practical experience verifying PCIe, Ethernet SERDES, or similar high‑throughput interfaces.
Security IP verification – Familiarity with cryptographic engines, secure‑boot flows, authentication protocols, side‑channel analysis, and related test strategies.
Simulation & automation tools – Proficient with VCS, Xcelium, or Questa; scripting in Tcl/Python for test bench generation and regression management.
Coverage‑driven verification – Ability to define functional, protocol, and security coverage models and drive them to closure.
Debugging & root‑cause analysis – Strong waveform analysis, assertion debugging, and use of log‑extraction tools to isolate failures.
Version control & CI/CD – Experience with Git and Jenkins/GitLab CI for automated regression runs.
Digital design fundamentals – Understanding of clock‑domain crossing, reset strategies, and low‑power design considerations for high‑speed blocks.
Education – B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
Skills and Qualifications
Experience – 5 to 6 Years of experience
Qualifications

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone for Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, procurement, billing and payroll services, strategic sourcing, and supplier relationship management to Stripe.
What you’ll do
We're looking for a Monetization Operations Analyst to join our growing team. This individual will help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts, workflows and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.
Responsibilities
Be responsible for onboarding sold custom contracts into our billing systems
Ability to understand the legal languages of the contract and comfortable working on it and have strong attention to detail
Build scalable and auditable onboarding processes for new and existing users
Partner with internal systems, deal desk, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineer and account managers to develop and improve the process.

Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to assist with system implementations for billings, collections, and assist with internal and external ad-hoc audit support.
Help scale and optimize our processes by assisting with the execution of key projects and programs.
Gain unique insights into various businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Can quickly learn the Stripe ways of working and make a real impact through process enhancements.
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe
Assist with monthly and quarterly flux analysis of key metrics
Assist with ad hoc projects
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
4-5 years of relevant financial operations/billing experience or 3+ years of customer service experience with a degree in Business Administration, Finance, or relevant field.
Excellent communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal.
Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions

Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case
Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
Demonstrated history of taking on various types of challenging projects and producing results
Solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing best practices
Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive and detail oriented
You will also likely have (not required):
* Knowledge in payments and the fintech industry
The ability to be flexible and comfortable with changing requirements
A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom
A passion for creating new systems and solving problems via infrastructure and automation

Role Summary
The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in cyber threat intelligence tradecraft, threat actor tracking, infrastructure analysis, and intelligence production. They operate with minimal supervision, lead complex intelligence investigations, provide authoritative threat assessments, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams and leadership. Success requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to communicate intelligence effectively across a broad range of stakeholders.
Your Opportunity
NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.
Job Responsibility
Monitor and assess emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, malware campaigns, and vulnerability exploitation trends.
Track threat actors and analyze their capabilities, targeting, infrastructure, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Conduct technical investigations using threat intelligence, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and infrastructure analysis techniques.
Correlate intelligence from multiple sources and assess potential impact to the organization.
Lead indicator of compromise (IOC) collection, enrichment, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
Maintain intelligence records, indicators, and threat artifacts within the organization’s Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP).
Develop and disseminate actionable threat advisories, intelligence reports, and emerging threat notifications.
Support intelligence-sharing efforts with internal stakeholders and trusted external partners.
Produce tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and business audiences.
Deliver intelligence briefings to security teams, leadership, and other stakeholders.
Provide threat-informed recommendations that improve organizational awareness and preparedness.
Serve as a subject matter expert on adversary activity, emerging threats, and cyber risk trends.
Provide intelligence support during cybersecurity investigations and incident response activities.
Perform adversary-focused analysis to support incident scoping, attribution, and impact assessments.
Partner with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, and Risk teams to provide threat context and intelligence insights.
Identify intelligence gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen defensive capabilities.
Job Qualification
Professional Experience
10+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Research, Incident Response, Security Operations, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
Demonstrated experience tracking threat actors, malware campaigns, adversary infrastructure, and emerging cyber threats.
Experience producing tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and executive audiences.
Proven ability to independently conduct investigations, develop actionable intelligence, and brief stakeholders.
Familiarity with nation-state actors, sophisticated cybercriminal groups, and supply chain threats.
Experience in intelligence-driven hunting to identify suspicious network activity and potential risks.
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of threat intelligence tradecraft, intelligence lifecycle methodologies, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies including MITRE ATT&CK, ATT&CK Navigator, Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, STIX/TAXII, Intelligence Lifecycle, and Structured Analytic Techniques.
Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms such as Anomali, ThreatQ, ThreatConnect, OpenCTI, MISP, or similar platforms.
Proficiency with intelligence and OSINT tools such as Maltego, VirusTotal, Shodan, Censys, DomainTools, PassiveTotal, GreyNoise, URLScan, SecurityTrails, or similar investigative platforms.
Knowledge of threat actor clustering methodologies used to track adversary campaigns, intrusion sets, and threat group activity.
Experience conducting infrastructure analysis involving domains, DNS, passive DNS, IP addresses, ASNs, WHOIS records, certificates, hosting providers, and internet-facing assets.
Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, YARA, Sigma, Snort, Suricata, malware analysis concepts, and intelligence automation techniques.
Experience with Python, data mining, Elasticsearch, ELK Stack, Databricks, large-scale data analysis, and threat intelligence correlation workflows.

Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and technical curiosity.
Strong communication and technical writing skills.
Ability to communicate intelligence effectively to technical, business, and leadership stakeholders.
Ability to operate with minimal supervision and lead complex intelligence investigations.

Run deep technical workshops, code labs, architecture reviews, office hours, developer sessions, technical webinars, and executive briefings.

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience and 8+ years of experience in technical Developer Relations, ML engineering, AI platforms, model infrastructure, cloud platforms, solution architecture, or startup technical engagement.

Experience creating workload qualification frameworks, benchmark plans, or technical decision guides that help developers decide when GPU acceleration is the right fit.
Track record as a technical DevRel practitioner, including public talks, workshops, GitHub samples, blogs, tutorials, reference architectures, or developer community programs.
Strong point of view on India's sovereign AI, Indic language AI, and foundation model ecosystem.

6–10 years of experience in application engineering, systems engineering, validation, or technical consulting within Aerospace & Defense or related industries
Strong technical understanding of automated test and validation systems

Experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, MATLAB, or automated test software frameworks

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS & GCP to build at scale.
Job Description
We are seeking a highly specialized Infrastructure Engineer Specialist to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on WAF configuration management and building robust DevSecOps automation frameworks. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments.
Basic Requirements
Key Responsibilities
1. WAF Configuration & Lifecycle Management
Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
Optimization & Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
2. DevSecOps Automation Frameworks
Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.
Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs.
Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments.
Policy as Code (PaC): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production
Required Qualifications
Experience: 10+ years in Infrastructure Engineering or DevSecOps, with a significant track record in high-traffic environments.
Primary Tech Stack: Extensive experience in WAF configuration management (e.g., F5, Signal Sciences, CloudFront WAF) and Nginx/Kubernetes Ingress Controllers.
Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in building DevSecOps automation frameworks. Expert-level skill in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python or Go).
Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy-as-code principles, and cloud-native security orchestration.
Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency in developing custom WAF rules (iRules, ModSecurity).
Experience with GitOps workflows for infrastructure security.
Certifications: Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) or advanced security automation credentials.

Position Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Principal Observability & Event Management Engineer to champion enterprise-wide initiatives that improve monitoring effectiveness, reduce alert noise, and accelerate incident response.
In this dual-impact role, you will act as both a strategic leader and a hands-on technical expert. You will define the enterprise standards for multi-domain monitoring (infrastructure, cloud, application, network, batch, and mainframe) while actively designing and configuring our Event Management platforms—specifically Oracle Unified Assurance (Assure1) and IBM Netcool. The ideal candidate will leverage data insights, machine learning, and automation to transform massive "event storms" into high-fidelity, actionable signals.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Governance
Drive Enterprise Initiatives: Own and lead cross-functional, enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving monitoring effectiveness, optimizing alert quality, and reducing incident volumes.
Define Standards: Establish corporate standards, approaches, and best practices for alert optimization across infrastructure, application, batch, network, and mainframe environments.
Culture & Mentorship: Mentor, guide, and evangelize a strong observability and optimization mindset across engineering and operations teams.
Continuous Improvement: Identify systemic gaps in monitoring design and lead long-term, architectural improvements to eliminate redundant or low-value alerts.
Platform Engineering & Administration
Infrastructure Design: Implement, maintain, and scale Oracle Assure1 / Unified Assurance servers and architectures for high-availability (HA) enterprise environments.
Event Correlation & Enrichment: Develop advanced Object-Server configurations, triggers, and correlation rules to distinguish isolated anomalies from critical root causes.
Multi-Vendor Integration: Integrate multi-vendor telemetry, logs, faults, and data from disparate monitoring domains into a single, unified Event Management UI.
Operations & Backend Support: Manage backend databases (e.g., MySQL, OpenSearch), maintain platform availability, and troubleshoot complex backend issues.
Automation, AIOps & Incident Response
Incident Automation: Write robust automation scripts and workflows to bridge monitoring tools with ITSM platforms (such as ServiceNow) to accelerate incident response times.
AIOps & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, topological discovery, and data-driven approaches to enhance event correlation, suppress noise, and automate self-healing or ticket generation.

Platform Expertise: Hands-on, deep technical experience with Oracle Unified Assurance / Assure1 and/or IBM Netcool suites (OMNIbus, Netcool Impact, ITM).
OS & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Linux Administration (RHEL) and expert-level scripting skills (Python, Bash, Perl, or Shell) for building event parsers and API integrations.

jobs.description:

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Contributing to the development of new product opportunities by assisting with the overall design, layout, and optimization of Memory/Logic/Analog circuits
Parasitic modeling and assisting in design validation, reticle experiments and required tape-out revisions
Leading all aspects of and managing the layout process including floor-planning, placement, and routing
Performing verification processes with modeling and simulation using industry standard simulators
Contributing to cross group communication to work towards standardization and group success
Working with Marketing, Probe, Assembly, Test, Process Integration, and Product Engineering groups to ensure accurate manufacturability of product
Proactively solicit mentorship from Standards, CAD, modeling, and verification groups to improve the design quality
Driving innovation into the future Memory generations within a dynamic work environment
Design Planning & Top-Level Integration
Perform top-level virtual flat placement to explore partitioning options and validate hierarchy quality before commit.
Implement top-level global routing to derive congestion, timing, and pin-feasibility signals that drive planning decisions.
Own partition creation: block shaping, abutment, channel/keep-out definition, and power-domain planning.
Drive pin optimization / pin cutting — pin placement, alignment, and count reduction guided by top-level routing.
Plan and implement repeater / feedthrough insertion: budget top-level nets, place repeaters, and manage crossings across partition boundaries.
Generate block-level constraints (timing budgets, boundary SDC, ILM/ETM models, physical constraints) directly from the design planning tool and hand them off to block owners.
Perform top-level assembly: integrate block-related work (LEF/DEF/GDS/ETM/ILM), close top-level timing, DRC, LVS, and EM/IR, and iterate ECOs to convergence.
Block-Level APR
Implement full APR flow (init → floorplan → place → CTS → route → ECO → sign-off) on digital blocks; own block-level STA sign-off across corners alongside DRC, LVS, EM/IR, and antenna closure.
Set up new project and revision environments — collateral (SDC, netlist, LEF, QTM), stdlib migrations, and constraint authoring.
Debug and correlate synthesis vs. APR vs. STA (PPA regressions, DRV, size_only/don't_touch strategy, scan chain stitching).
Methodology & Automation/AI
Automate flows in Tcl / SKILL / Python; extend internal make-based flow and contribute to shared analysis tooling and dashboards.
Improve the processes efficiency and quality leveraging AI flows
Partner with STA, DFT, CAD, and custom-layout teams; document methodology and provide mentorship to engineers gaining experience.

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. About the Role
UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our UPI team and drive product strategy, user growth, and experience excellence across our UPI-powered flows.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and regulatory nuance. You will own high-impact product surfaces and work closely with engineering, design, data, and business teams to ship products that millions of Indians use daily.

Key Responsibilities
1. Analytics Strategy & Ownership
- Own the end-to-end analytics charter for one or more UPI surfaces — from metric definition to instrumentation to insight generation
- Build and maintain the source-of-truth framework for north-star and guardrail metrics across the UPI funnel (initiation, authentication, success/failure, retention)
- Partner with NPCI-mandated reporting requirements and ensure analytical rigor aligns with regulatory data standards
- Lead a team of analysts, setting priorities, reviewing outputs, and raising the bar on analytical craft

2. Funnel, Growth & Behavioural Insights
- Diagnose friction points across the UPI journey using deep-dive analysis, cohort studies, and funnel decomposition
- Build engagement, frequency, and top-of-wallet models to inform product and growth strategy
- Design analytical frameworks for discovery and nudge effectiveness as new UPI capabilities are adopted
- Partner with design and product research to combine quantitative and qualitative signals into a single narrative

3. Platform Reliability & Scale Analytics
- Define and monitor SLA, success-rate, and latency benchmarks; build alerting and anomaly-detection frameworks tied to these metrics
- Build root-cause analysis playbooks for payment failure spikes and incident-linked drop-offs
- Model traffic and failure patterns ahead of high-volume events (festive seasons, IPL, government disbursements) to support platform readiness

4. Experimentation & Decision Science
- Own the experimentation backbone — design, power, and evaluate A/B tests across the UPI funnel
- Drive a test-and-learn culture: hypothesis → experiment → read-out → scale, with statistically sound methodology
- Build self-serve dashboards and tooling that let product, engineering, and business teams access trusted insights without analyst dependency
- Proactively surface insights that shape upstream roadmap and prioritization decisions

Required Qualifications
- 7–9 years of analytics/data experience, with a mandatory focus on consumer-facing products or fintech; prior experience in payments or UPI strongly preferred
- Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, or equivalent); working knowledge of Python/R for deeper statistical analysis
- Solid grounding in experimentation design — hypothesis framing, sample size/power calculations, and interpreting A/B results correctly
- Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear, decision-ready recommendations
- Experience building and owning dashboards and metrics frameworks at scale, including data quality and governance practices
- Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to present findings crisply to leadership and align cross-functional stakeholders
- Experience managing or mentoring a team of analysts, with a demonstrated ability to review work and raise analytical standards

Good to Have
- Prior experience working in a UPI-regulated environment or with NPCI data/reporting constructs
- Exposure to large-scale transaction data systems and familiarity with data warehousing/pipeline concepts (e.g., working with data engineering teams on instrumentation)Experience with growth, lifecycle, or CRM-driven analytics
- Familiarity with fraud/risk analytics in a payments context

Why Join Us
- Work on one of India's most critical financial infrastructure products — UPI — at massive scale
- Join a high-performance analytics org embedded deeply with product and engineering, with a bias for shipping insights that matter
- Influence decisions that affect hundreds of millions of transactions every day
- Operate in a fast-moving, ownership-driven culture where analytics leads have real authority — and real accountability

Compensation
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants, and unmatched transaction data depth, Paytm is uniquely positioned to define the next chapter of UPI in India — and we want you to help write it.

- Define, own and track business KPIs across Card and PBL, including GMV, transactions, adoption, active users, retention and market share.
- Use  funnel analysis, cohort analysis, merchant segmentation and behavioral insights to identify growth opportunities.
- Design and execute experiments, A/B tests and targeted growth interventions to improve conversion, engagement and retention.

- Establish scalable growth playbooks and lifecycle marketing initiatives across different merchant and customer segments.

At Paytm, you will have the opportunity to build and scale growth initiatives across a large merchant and financial services ecosystem. jobs.description:
About Us
Paytm is India's payment Super App offering consumers and merchants the most comprehensive
payment services. As the pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, today, Paytm stands as
India’s largest payment company by Users, Merchants, Payment Transactions, and Revenue.
Paytm’s mission is to drive financial inclusion in India and bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream
economy through technology-led financial Services. Paytm enables commerce for small merchants and
distributes various financial services offerings to its consumers and merchants in partnership with
financial institutions.

accept payments and Sound-box to reconcile payments via voice alerts. We are also distributing loans to
these partners via our ‘Paytm for Business’ App.

Paytm Intelligence is building next-generation AI platforms across two key areas: AI inference
infrastructure and agentic AI solutions. Our focus is on enabling enterprises to move from AI
experimentation to production-grade deployment with measurable business outcomes.
In the agentic AI space, we are building solutions such as Outreach Manager, CLM agents, and domain-
specific AI agents that automate complex customer journeys across sales, service, and operations. These
systems go beyond traditional chatbots, orchestrating workflows, decisions, and actions across
enterprise systems.

About the Role
We are hiring an AI Agentic Solutions Architect to drive enterprise adoption of AI-powered workflow
automation. This role sits at the intersection of business process transformation, AI systems, and
enterprise sales.
You will work directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, identify automation
opportunities, and design agentic solutions that deliver measurable outcomes such as cost reduction,
conversion uplift, and improved customer experience.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Journey and Workflow Design
 Map end-to-end customer journeys across sales, support, and operations.
 Identify high-impact automation opportunities.
 Design agent-driven workflows across systems and teams.
Solution Architecture
 Design agentic AI systems including orchestration, APIs, and integrations.
 Combine LLMs, rules, and enterprise systems into scalable architectures.
Business Value Articulation
 Translate solutions into measurable outcomes such as cost reduction and conversion uplift.
 Support deal teams with ROI narratives.
POC and Deployment
 Lead proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with clear success metrics.
 Ensure POCs convert to production deployments.
Stakeholder Engagement
 Engage both business and technical stakeholders.
 Effectively handle skepticism stemming from prior enterprise AI failures.
Reusable Playbooks
 Build repeatable solution frameworks across industries.
 Enable sales teams with structured use cases.
Superpowers & Skills That Will Help You Succeed
 5–8 years of experience in AI/ML, SaaS, or workflow automation.
 Proven track record of working successfully with enterprise customers.
 Strong foundational understanding of customer journeys and core business processes.
 Technical familiarity with APIs, system integrations, and complex enterprise software architectures.
 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap and communicate effectively
with both technical engineers and business stakeholders.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)
 Deal Impact: Influence deal progression and maximize win rates.
 POC Conversion: Successfully convert pilots to full production deployments.
 Business Value Articulation: Deliver quantified outcomes, data-backed ROI, and clear business
metrics.
 Workflow Depth: Build strong, highly repeatable use cases across diverse industries.
 Customer Credibility: Establish deep trust and strategic advisory standing with enterprise
stakeholders.
Culture & Compensation

Why Join Us?
We foster a merit-based culture that thrives on self-motivated & driven individuals who are set out
to build a successful career in India’s fastest-growing Fintech Organization. We offer an agile &
democratic setup that gives space to your creativity, provides the opportunity to work at a massive
scale, and encourages diverse perspectives at all times.

Compensation Wealth Creation
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With an enviable 500 million+
registered users, 21 million+ merchants, and unparalleled depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in
a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants—and we are
committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a
part of the story!

jobs.title: Director, Systems Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Oracle is seeking an engineering director to build and lead a new Systems Firmware team in Bengaluru. You will hire the founding engineers, establish the team’s technical direction and culture, and take responsibility for outcomes that directly affect the reliability and serviceability of our server fleet.
The team’s initial mission is to resolve BMC and BIOS firmware issues in production. Working closely with US engineering teams, infrastructure operations, hardware teams, and external partners, you will lead complex investigations, drive lasting fixes, and improve the diagnostics, testing, and release practices that prevent problems from recurring. The team will participate in on-call rotations during India daytime hours, complementing US coverage through coordinated response and clear technical handoffs.
You will start with four senior engineers and provide close technical leadership while building the practices and partnerships needed for the team to succeed. You will set priorities, develop your engineers, and balance immediate fleet needs with longer-term improvements in firmware quality, security, and operational efficiency.
You will also shape the team’s roadmap and future capability. As additional hiring is approved, our intent is to expand its responsibilities into firmware development and delivery for new server and GPU platforms. This includes working with original design manufacturers and joint design manufacturers (ODM/JDMs), particularly Taiwan-based partners, on platform requirements, firmware integration, bring-up, validation, and production readiness.
This role calls for a leader with deep systems firmware expertise, sound operational judgment, and a record of building strong engineering teams. You should be comfortable guiding difficult technical investigations, holding partners accountable for delivery, and translating lessons from production into better engineering decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead the Bangalore Systems Firmware team. Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineers working on BMC firmware and BIOS. Establish clear ownership, coach technical leaders, and create an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Own firmware operational support during India daytime hours. Establish sustainable on-call rotations and effective handoffs with US teams to provide continuity of support for Oracle’s server and GPU fleet.
Lead resolution of complex firmware issues. Guide incident triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions across firmware, hardware, and software boundaries. Prioritize work by customer impact and ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
Turn fleet experience into better products. Partner with engineering, operations, and vendors to address recurring defects, improve diagnostics and recovery, and translate customer and operational needs into firmware enhancements.
Establish engineering and operational standards. Define and evolve runbooks, escalation processes, maintenance procedures, and firmware validation and deployment practices that improve fleet availability, health, security, and reliability.
Drive disciplined execution. Set priorities and manage interdependent initiatives across teams, balancing urgent fleet issues with long-term improvements. Establish measurable outcomes, manage dependencies, and adjust plans as business needs and resources evolve.
Champion firmware quality and security. Partner with security and engineering stakeholders to establish secure development practices, clear acceptance criteria, and appropriate testing and release controls.
Develop strong global partnerships. Align priorities and ownership across US and India engineering teams, fleet operations, hardware engineering, and external partners. Build productive relationships with ODM/JDM vendors, including Taiwan-based partners.
Expand the team’s product development capabilities as it grows. Build the expertise and processes needed to contribute to firmware architecture, platform bring-up, integration, validation, and production readiness for new server and GPU products.
Drive continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging firmware technologies, identify team skill gaps, and invest in automation, knowledge sharing, and engineering practices that improve execution and reduce recurring operational work.
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated success leading systems firmware engineering teams, with experience hiring, coaching, managing performance, and developing senior technical talent.
Deep technical expertise in server firmware, with substantial experience in BMC firmware and/or BIOS/UEFI and the ability to lead engineering decisions across both domains.
Experience supporting production server environments and leading the investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and platform management.
Strong technical judgment, including the ability to guide architecture and design reviews, evaluate competing solutions, and connect immediate corrective actions to long-term reliability improvements.
Experience establishing operational support practices, including on-call rotations, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and coordination across geographically distributed teams.
A record of delivering complex engineering initiatives through clear priorities, resource planning, dependency management, and effective cross-functional execution.
Experience applying secure development practices, firmware validation, release management, and controlled deployment processes.
Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, manage escalations, and align engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building a new engineering team or expanding an existing team from operational support into firmware development and product delivery.
Experience working directly with ODM/JDM partners on server firmware development, platform bring-up, qualification, and production issue resolution; collaboration with Taiwan-based vendors is particularly relevant.
Experience with GPU or accelerated computing platforms and the firmware requirements of large-scale cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with OpenBMC or other BMC firmware stacks, BIOS/UEFI implementations, and server management interfaces and standards such as Redfish and IPMI.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.
As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.
Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.
You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.
As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.
This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.
Key Responsibilities
Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.
Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.
Required qualifications
Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
11 years of software development experience; or
A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.
Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes.
Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support.
Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance.
Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.
Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms.
Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I²C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI.
Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features.
Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation.
Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation.
Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response.
Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
Product development and technical ownership
Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

Title and Summary
AI Principal Architect
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
• Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
• Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
• Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
• Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
• Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
• Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
• Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
• Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
• Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
• Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
• Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.
All About You
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
• Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
• Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
• Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
• Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
• A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
• The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
• Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
• Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
• Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact:
As an IP Logic Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing high-quality intellectual property (IP) for Unified Intel Chassis designs. This position is at the forefront of Intel's innovation, ensuring that our products consistently deliver world-class performance, power efficiency, and reliability. Work closely with architects to define and design complex protocol bridges. Define and implement range-based access control for secured memory and register paths across HBW and LBW. Own privilege qualification and policy propagation across AXI-Lite, APB, IOSF-SB, and HBW request paths. Design and validate parity/ECC generation and checking for request, response, and data channels. Define fault behavior for unauthorized accesses and corrupt transactions, including silent block semantics, RAZWI-style handling, poison propagation, and timeout cleanup. Build or integrate logging, interrupt, and firmware-visible error harvesting flows for local and global RAS handling. Support error injection, diagnostics, and post-silicon debug hooks for both security and reliability validation. Define and implement telemetry capture for fabric load, latency, congestion, error context, and other operational health indicators. Own debug and trace data paths for wrapper-level and fabric-level observability, including data capture, transport, formatting, and handoff to downstream debug infrastructure. Design counters, sticky status, snapshots, and firmware-visible CSRs that make performance and failure analysis practical. Integrate trigger, monitor, and logging hooks needed for bring-up, stress triage, and post-silicon correlation. Work with architecture, validation, firmware, and post-silicon teams to ensure telemetry and debug signals are useful, stable, and diagnosable. Balance observability depth against area, timing, bandwidth, and survivability constraints. Support root-cause analysis of bandwidth loss, latency outliers, protocol stalls, and intermittent field or lab issues using hardware observability features.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop logic designs, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulations required for IP blocks, functional units, and subsystems.
Define architecture and microarchitecture features for the IP block being designed.
Apply strategies, tools, and methods to optimize RTL design for power, performance, area, and timing targets.
Strong knowledge of AXI, AXI-Lite, APB, parity/ECC schemes, and transaction error handling.
Experience with secure MMIO, access-control/firewall logic, or privilege-based filtering.
Experience with RAS concepts such as fault containment, poison, interrupt generation, logging, and recovery-oriented design.
Support SoC customers with seamless integration and verification of IP blocks.
Telemetry and debug are both observability functions rather than primary Datapath functions.
Drive compliance with quality assurance standards to enable smooth IP handoff within the SoC development process.

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
A minimum of 8 years of experience in logic design and RTL development.
Proficiency in hardware description languages such as Verilog, System Verilog.
Strong understanding of digital design principles, including timing analysis, power optimization, and area trade-offs.
Experience with industry-standard EDA tools for design and simulation (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor Graphics).
Knowledge of IP block integration workflows within SoC designs.
Expertise in RAS/debug/security/telemetry.

Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of professional experience encompassing complex IP logic design for high-performance applications.
Demonstrated expertise in architecture and microarchitecture definition.
Familiarity with advanced verification methodologies such as UVM or formal verification techniques.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
A mindset for continuous learning and improvement, with an eagerness to tackle challenging, innovative design projects.

jobs.title: CPU Physical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Performs physical design implementation of CPU designs from RTL to GDS to create a design database that is ready for manufacturing. Conducts all aspects of the CPU physical design flow including synthesis, place and route, clock tree synthesis, floor planning, static timing analysis, power/clock distribution, reliability, and power and noise analysis. Conducts verification and signoff including formal equivalence verification, static timing analysis, reliability verification, static and dynamic power integrity, layout verification, electrical rule checking, and structural design checking. Analyzes results and makes recommendations to improve current and future CPU microarchitectures closely collaborating with logic, circuit, architecture, and design automation teams. Possesses CPUspecific expertise in various aspects of structural and physical design, including physical clock design, timing closure, coverage analysis, multiple power domain analysis, structured placement, routing, synthesis, and DFT. Works intimately with industry EDA vendors to build and enhance tool capabilities to design a highspeed, lowpower synthesizable CPU. Optimizes CPU design to improve product level parameters such as power, frequency, and area. Participates in the development and improvement of physical design methodologies and flow automation.
Qualifications:
As a CPU Physical Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in implementing high-performance, low-power CPU designs from RTL to GDSII. You will focus on detailed processes such as synthesis, placement, routing, timing analysis, and power optimization, enabling designs that meet stringent performance and efficiency targets. Your work will directly influence the success of Intel's next-generation CPUs and their manufacturing readiness, contributing to innovative advancements in computing technology.
You will join a dynamic team dedicated to designing Intel's latest high-performance CPUs using cutting-edge technologies. This group focuses on delivering innovative solutions that propel Intel's leadership in the semiconductor industry. Collaborating across multiple domains, the team drives groundbreaking designs that support Intel's mission of creating world-changing technologies to enrich the lives of every person on Earth.
Key Responsibilities
- Perform physical design implementation from RTL to GDSII, including synthesis, placement, routing, clock tree synthesis, and optimization.
- Conduct static timing analysis, power distribution analysis, and reliability verification to ensure design convergence and high manufacturability.
- Collaborate with logic, circuit, architecture, and automation teams to improve CPU microarchitectures and design methodologies.
- Work closely with industry-leading EDA vendors to enhance tool capabilities for high-speed, low-power CPU development.
- Optimize designs for power, frequency, and area, ensuring product-level parameter excellence.
- Participate in developing and improving physical design methodologies and flow automation for future projects.
Qualifications

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in dynamic environments across geographies.

Intel is looking for an experienced Analog Designer to join the IO Design Team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design and development of advanced analog and mixed-signal circuits that enable high-speed chip-to-chip, package-to-package, and system-level connectivity for Intel's next-generation products.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in transistor-level circuit design, high-speed IO architectures, and silicon debug. This position requires technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership of critical IP blocks from concept through silicon validation.
Key Responsibilities-
• Lead the design, analysis, and optimization of analog and mixed-signal circuits for high-speed IO interfaces.
• Develop and drive architecture and circuit implementation for:
• High-speed TX and RX circuits
• Serializer/Deserializer (SerDes) building blocks
• PLLs, DLLs, CDRs, and clocking circuits
• Equalization and signal conditioning circuits
• Bandgap references, bias generation, and LDOs
• ESD protection and IO pad circuitry
• Perform detailed transistor-level design, simulation, and verification across multiple PVT corners.
• Drive design closure for performance metrics including bandwidth, jitter, noise, power, area, yield, and reliability.
• Collaborate closely with physical design teams on layout reviews and post-lay out optimization.
• Support silicon bring-up, characterization, root-cause analysis, and correlation between simulation and silicon measurements.
• Work with architecture, digital design, signal integrity, package, product engineering, and validation teams to ensure successful product execution.
• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team-wide design methodologies and best practices.
• Drive technical reviews and provide leadership in solving complex design challenges.

• 5 to 9 years of industry experience in analog/mixed-signal IC design.
• Strong expertise in CMOS analog circuit design fundamentals.
• Proven experience designing high-speed analog circuits in advanced technology nodes.
• Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: SerDes architectures, High-speed IO interfaces, PLL/DLL/CDR circuits, TX/RX analog front-end circuits, Clock distribution networks, Reference and bias circuits, LDOs and power management circuits.
• Deep understanding of circuit noise, mismatch, jitter, stability, and reliability considerations.
• Strong experience with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, and industry-standard analog verification flows.

• Technical leadership in analog and mixed-signal design.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional environments.

jobs.title: Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
jobs.description:
Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
Description -
Job Description: Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
Location: Bangalore, India
Level: Intermediate
Function: Training Centre of Excellence (Training COE)
Program: Customer Resolution Training (CRT)
Role Overview
We are seeking a passionate and learner-focused Soft Skills Trainer to support the Customer Resolution Training (CRT) program, with a focus on strengthening customer-facing communication, service excellence, and effective resolution skills among customer support agents.
The ideal candidate will have experience delivering soft skills training in a customer service or contact centre environment and be confident in facilitating interactive learning sessions, conducting role-plays, providing individual coaching, and translating customer experience expectations into observable agent behaviours.
This is a hands-on training role that requires strong facilitation skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to collaborate with Training, Quality, and Operations teams to improve agent confidence, communication effectiveness, and customer resolution outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
1. CRT Soft Skills Training & Facilitation
Deliver structured soft skills training interventions aligned with CRT program objectives and customer experience expectations.
Facilitate interactive sessions on:
Customer-centric communication and active listening.
Empathy, rapport building, and acknowledging customer concerns.
Ownership, accountability, and end-to-end resolution.
Probing, questioning, and identifying customer needs.
Managing difficult conversations, objections, and escalations.
De-escalation techniques and emotional intelligence.
Clear explanations, expectation setting, and professional communication.
Positive language, call control, and effective closing.
Use role-plays, case studies, simulations, group activities, and real-world customer scenarios to reinforce learning.
Adapt facilitation methods to suit different learner profiles, experience levels, and capability gaps.
Reinforce the application of soft skills during customer interactions, rather than focusing solely on theoretical concepts.
2. Agent Coaching & Performance Improvement
Conduct individual and group coaching based on call observations, Quality feedback, assessment results, and identified skill gaps.
Review customer interaction examples to identify behavioural opportunities and recommend targeted interventions.
Provide actionable feedback on communication, empathy, listening, ownership, and resolution behaviours.
Conduct mock calls, practice conversations, and behavioural assessments to evaluate agent readiness.
Track coaching actions and conduct follow-up validations to ensure feedback is translated into improved performance.
Support agents who require additional intervention through structured improvement plans and targeted practice.
3. CRT Program Execution
Support the implementation and ongoing delivery of CRT learning interventions across relevant agent groups.
Partner with the CRT program team to understand learning objectives, customer pain points, performance trends, and priority capability gaps.
Prepare session plans, facilitator guides, participant activities, practice scenarios, and assessment materials.
Maintain training attendance, assessment results, coaching records, and program progress reports.
Ensure consistent delivery of approved content and alignment with CRT standards.
Incorporate feedback and emerging customer interaction trends into future training interventions.
4. Quality & Business Collaboration
Partner with Quality and Operations teams to identify recurring communication and customer experience gaps.
Participate in call calibrations and feedback discussions to understand performance expectations and align coaching approaches.
Analyse available quality insights, customer feedback, repeat contacts, and escalation trends to identify relevant learning needs.
Support pre- and post-training assessments to evaluate skill development and learning transfer.
Recommend targeted refreshers or coaching interventions based on observed performance gaps.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving customer experience and resolution effectiveness.
5. Learning Effectiveness & Reporting
Measure learning effectiveness through assessments, mock-call evaluations, facilitator observations, and post-training feedback.
Maintain accurate records of training delivery, learner progress, and follow-up coaching.
Prepare regular updates on training completion, learner performance, key behavioural gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Share insights and recommendations with the CRT program, Quality, and Operations stakeholders.
Demonstrate the impact of training through observable improvements in agent communication and customer interaction quality.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; relevant training certifications are an advantage.
Typically 3–6 years of experience in soft skills training, customer service training, communication coaching, or learning and development.
Experience in a customer support, BPO, contact centre, or customer experience environment is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to facilitate soft skills sessions and coach customer-facing employees.
Experience with call listening, mock-call assessments, Quality feedback, or behavioural coaching is desirable.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage diverse audiences.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and standard virtual training tools.
Ability to manage multiple training activities, maintain documentation, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Core Competencies
Facilitation excellence: Creates engaging, interactive, learner-centred sessions.
Customer empathy: Demonstrates a strong understanding of customer emotions, expectations, and service recovery.
Coaching effectiveness: Provides specific, constructive, behaviour-based feedback.
Communication: Communicates with clarity, confidence, and professionalism.
Adaptability: Adjusts delivery based on learner needs and performance gaps.
Analytical thinking: Uses call observations and Quality insights to identify capability needs.
Collaboration: Works effectively with Training, Quality, and Operations teams.
Execution discipline: Manages schedules, records, assessments, and follow-up actions consistently.
Success Measures
Training delivery completion and adherence to the CRT learning plan.
Improvement in soft skills assessment and mock-call scores.
Observable improvement in empathy, active listening, probing, ownership, and expectation setting.
Reduction in recurring behavioural gaps identified through call monitoring, where applicable.
Completion and effectiveness of targeted coaching and refresher interventions.
Positive stakeholder feedback and demonstrated application of learning on the job.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a practical, energetic, and learner-focused trainer who can connect with frontline agents, simplify behavioural concepts, and translate them into effective customer conversations.
The right candidate will combine strong facilitation and coaching skills with an understanding of contact centre realities. They should be comfortable working closely with Quality and Operations, using real customer scenarios to address capability gaps, and contributing to measurable improvements in the CRT program.
This is an intermediate-level opportunity for a trainer who is ready to take ownership of soft skills learning delivery and grow their impact through structured coaching, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.
