Description -
Workplace Experience & Real Estate Portfolio Lead
Bengaluru, India
About the Role
India is one of HP Inc.’s strategically important and operationally complex markets. The Principal, CREWS India is the accountable workplace experience and real estate leader for India, shaping environments that enable business performance, strengthen employee engagement, and help teams, peers, and partners thrive across multiple sites.
Based in Bengaluru and reporting to the Director, CREWS — APJ, the Principal, CREWS India will serve as a trusted country leader and partner to India business and site leaders, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Security, EHS, and global CREWS stakeholders. The role requires executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders, lead enterprise-scale change, and translate business, workforce, and employee needs into an integrated India workplace strategy.
This is a strategic leadership and accountability role. The successful candidate will lead through others, influence without authority, and connect workplace decisions to HP’s business priorities. Success will be measured through business continuity, productivity and collaboration, employee experience, cost and capital discipline, risk and compliance, partner performance, and delivery of complex transformation priorities.
Key Responsibilities
Own workplace experience, facilities, and site services across India, creating safe, compliant, reliable environments that enable employees and teams to perform at their best.
Bring a hospitality-led mindset to workplace delivery, creating responsive, thoughtful, high-quality experiences for employees, leaders, visitors, and partners.
Set India’s real estate and workplace strategy, translating business and workforce priorities into portfolio plans, space optimization, investment choices, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with senior business and site leaders to anticipate growth, workforce, cultural, operational, and regulatory needs and convert them into workplace solutions that improve productivity, collaboration, talent experience, and resilience.
Establish strong governance through clear KPIs, SLAs, reporting rhythms, accountability, and recovery plans for service providers and internal delivery teams.
Own India operating and capital budgets, optimize total workplace cost, and build compelling business cases that balance financial return, employee experience, risk, and long-term value.
Provide strategic oversight of construction, fit-out, renovation, consolidation, expansion and facilities related issues
Build, coach, and develop India CREWS team and partner ecosystem, fostering an inclusive, positive environment where people take ownership, collaborate, and thrive.
Represent HP Inc. with landlords, developers, service partners, consultants, and senior governmental or regulatory representatives where required.
Drive EHS, security, procurement, financial, sustainability, and statutory compliance across the India portfolio.
Ensure disciplined follow-through on issues, escalations, and service gaps, with clear ownership, urgency, transparency, and closure.
Foster collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and One HP problem-solving across regional, global, and local teams.
Lead India’s employee transportation program, ensuring compliance, service reliability, and adoption of innovative, industry-standard technologies.
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree required in Business Administration, Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate, Facilities Management, or a related discipline; equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
Graduate degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification preferred.
Typically 12+ years of progressive experience in facilities services, corporate real estate, workplace operations, portfolio management, or related fields.
Experience leading large, complex, multi-site operations in India, preferably within a multinational, technology, engineering, R&D, or shared-services environment.
Demonstrated track record of influencing senior executives, leading enterprise-scale change, and delivering measurable outcomes across workplace experience, cost, risk, and business performance.
Preferred certifications include Certified Facility Manager, PMP, RICS, MCR/CORENET, LEED, GRIHA, or equivalent credentials.
Required Knowledge & Skills
Facilities management, workplace services, preventive maintenance, EHS, sustainability, security coordination, and business continuity.
Construction, fit-out, renovation, HVAC, plumbing, property management, supplier management, and project governance.
Finance, procurement, financial analysis, budget ownership, forecasting, invoicing, and executive reporting.
KPIs, service provider governance, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and recovery planning.
Ability to navigate statutory requirements, government interfaces, landlord/developer relationships, and India market dynamics.
Leadership Competencies
Strategic thinking, results orientation, and the ability to convert ambiguity into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans.
Executive presence and effective communication with senior leaders, employee councils, government representatives, landlords, developers, vendors, and internal teams.
Customer centricity, digital fluency, learning agility, and data-driven decision-making, with the ability to translate business, workforce, and employee needs into strategies that improve productivity, collaboration, engagement, and organizational performance.

Provides guidance on compliance matters and identifies hidden risks or non-conformity issues
Reviews the work of global control owners to identify compliance issues and provides advice, training and assistance with developing remediation plans

jobs.title: Communications & People Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
Communications & People Engagement Lead
Description -
The Communications & People Engagement Lead is a strategic partner responsible for shaping organizational culture, driving employee engagement, strengthening leadership communications, and enabling successful change adoption across the Global Customer Care Centers (CCC) organization.
This role serves as the connective tissue between leadership, employees, and business priorities assuring that communication is not merely informational, but transformational. The individual will design and execute integrated communication, engagement, culture, recognition, and change management strategies that foster connection, transparency, inclusion, and organizational effectiveness across a globally distributed workforce.
The role requires a highly creative, customer-centric, and influential communications professional capable of translating business priorities into meaningful employee experiences that build trust, drive alignment, accelerate adoption of change, and strengthen employee commitment to organizational goals.
Working closely with Customer Care Center leadership, Operations, Quality, Training, HR, Communications, and other business stakeholders, the Communications & People Engagement Lead will help build a connected, resilient, engaged, and future-ready workforce while elevating employee experience across all care center locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Communications
Organizational Communications Strategy
Develop and execute integrated communications strategies aligned to CCC business priorities, transformation initiatives, and organizational objectives.
Serve as the primary communications advisor to CCC leadership, shaping messaging that drives clarity, engagement, and alignment.
Build annual communication roadmaps and engagement calendars supporting strategic priorities.
Ensure consistent, timely, and effective communication across global teams, sites, and functions.
Establish communication standards, governance, and best practices across the organization.
Executive & Leadership Communications
Develop executive-level messaging, presentations, speeches, town halls, leadership updates, and employee communications.
Support leadership engagement sessions, all-employee meetings, fireside chats, podcasts, and interactive forums.
Partner with leaders to strengthen visibility, accessibility, and connection with employees.
Coach leaders on communication effectiveness, storytelling, and employee engagement approaches.
Communication Content Management
Own and manage end-to-end communication channels and content strategies.
Create and distribute:
Newsletters
Leadership updates
Internal campaigns
Employee stories
Organizational announcements
Transformation communications
Recognition communications
Ensuring content reflects organizational values, culture, and customer-focused priorities.
2. Storytelling, Branding & Employee Advocacy
Strategic Storytelling
Develop compelling narratives that connect employees to purpose, customers, business outcomes, and organizational strategy.
Translate complex business concepts into engaging, relatable, and actionable content.
Create storytelling frameworks that highlight innovation, customer impact, quality, transformation, and employee success.
Employee & Customer Impact Stories
Identify and amplify stories showcasing employee contributions, customer outcomes, operational excellence, and business impact.
Partner with leaders and teams to celebrate achievements and successes across geographies.
Build internal advocacy programs that increase employee pride and organizational connection.
Creative Content Development
Lead innovative communication approaches leveraging:
Visual storytelling
Infographics
Video communications
Digital campaigns
Podcasts
Interactive experiences
Executive narratives
Employee spotlights
Social and collaboration platforms
3. Employee Engagement & Culture
Employee Experience Strategy
Design and implement programs that strengthen employee engagement, belonging, motivation, and connection.
Partner with HR and leadership teams to improve employee experience across the employee lifecycle.
Develop initiatives that align employee sentiment with organizational goals and values.
Recognition & Appreciation Programs
Lead enterprise recognition strategies that celebrate performance, innovation, customer obsession, teamwork, and cultural excellence.
Establish scalable global recognition programs and engagement events.
Drive employee appreciation initiatives that reinforce desired organizational behaviors.
Inclusion, Belonging & Community
Champion an inclusive culture where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
Build engagement initiatives that foster collaboration across countries, cultures, functions, and teams.
Partner with employee resource groups and community networks to create meaningful employee experiences.
Employee Listening Programs
Design and manage employee listening strategies including:
Pulse surveys
Focus groups
Listening sessions
Engagement assessments
Sentiment analysis
Translate employee feedback into actionable recommendations.
Ensure leadership accountability through continuous feedback loops and action planning.
4. Change Management & Organizational Adoption
Management of Change (MoC)
Lead communication and engagement workstreams supporting organizational transformation programs.
Develop comprehensive change communication strategies and adoption plans.
Ensure employees understand the rationale, benefits, risks, and impacts of transformation initiatives.
Change Communications
Create and implement communication plans covering:
Business rationale for change
Strategic objectives
Employee impacts
New ways of working
Adoption expectations
Success outcomes
Ongoing progress updates
Change Champion Network
Build and manage global networks of change champions.
Enable champions with training, messaging, communication assets, and engagement tools.
Drive local advocacy and adoption across regions and teams.
Adoption & Readiness Management
Measure awareness, readiness, engagement, and adoption of key initiatives.
Identify resistance points and engagement risks.
Develop mitigation strategies and targeted interventions.
Track organizational readiness and communication effectiveness.
5. Leadership Engagement & Organizational Effectiveness
Leadership Partnership
Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on employee engagement, communications, culture, and change initiatives.
Provide insights and recommendations that improve organizational effectiveness and employee connection.
Employee Engagement Events
Lead planning and execution of:
Global All Employee Meetings
Leadership forums
Town halls
Engagement weeks
Recognition ceremonies
Cultural celebrations
Volunteer and community activities
Learning and development events
Global Collaboration
Foster collaboration across sites, partners, suppliers, and functional organizations.
Encourage sharing of best practices, knowledge, and organizational success stories.
6. Employee Relations & Interpersonal Effectiveness
Employee Advocacy
Champion employee concerns, perspectives, and ideas.
Promote transparent communication and trust across the organization.
Active Listening & Empathy
Create environments where employees feel heard, respected, and supported.
Strengthen leadership understanding of employee needs and experiences.
Conflict Resolution & Engagement Support
Facilitate constructive dialogue and partnership across teams.
Support resolution of communication, engagement, and adoption challenges.
Promote collaboration and positive working relationships.
Success Measures
Performance will be measured through:
Communication Excellence
Employee awareness and understanding of organizational priorities.
Communication reach, engagement, and effectiveness.
Leadership communication satisfaction metrics.
Quality and timeliness of communication delivery.
Employee Engagement
Improvements in engagement and sentiment indicators.
Participation in engagement programs and activities.
Recognition program adoption and impact.
Employee advocacy and connection measures.
Change Adoption
Change readiness and adoption of metrics.
Effectiveness of change communication programs.
Champion network participation and influence.
Achievement of transformation communication objectives.
Culture & Leadership Impact
Improved employee trust and leadership connectivity.
Stronger culture of transparency, inclusion, and recognition.
Increased alignment to organizational vision and goals.
Enhanced employee experience outcomes.
Qualifications & Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Journalism, or related discipline.
Master's degree preferred.
Experience
8–12+ years of experience in Communications, Employee Engagement, Internal Communications, Organizational Development, Change Management, Human Resources, or related fields.
Experience supporting global and matrixed organizations.
Proven track record managing enterprise communication and engagement programs.
Experience supporting organizational transformation and change adoption initiatives.
Critical Skills & Competencies
Professional Skills
Executive and organizational communications
Internal communications strategy
Employee engagement and experience
Change management
Strategic storytelling
Event management
Stakeholder management
Program and project management
Communication analytics and insights
Content creation and digital communications
Leadership Competencies
Influencing without authority
Strategic thinking
Business acumen
Customer obsession
Relationship building
Emotional intelligence
Collaboration and partnership
Creativity and innovation
Resilience and adaptability
Inclusive leadership

The Communications & People Engagement Lead transforms communication into a strategic business capability—connecting people to purpose, enabling organizational change, strengthening culture, elevating employee experience, and building a highly engaged, resilient, customer-obsessed workforce across the Global Customer Care Centers organization.

Description -
The Knowledge Coordinator manages content feedback and documentation requests from intake through closure. This role combines request coordination, stakeholder communication, light content editing, workflow administration, and basic AI-assisted process improvement to help keep knowledge and support content accurate, useful, and current.
Applies intermediate subject-matter knowledge to resolve common business issues of moderate complexity. Works independently within defined practices and procedures, interprets established policies, analyzes information, and recommends appropriate actions. Contributes as an informed team member and may provide limited direction for small projects or workstreams.

Manage knowledge feedback and content requests from intake through validation and closure, resolving straightforward updates or routing work to the appropriate owner.

Perform light editing of knowledge articles, support documentation, metadata, process instructions, templates, and workflow content.

Technical and support documentation

Basic prompt writing and AI-assisted content workflows
Low-complexity automation and process improvement
Quality review, attention to detail, and follow-through

Supports the immediate team and adjacent stakeholders by keeping content requests organized, progressing, and completed to standard.

We are seeking a skilled and experienced DFT Engineer to join our VLSI design team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in Design for Testability (DFT) techniques, including LBIST (Logic Built-In Self-Test), ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation), DFT DRC (Design Rule Checking), MBIST (Memory Built-in Sefl-Test), Boundary Scan, JTAG and Analog/Phy DFT.

Validation of DFT structures/patterns in RTL, Netlist with and without SDF.
Work closely with the verification team to define and implement DFT verification plans.

7-10 years of hands-on experience in DFT methodologies and techniques.
Strong knowledge of LBIST, ATPG, DFT DRC, Scan compression, Low power DFT Techniques, MBIST, Boundary Scan, Analog DFT, JTAG Architecture, DFT STA Constraint development.
Hand-on experience/expertise in Cadence/Siemen’s DFT EDA tools for Scan stitching, DRC, ATPG, Coverage improvement, MBIST, Boundary Scan.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Senior Design Verification Engineer
About the Role
As a Senior Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will lead verification planning and execution for next-generation automotive connectivity SoCs based on E2B technology. Working independently with minimal supervision, you will develop advanced verification environments for complex SoCs incorporating embedded microprocessors, communication subsystems, firmware, security functions, and mixed-signal components.
You will collaborate closely with architecture, digital design, analog design, firmware, functional safety, and validation teams to ensure robust verification coverage and high-quality silicon. You will also contribute to verification methodology improvements, mentor junior engineers, and help resolve complex hardware, firmware, and system-level issues.
This career-level position provides the opportunity to contribute to technologies that enable reliable, high-performance communication within modern vehicles.
Key Responsibilities
Verification Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive verification strategies and test plans for automotive connectivity SoCs and E2B-related functionality.
SoC Verification: Verify complex SoCs containing embedded processors, memories, interconnects, DMA controllers, interrupts, communication interfaces, security features, and mixed-signal subsystems.
UVM Environment Development: Architect, develop, and maintain scalable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, including agents, scoreboards, reference models, sequences, assertions, and functional coverage.
Processor and Firmware Verification: Develop firmware-driven verification scenarios for microprocessor-based SoCs, including processor initialization, interrupts, exceptions, memory accesses, peripheral control, and hardware-software interactions.
C DPI Development: Develop and integrate C/SystemVerilog DPI components, software models, and reference models into simulation environments.
E2B Protocol Verification: Verify E2B protocol functionality, including data transfers, control and configuration mechanisms, timing behavior, error handling, diagnostics, and recovery scenarios.
Coverage and Verification Closure: Define and track functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, test status, and verification metrics through sign-off.
Debug and Issue Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues across RTL, UVM environments, embedded software, C models, and system-level use cases.
Functional Safety Verification: Support verification of safety mechanisms, fault injection campaigns, requirements traceability, and verification activities associated with ISO 26262-compliant automotive products.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with architecture, design, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams on verification planning, issue resolution, and product readiness.
Post-Silicon Support: Contribute to FPGA prototyping, silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and investigation of system or customer issues.
Technical Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior verification engineers and contribute to design and verification reviews.
Methodology and Automation: Improve verification productivity through reusable components, automation, regression infrastructure, and verification best practices.
Must-Have Skills
SystemVerilog and UVM: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and the Universal Verification Methodology, with experience developing reusable verification environments for complex digital designs.
SoC Verification: Strong experience verifying complex SoCs that include embedded microprocessors, memories, buses, peripherals, interrupts, and communication subsystems.
C DPI Development: Hands-on experience developing C/SystemVerilog DPI interfaces and integrating C models or reference models into verification environments.
Verification Planning: Proven ability to convert architecture, design, and product requirements into detailed verification plans, test scenarios, functional coverage, and sign-off criteria.
Coverage-Driven Verification: Strong experience with constrained-random verification, functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification.
Hardware-Software Integration: Experience developing firmware-driven tests and debugging interactions between embedded software and RTL.
Debugging Expertise: Strong analytical and debugging skills across SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, RTL, embedded C code, and system-level environments.
Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Python, TCL, Perl, shell scripting, or similar languages for regression management, result analysis, and workflow automation.
Communication and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across architecture, design, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams.
Technical Leadership: Ability to independently lead verification activities, conduct technical reviews, mentor less-experienced engineers, and influence verification methodology adoption.
Preferred Skills
Experience verifying SoCs incorporating RISC-V processors. Experience with ARM or other embedded processor architectures is also valuable.
Understanding of processor concepts such as privilege modes, exceptions, interrupts, memory protection, caches, debug infrastructure, and firmware boot sequences.
Experience with automotive communication technologies, in-vehicle networking, or E2B technology.
Experience verifying communication protocols, packet-based interfaces, control channels, diagnostics, and error-recovery mechanisms.
Knowledge of automotive functional safety development and ISO 26262 verification practices.
Experience with fault injection, safety-mechanism verification, requirements traceability, and functional safety evidence generation.
Experience with emulation, FPGA prototyping, virtual platforms, or pre-silicon firmware development.
Knowledge of formal verification, clock-domain crossing, reset-domain crossing, low-power verification, or gate-level simulation.
Experience working with analog behavioral models or mixed-signal verification environments.
Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity concepts and secure communication mechanisms.
Experience with continuous integration, regression automation, and verification dashboards.
Preferred Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Master’s degree preferred.
4–8 years of relevant digital or mixed-signal IC verification experience.
Experience verifying processor-based SoCs and delivering designs through verification closure.
Experience with automotive semiconductor products or communication SoCs is preferred.
Why You Will Love Working Here
At Analog Devices, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team developing next-generation automotive connectivity solutions. You will work with experienced architects, designers, firmware developers, functional safety engineers, and validation teams to solve challenging system-level problems and deliver robust semiconductor products.
We offer an environment focused on professional growth, technical innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Your work will contribute to technologies that enable reliable, efficient, and high-performance communication inside the vehicles of the future.

Serve as the primary point of leadership for India‑based category execution supporting APAC capital projects.

Oversee the full RFx lifecycle for complex construction, engineering, cleanroom, and fit‑out packages.
Set negotiation strategy, support contract‑structure development, and ensure commercial alignment across multiple projects and markets.
Ensure commercial rigor on change‑order management, claims mitigation, cost reconciliation, and risk allocation.
Partner with Commercial Managers/GWI to ensure category execution directly supports project schedule, budget, and risk requirements.
3. Supplier Strategy, Governance & Performance Management
Lead supplier capability assessments, long‑term performance tracking, and supplier‑development programs across APAC construction categories.
Provide forward‑looking visibility into resource constraints, market disruptions, contractor risks, and capacity challenges.
Influence supplier segmentation strategy together with GSP Category Leadership.
Establish and maintain structured governance mechanisms for supplier performance, quality, and consistency.

Lead development of high‑fidelity cost models, inflation indexes, market‑trend dashboards, and commercial risk heatmaps.
Provide decision‑grade insights to Singapore Category Leadership, onsite commercial teams, and project executives.
Support regional capital planning with analytical inputs, cost forecasts, and scenario modeling.
Drive data governance discipline to ensure audit‑ready processes, document control, and compliance.
5. Regional Execution Scalability & Cross‑Market Support
Enable rapid scaling of sourcing support across India, Korea, Taiwan, and China during project surges.
Establish standardized processes, templates, playbooks, and commercial governance frameworks for APAC.
Partner closely with onsite focal resources to resolve commercial issues, negotiate escalations, and drive supplier accountability.
Lead continuous‑improvement initiatives to optimize cycle time, sourcing quality, and process maturity.

10–15 years of experience in capital construction procurement, category management, or large‑program commercial operations.

Deep expertise in commercial negotiation, contract terms, risk allocation, claims strategy, and cost governance.
Strong leadership capability — able to build, mentor, and scale high‑performing teams.
Advanced analytical capability: cost modeling, market intelligence, benchmarking, and financial analysis.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
High agility, strong judgment, and ability to operate in fast‑moving and high‑ambiguity project environments.

India is being established as the central execution hub for APAC capital construction sourcing.

A platform for accelerated growth into Regional Category Leader roles.

High‑quality commercial packages delivered on schedule, aligned to project and category strategies.

Define and own the technical architecture for the team’s core systems: the probabilistic identity spine, audience intelligence platform, content-affinity and genre-preference models, and ML-based forecasting.

Flagship ML System Ownership
Architect and lead delivery of the probabilistic identity resolution system — resolving unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence at scale across all Our brands — using entity resolution, embeddings/representation learning, calibration, candidate blocking, and champion/challenger promotion, with a roadmap toward person-level graphs (incl. GNNs) and real-time resolution.

Drive the roadmap for bringing ML personalization signals (genre/content affinity, engagement trends) into batch and, over time, real-time activation paths.

Establish engineering standards for the full ML lifecycle: data contracts → feature engineering → training → evaluation → deployment → monitoring → deprecation.
Champion a lightweight, adoptable, well-documented architecture (Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions CI/CD, MLflow throughout, feature tables, inference/monitoring tables), with leakage prevention, reproducibility, and FinOps controls baked in.

Partner with the Senior ML Engineering Manager on technical roadmap prioritization, headcount planning, and team capability development.
Represent the Hyderabad team in cross-functional technical forums with US-based ML, Data Engineering, Product, and Ad Sales stakeholders.
Produce high-quality technical design documents, architecture reviews, and post-mortems that elevate the team’s engineering culture.

8+ years of industry experience in ML engineering (6+ with a Ph.D.), with demonstrated Staff-level scope and impact.
Mastery of the full ML stack: data engineering, feature engineering, model development, MLOps, and production monitoring.
Deep Databricks expertise: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Feature Store, Asset Bundles, and Genie Space configuration.
Strong AWS proficiency (SageMaker training/pipelines/model registry, S3, Lambda, Glue) and Snowflake expertise (DCR patterns, Snowpark, Cortex, SQL optimization at scale).

Preferred

Deep knowledge of probabilistic identity resolution (entity resolution, graph-based household matching, confidence calibration) and Data Clean Room ML (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms).

Experience with real-time feature serving and low-latency inference, and with mixture-of-experts or graph neural networks.
Published research or conference presentations in relevant ML domains.

The Director, Record to Report Controllership, will provide end-to-end leadership for the Record-to-Report accounting and controllership activities. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will be responsible for leading a large controllership team, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, strong balance sheet governance, effective internal controls, and successful delivery of close, reporting, audit support, and compliance requirements.
This is a critical leadership role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in building, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Director will partner closely with WBD Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial outcomes at scale.
The role requires a strong controllership mindset, deep technical accounting knowledge, proven people leadership, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead transition of accounting work to WBD’s Hyderabad center, drive operational discipline, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability, quality, and compliance.
This role will manage ~ 5 Senior Manager level accounting positions in Hyderabad and will oversee a broader team of ~50 accounting positions, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role without any additional pay. Subject to any applicable laws, the Company reserves the right to change your hours of work where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you
Your Role Accountabilities…
Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership
• Lead and oversee RTR accounting and controllership activities
• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
• Supervise intercompany reconciliations and resolve out-of-balance items with WBD counterparts.
• Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution.
• Review and analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders.
• Review and sign-off monthly and quarterly Balance Sheets, Income Statements, and Cash Flow Statements, including footnotes disclosures and supplemental schedules, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
• Ensure accounting implications of business transactions are assessed timely, including coordination with Technical Accounting teams where required.
• Responsible for system/manual reconciliations between the Business Unit boundary systems and SAP, ensuring data consistency and accuracy
• Continuously identify, design, and implement process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. This includes special projects and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) as needed.
Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness
• Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements.
• Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters.
• Drive discipline around documentation, evidence retention, review controls, issue tracking, and remediation.
• Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution.
Transition and Operating Model Buildout
• Lead the transition, stabilization, and scaling of accounting activities being insourced from other regions into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.
• Establish clear ownership, process documentation, KPIs, service levels, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms.
• Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure business continuity, knowledge transfer, and successful transition outcomes.
• Build sustainable team capacity and capability to support the future-state controllership operating model.
Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership
• Act as the key connection point between the Hyderabad Accounting COE and Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, GBS, and other business stakeholders.
• Develop strong relationships with global and regional finance leaders and provide responsive, practical, and technically sound accounting support.
• Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution
• Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision-making.
• Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups.
Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems
• Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
• Support system implementations, ERP-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
• Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership, technology, GBS, and transformation teams.
People Leadership and Talent Development
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Senior Managers and accounting professionals.
• Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
• Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
• Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution.
• Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
Qualifications & Experience…
Required
● Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualifications.
● At least 18 years of progressive accounting, controllership, and financial reporting with at least 8 years of supervisory role.
● Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls.
• Deep understanding of US GAAP, IFRS, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting.
● Proven experience leading large accounting teams, including leaders/managers.
● Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization.
● Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders.
● Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure.
● Strong analytical, problem-solving, present solution, and decision-making skills.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency
● High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
● Able to work effectively across various time zones.
Desired
• Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution, or related industries.
• Experience with remote transition.
• Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms.
• Experience leading finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.
• MBA or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business preferred.
Leadership Attributes
• Strong controllership leader with sound judgment and high integrity.
• Comfortable building structure in a changing environment.
• Able to balance technical accounting depth with practical business partnership.
• A leader who can build capability, coach teams, and create accountability.
• A transformation-minded leader who can simplify, standardize, and scale processes.
• Confident working with senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
• Proactive in identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving closure.

Strong hands-on experience working across FreeWheel Ad Server, FreeWheel Marketplace, SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, and other programmatic platforms.

Hyderabad / Chennai
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
As a Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments.
The Opportunity
Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence.
Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock.
Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies.
Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims
External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view
Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support.
Who You Are
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience: 5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred.
Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement): You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each:
Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics
EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources
Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so
Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data
Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs
Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting
Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group)
Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data
Therapeutic Area Exposure: Demonstrated exposure to either of Oncology (solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways), Ophthalmology (Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or CVRM (cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights
Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Are you the kind of product leader who gets energy from turning a great product into a growth engine?
If you've built product-led experiences that actually moved the needle on revenue and retention and you want to do it at scale, in a role that sits at the heart of company strategy, this is your opportunity.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who will architect the experiences that bring customers in, help them succeed, and grow with us, making our product the primary driver of how we acquire and retain customers.
This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week.
About the team
You'll join a forward-thinking, collaborative product organisation focused on delivering exceptional experiences for Customer and Employee Service teams. You'll be part of a small but high-impact group of PMs in Pune, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success across locations.
The opportunity
Our ambition is bold: build the most powerful self-serve growth experience in our category. That means turning our product into the primary driver of new and expansion revenue, designing experiences that make it effortless for customers to discover, adopt, and expand and connecting product signals with sales and customer success to maximise retention.
As the PM driving this, you'll set the vision, lead execution, and shape how we use AI to move faster and smarter.
What you'll do
Own the growth roadmap: Define the product strategy for your area, tying every initiative to clear revenue and retention targets with measurable hypotheses and expected outcomes.
Deliver a best-in-class self-serve experience: Design and optimise the full customer journey: sign-up, onboarding, activation, upsell, and expansion. Build in-product experiences that drive real conversion and growth.
Build the PM community in Pune: Establish shared standards for research, experimentation, and storytelling that raise the bar for the whole team.
Use AI responsibly: Identify and deliver high-value use cases for AI across onboarding, workflows, and recommendations.
What you bring
8+ years in B2B SaaS product management, with proven success driving growth motions that directly impacted revenue and retention.
Strong experience with workflow, customer service, or employee experience products (e.g. support, ticketing, CRM, or similar).
A track record of defining and tracking metrics across the full funnel from sign-up through to expansion and churn, and running A/B experiments.
Experience influencing beyond your immediate team, partnering effectively with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering across time zones.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex ideas into clear narratives for executives and cross-functional partners.
A clear point of view on responsible, value-driven AI usage.
Why this role matters
This isn't a supporting role, it's a core lever for how we acquire, grow, and retain customers in the next phase of our journey. If you want to build an industry-defining growth experience and shape how growth is built into the product experience in customer and employee service, this is for you.

jobs.description:
Job Description
What we are looking for:
Our Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) is looking for an experienced Staff Data Platform Engineer to join our growing Platform engineering team. You’ll work in a collaborative Agile environment, driving innovations in data infrastructure that not only powers advanced analytics but also lays the foundation for AI and machine learning integration across Zendesk’s data platform.
About the team:
We are a newly formed Data Platform Team here in Pune dedicated to developing and maintaining Zendesk’s data platform that powers next‑generation reporting and analytics across the product portfolio. As a Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will work on designing and developing advanced data infrastructure that power the Zendesk Data Platform.
Data is at the heart of Zendesk’s business—this is a high-impact, high-ownership role with broad technical and organizational influence.
What you get to do every single day
Lead architecture and roadmap
Define and evolve the end-to-end data platform architecture across ingestion, transformation, storage and governance.
Establish standardized data contracts, schemas, documentation, and tooling that improve consistency and reduce time-to-data for analytics and product teams.
Lead build-vs-buy evaluations and pilot new technologies to improve reliability, speed, or cost.
Deliver platform capabilities at scale
Design and deliver secure, and highly-available data services and pipelines handling large-scale, mission-critical workloads.
Own, operate, and scale our core orchestration platform (Astronomer / Apache Airflow), optimizing performance, deployment workflows, and infrastructure costs
Raise the engineering bar
Define standards for data modeling, testing (unit/integration/contract), CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and code quality; champion reproducibility and reliability.
Conduct deep root cause analyses; drive systemic fixes that improve resilience and developer experience.
What you bring to the role
Basic qualifications
10+ years of total software/data engineering background, with 3+ years dedicated to Platform Engineering or Data Infrastructure.
3+ years leading complex, cross-team architecture and infrastructure initiatives at a Staff level.
Hands-on technical expertise designing, provisioning, and managing cloud environments on any of the public clouds like AWS, GCP, Azure (We primarily use AWS)
Experience with infrastructure automation tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, etc. (we primarily use Terraform)
Proven track record designing and automating robust CI/CD pipelines using tools like, Github Actions , Jenkins. (We primarily use Github actions)
Intermediate level experience with at least one of the programming languages: Python, Go, Java, Scala. (we primarily use Python)
Working knowledge of Docker.
Intermediate level experience with SQL
Experience implementing monitoring and observability frameworks (preferably for data pipelines)
A demonstrated willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal - you’ll be collaborating closely with people in multiple time zones.
Ability to work independently and in a team, with a proactive approach to improving developer experience and engineering processes.

3+ years of experience building & maintaining scalable data infrastructure with strong focus on automation and reliability
Interest / Experience in building developer-facing automation agents, internal CLI tools, or platform productivity integrations.
Experience ‘managing’ ETL orchestration platforms such as Airflow, Dagster, etc. (we primarily use Airflow)
Familiarity with dbt (Data build tool), used for building data pipelines
Familiarity with Data Governance and security compliance best practices

Infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Terraform)
CICD (Github Actions)
Data Pipeline and Orchestration (Snowflake, dbt, Astronomer Managed Airflow)

Job Description
Zendesk is a global leader in AI-first customer service and employee service software, renowned for its powerful yet customer-friendly solutions. At Zendesk, we believe in building better customer relationships through our suite of products that are smart, flexible, and reliable.
We have a rare opportunity for a seasoned product manager to drive the evolution of our product experiences at Zendesk. This PM will define, execute, and iterate on building AI-augmented products that empower our billions of end-users, millions of agents, and thousands of admins to be able to give and receive world class service on Zendesk.

You will be responsible for working with our 130k+ customers to understand the bottlenecks and pain points they (and their customers) run into when it comes to providing customer service, and designing/launching scalable solutions to empower them. Role Overview
As a Technical Account Manager at Zendesk, you'll become an extension of our largest customers' teams, bridging technical expertise with business acumen. You'll guide clients in maximizing value from Zendesk solutions by understanding their business strategy, consulting on implementation methodologies, and creating technical solutions to business problems. Rather than performing implementations yourself, you'll partner with clients and internal teams to navigate configurations, integrations, and overall architecture to drive innovation and transformation in customer experience.

Strategic vision to identify opportunities clients haven't recognized

jobs.description:
Job Description
Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience
Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
Core Daily Activities
Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.
Key Responsibilities:
Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.
Preferred Qualifications:
Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description
About Us:
Zendesk is a leader in customer experience solutions, dedicated to delivering innovative technology and exceptional service. Our Contact Center Center of Excellence (CoE) focuses on optimizing customer support platforms, including Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS-based solutions, to enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency.
Position Overview
We are seeking a seasoned Contact Center Partner Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX Suites—preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS—with a strong focus on partner onboarding, technical enablement, and co-selling support. This role will lead partner technical enablement efforts, ensuring partners are fully equipped and supported to resell and implement Zendesk Contact Center solutions effectively. The ideal candidate will provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and hands-on expertise to drive partner success and seamless integration of contact center solutions.
Core Daily Activities
Partner Onboarding and Enablement: Drive the technical onboarding process for partners, ensuring they acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully implement and resell Zendesk Contact Center solutions.
Co-Sell Technical Support: Collaborate closely with partners during co-sell engagements, providing expert technical guidance and solving complex implementation challenges.
Architect and Optimize Contact Center Solutions: Design scalable and efficient architectures leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk to support partner deployments.
Lead Technical Strategy and Partner Roadmap: Define technical enablement strategies aligned with partner needs and evolving business goals.
Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Coach partners, internal teams, and presales specialists on best practices in solution design and deployment.
Drive Innovation and Emerging Technology Adoption: Stay updated on AI, ML, and automation trends in contact centers to continuously improve partner technical capabilities.
Support Pre-Sales and Post-Sales Activities with Partners: Support technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, PoCs, and ongoing partner support.
Develop Enablement Materials: Create technical documentation, playbooks, and training content tailored for partner consumption.
Key Responsibilities
Partner Success Focus: Own the technical onboarding and enablement process for partners, reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time to market.
Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the architectural vision for partner-facing contact center solutions within the CoE framework.
Technical Oversight: Support and guide partners and internal teams to adhere to architectural best practices, security standards, and delivery excellence.
Collaboration: Work with partner sales leads, sales, and engineering teams to align on technical requirements, scope, and co-sell strategies.
Innovation Advocacy: Promote adoption of the latest contact center technologies and best practices with partners.
Governance and Compliance: Ensure partner solutions meet compliance, security, and governance requirements.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
Experience: Minimum of 10 years in solution architecture, with at least 5 years focused on contact center technologies including Amazon Connect and Zendesk, with partner-facing or customer enablement experience preferred.
Technical Expertise: Proficient designing solutions using Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS services (Lambda, Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). Experience with Python and/or NodeJS is a plus.
Enablement Skills: Demonstrated ability to deliver technical training and enablement to partners or customers.
Leadership: Experience leading technical engagements involving multiple stakeholders including partners, internal teams, and vendors.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to translate complex technical information for diverse audiences.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to devise creative technical solutions in partner-centric contexts.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Lead
Location: Pune, India
Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk.
About Zendesk
At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy.
The Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Observability & Monitoring Lead with 6+ years of industry experience to spearhead our SRE and observability strategy. You will be responsible for maturing our monitoring ecosystem, driving operational excellence, and reducing system downtime through proactive detection and incident management. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, ensuring that observability data directly translates into improved reliability, SLA compliance, and reduced MTTR.You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes.
What You’ll Do
Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation).
Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection.
Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations.
Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto-
Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics
Incident Reduction: Develop and execute strategies to systematically reduce the volume of high-priority incidents through trend analysis and proactive stability improvements.
Incident Automation: Lead the engineering of automated response workflows and self-healing capabilities to minimize manual intervention and accelerate resolution times.
Strategy & Architecture: Design and coordinate with engineering teams for comprehensive observability strategies, including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems.
Tooling Enhancements : End-to-end management of observability stacks (Data Dog) and its integration with ITSM tools (Ticketing Tools) and applications. Seek assistance from product and engineering team for any tool enhancement use cases to build a robust observability platform integrated with the ticketing tools.
Application Onboarding: Responsible and accountable for onboarding relevant observability and monitoring necessities for new applications which are onboarded and handed over to operations.
Incident & SLA Management: Oversee the operational lifecycle of monitoring tickets and Lead the monthly analysis and reporting of performance metrics (Eg - Mean time to detect, Mean time to restore,Mean time to Respond/Accept, First touch resolution) and ensure SLA compliance .
Continual Service Improvement: Liaise with technical and level 2 teams to improve and mature the current monitoring state of applications in scope.
Process Automation: Drive the automation of incident reporting, alert correlation rules, and "alert fatigue" reduction. Transform raw telemetry data into actionable executive insights.
SRE Leadership: Responsible for managing the L1 SRE Engineers who will be handling the automated monitoring incidents in day to day operations.
Governance & Leadership: Manage governance calls, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews, and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with domain team leads to define SLOs/SLIs, align on capacity planning, and ensure documentation (Runbooks/HLD/LLD) is maintained to "single point of failure" (SPOF) standards.
What You Bring
Experience: 6+ years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications.
Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools.
Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets.
Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python.
Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS
ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews.
Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives.
Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages.
Nice to Have
Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance.
Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems.
Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog).
Working Model
Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows.
Part of an on-call rotation with follow-the-sun support.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Devops engineer with 5+ years of technical expertise to join our team within the CIO RUN function. In this role, you will bridge engineering, operations, and business systems—driving system stability, proactive detection, and rapid incident mitigation while leading administration, enhancement, and process optimization across our Salesforce and Quote to Cash (Q2C) platform ecosystems.
You will be responsible for hands-on configuration of observability platforms, triaging system alerts and user reports, managing incident response workflows, enforcing end-to-end ITIL lifecycles (Incident, Problem, and Change Management), and configuring Salesforce applications (custom objects, validation rules, flows, profiles/permissions, and Q2C workflows) to support evolving administrative and business requirements.
Primary Platforms: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Core Sales and Salesforce CPQ / Q2C. Zuora Billing knowledge is a plus. Over time, you may also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications in the Salesforce value stream.
Key Responsibilities
Partner and collaborate with end users to understand administrative needs, resolve issues and meet business requirements.
Handle both end user tickets and monitoring tickets from ITIL perspective with end to end ownership maintaining required response and resolution SLA targets.
Liaise with the problem manager to identify repeated incidents and engage with level 2 or domain teams for permanent fixes.
Able to manage high impact major incidents P1/P2 and able to perform initial level troubleshooting and triaging.
Develop and mentor others around application customization via custom objects, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, etc
Implement, own and optimize internal processes to improve efficiency.
Document procedures, policies, and systems in Runbooks, SOPs and KEDBs/KB Articles.
Manage and own system administration and help streamline business functionality including: profiles/permissions, role hierarchy, security models, application customization, reports and dashboards, etc
In future , also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications relating to Salesforce value streams.

User & Access Administration: Manage end-to-end user administration, including logins, MFA troubleshooting, password resets, license assignments, profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing settings across Core Sales and Salesforce environments.
Visibility & UI Administration: Administer and adjust field-level security, custom fields, page layouts, record types, list views, report access, and button/tab visibility to support smooth end-user workflows.
Light Data & Config Operations: Execute routine data fixes, picklist updates, public group management, delegated approver setups, and light operational configuration updates.
Triage & Routing: Actively monitor and triage the ITCRM support queue and incoming requests, accurately categorizing issues, resolving L1/L2 admin queries, and routing non-admin requests (such as CPQ incidents or complex integrations) to appropriate domain teams.

ITIL 4 Foundation certification or specialized certifications in Incident/Problem Management.
Prior experience in service-based or consulting environments with broad, multi-client operational exposure.
Background in a global technology company supporting enterprise-grade, business-critical SaaS systems and distributed topologies.
