jobs.description:
Job Description:
Are you looking for an exciting new chance to build on your experience working on business-led change initiatives? Arm is changing the future of computing across multiple sectors from mobile clients and automotive through to Hyperscalers and embedded devices. And we're doing this together with our broad ecosystem of partners and for the benefit of everyone!
You will be part of Arm’s Enterprise IT Business Applications Architecture practice and work across the portfolio of projects to provide architectural guidance and solutions to business challenges that are aligned to strategy and EIT roadmaps. You will also be responsible for technical leadership and direction to development and delivery teams, ensuring delivery of your designs is adequately stewarded and also collaborating across teams to find opportunities for new technologies.
Responsibilities:
Interpret Business Needs
Collaborate with senior leaders to identify future technology innovations and evolutions that have potential to address business ambitions
Develop solutions designs (HLD) and roadmaps aligned to the Domain target
Maintain mapping between Capabilities, Applications and Data
Assess and Apply Technology
Be creative in the use of existing technologies
Work with members of the technical communities to develop and establish reference patterns for Platforms and Solutions
Look ahead for opportunities with new technologies and applications
Technical leadership
Supports change initiatives and technical communities, guiding and helping teams and partners to align with the overall enterprise architecture
Ownership of solution pattern and approach, responsible for sign-off on High-Level designs and ensuring alignment to target and roadmaps
Ensure quality of Architecture design artefacts and present at governance forums
Practice Development
Develop and evolve Architecture principles, governance, materials and ways of working
Guide and mentor teams on architecture principles, governance, and standard practices
Drive innovation by researching and evaluating emerging technologies that align with business needs
Required Skills and Experience:
At least 8 years of experience in a Solution Architect role.
Strong experience with Salesforce, SAP, and integration platforms (e.g., Mulesoft, event-driven architectures, MS Power Platform, Automation Anywhere).
Good knowledge of LoB applications (e.g., ServiceNow, HCM, CMS, CLM) in commercial and operational domains.
Expertise in cloud services (multi-provider, AI, cloud-native development).
Experience with DevSecOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.
Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term needs and define multiple solution options.
Familiarity with Business Analysis, Programme Management, and application development methodologies.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies
Demonstrable experience in project governance, leadership, and architecture team development.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:
Formal qualifications in development languages or application platforms
Experience of the semi-conductor industry or other Engineering based organisations!
In Return:
This is a new team, and there is plenty of opportunity to shape its future, and your own growth and progression.
Our 10x Mindset
At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset
Use of AI in Your Application
At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.
Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations
At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.
Hybrid Working
Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.
Equal Opportunities
Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Senior Test & Evaluation Engineer
jobs.description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Develop and execute comprehensive test plans in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external customers
Define and assess with product engineering details of required prototype
Evaluate and propose most suitable prototype manufacturing process
Design, develop, operate & maintain complex test equipment and automated data acquisition systems, using programming applications such as LabVIEW, FlexLogger, DIAdem, and DeltaV.
Build and integrate custom test systems using National Instruments (NI) hardware and electromechanical components
Analyze experimental results and prepare clear, data-driven engineering reports including conclusions and recommendations
Create, document, and implement engineering best practices
Interpret industry standards that pertain to HPBV testing and coordinate testing associated with certification.
Provide technical input and direction to the design and evaluation of new product concepts, including conceptualization, design review, and testing of complex products.
Lead future development of lab space specific to Isolation Valve testing.
Drive efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory
Mentor and support other engineers while promoting best practices and continuous learning
Work effectively in a global and local team with the ability to work independently in local test facility to drive projects forward.
Leverage expertise in valve test methods and lead continuous improvement and implementation of test technologies across the global labs
Perform additional duties or special projects as assigned by the Engineering Manager
Who You Are:
You take on new opportunities and challenging assignments with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. You apply knowledge of business and engineering drivers to advance work and achieve meaningful results. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives while fostering an inclusive and respectful environment. You consistently deliver on commitments by holding yourself accountable for quality, safety, and performance outcomes.
For This Role, You Will Need:
Proven competency and experience with data acquisition systems and instrumentation of mechanical systems
Strong analytical, problem solving, critical thinking and decision-making skills
Demonstrated commitment to safety and risk management in planning process
Ability to apply fundamental knowledge of mathematics and physical sciences to real-world applications supporting the development of products, test equipment, test procedures, and measurement techniques.
Background in machine design, material selection and manufacturing methods
Working experience in CAD software, such as Inventor, AutoCAD, Solidwork.
Experience with pressure retaining materials, material coatings, and wear mechanisms
Background in machine design, material selection and manufacturing methods
Hands on experience with design/certification standards like EN 12516, ASME standards, API 609, AWWA, ISO15848, API 607, TSx, SIL etc.
New product designs, development, hands on experience with design verification tools such as 6σ, GD&T, DFMEA, QFD, DFM/A and engineering calculations
Strong communication skills
Must be well organized, detail oriented and capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously
Willingness to work outside traditional work hours to interact with supporting locations globally
Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
Minimum Educational Requirements:
Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering discipline
English fluent – verbal and writing, any additional language is a plus
Minimum Work Experience Required:
Min. of 8 years related experience with min. of 5 years in the area of industrial valves
Experience in matrix organization with skip level reporting
Experience working with remote/global teams
Our Culture & Commitment to You:
At Emerson, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and stronger business outcomes. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute.
We invest in professional growth, encourage continuous learning, and provide opportunities to work on meaningful engineering challenges that impact global industries. Our collaborative culture promotes knowledge sharing, innovation, accountability, and a commitment to safety and operational excellence.
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals across the world, contribute to cutting-edge product development, and help shape the future of valve testing and evaluation technologies.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer Electrical Design
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Position Overview
The Electrical Design Engineer will be responsible for designing, reviewing, and optimizing electrical power systems supporting a semiconductor fabrication (FAB) environment. This includes high-reliability power distribution, substations, cleanroom infrastructure, critical equipment supply, power redundancy systems, control systems, grounding systems, lightning protection, and integration with facility monitoring systems. The role requires prior experience in Power distribution design, semiconductor or similar industry, industrial manufacturing, mission-critical infrastructure, etc. Must be AI-Proficient.
⸻
Key Responsibilities
• Develop & review electrical design packages including single line diagrams (SLD), load list, Sizing calculations, system studies, electrical design layouts, conceptual and detailed engineering packages.
• Design, review & size of GIS, UPS systems, MV/LV Switchgears, Power & Distribution transformers, generators, VFDs, PDBs, harmonic filters, SCADA, PMS, grounding system, cabling schedules, and emergency power circuits.
• Prepare and review technical documentation including control philosophies, schematics, wiring diagrams, and layout drawings.
• Collaborate with multi-disciplinary engineering teams including Engineering Consultants, Global Engineering Team, GC & Sub-vendors.
• Support development and design of power distribution for critical FAB tools.
• Coordinate electrical requirements with OEM tool vendors and ensure compatibility with facility services.
• Manage power requirement forecasting aligned with ramp-up and expansion strategies.
• Knowledge of HV/MV distribution (220KV/66KV/33KV/6.6KV), GIS/AIS substations, switchgears, protection relays, transformers, RMUs.
• Perform & review Power system Study, earthing system design, relay coordination, protection philosophy, and arc flash assessments.
• Support specification & TDS preparation, procurement, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and energization of major equipment.
• Ensure designs comply with local & international standards including IS, IEC, IEEE, NFPA-70/NEC, SEMI S2/S22, ISO and similar.
• Conduct technical evaluations, risk assessment, design reviews, and support HAZOP/DRB processes.
• Maintain accurate as-built drawings, approval documentation, and engineering logs.
• Support budgeting, BOQ preparation, estimation, procurement, and schedule tracking.
• Provide technical support during construction, installation, commissioning, and qualification
Provide technical oversight during construction, resolving electrical issues, and ensuring adherence to design specifications.
Supervise contractors, vendors, and third-party consultants for successful project execution.
Required Technical Skills
• Proficiency in HV/MV/LV power system engineering
• Knowledge of semiconductor facility tool power requirements
• Experience with substations, UPS, generators, and power distribution systems
• Understanding of power quality, harmonics, and grounding strategies
• Familiarity with BMS/SCADA/FMCS integration.
• Must have AI Proficiency in using Generative AI models such as Co-Pilot, Chat GPT, Claude or other LLMs.
Software Expertise
• AutoCAD / AutoCAD Electrical
• Revit / BIM (Preferred)
• ETAP / SKM Power Tools (Preferred)
Soft Skills & Competencies
• Strong cross-functional communication and vendor management skills
• Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capabilities
• Ability to work under pressure in high-reliability and fast-paced project environments
• Strong documentation and technical reporting skills
About Micron Technology, Inc.
We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Summary
The Construction Quality Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the overall Quality Management System (QMS) for large-scale construction projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, engineering standards, statutory regulations, client requirements, and international quality practices. The role oversees quality assurance and quality control activities across all phases of construction including civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), process utilities, cleanroom systems, and high-tech industrial facility installations. The position plays a critical role in ensuring defect-free execution, minimizing rework, maintaining construction excellence, and achieving project delivery targets with the highest quality standards.
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Develop, implement, and maintain project-wide Construction Quality Management Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), quality procedures, and inspection protocols.
Lead all QA/QC activities for civil, structural steel, architectural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, piping, HVAC, cleanroom, and utility systems construction works.
Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, standards, client requirements, and statutory regulations.
Establish and monitor quality assurance systems for contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers across the project lifecycle.
Conduct quality audits, surveillance inspections, site walkthroughs, and compliance reviews to identify gaps and enforce corrective actions.
Review and approve Method Statements, Material Submittals, Inspection Requests, Test Reports, Welding Procedures, and quality documentation.

Sustainability shall be conversion with the sustainability and green building requirement.

Lead quality meetings with clients, consultants, EPC contractors, and stakeholders to review project quality performance and risk mitigation actions.
Ensure proper maintenance of quality records, inspection reports, turnover dossiers, as-built documentation, and handover packages.
Support commissioning and startup teams by ensuring all systems are installed and tested in accordance with approved quality standards.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance construction quality, reduce defects, improve productivity, and optimize project delivery efficiency.
Mentor QA/QC engineers, inspectors, and site quality personnel while fostering a strong culture of quality excellence across the organization.
Education & Qualifications Required
Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or related engineering discipline.

Certifications such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), PMP, CSWIP, AWS-CWI, NACE, or equivalent certifications are preferred.
Strong knowledge of construction quality standards, semiconductor/high-tech industrial facility requirements, cleanroom construction practices, and EPC project execution methodologies.
Proficiency in QA/QC documentation systems, inspection methodologies, material quality standards, and testing procedures.
Strong understanding of international codes and standards including ASTM, ASME, ANSI, SEMI, NFPA, ACI, IPC, AWS, and IEC.
Experience with digital quality management systems, construction management software, BIM coordination platforms, and project reporting tools.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multi-disciplinary construction teams in fast-paced and technically demanding environments.
Experience Required
12–15+ years of experience in construction quality management for large industrial, semiconductor, data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, or high-tech infrastructure projects.
Minimum 5+ years in a leadership role managing QA/QC teams on mega construction projects.
Experience in semiconductor fabs, cleanroom facilities, advanced manufacturing plants, or mission-critical infrastructure projects is highly preferred.
Proven experience handling EPC contractors, international consultants, commissioning teams, and large-scale project stakeholders

Construction Quality Management Systems (QMS)
QA/QC Procedures & Inspection Management
Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & CAPA
Welding Inspection & NDT Coordination
Cleanroom & Semiconductor Facility Standards
Material Testing & Compliance Verification
Construction Codes & International Standards
Contractor Quality Performance Management
Audit & Compliance Management
Risk Assessment & Quality Improvement Programs
Project Documentation & Turnover Management
Leveraged AI-enabled and Generative AI solutions to streamline construction interface management, accelerate issue resolution, improve coordination across multidisciplinary teams, and enhance project execution visibility

Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Engineer/Sr Engineer – (GQ FECTQA MOI)
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from artificial intelligence to advanced memory technologies possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. Because doing so fuels the next generation of semiconductor technology.
Job Description
As a Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Remote Operation Control (GQ FECTQA ROC) Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will be part of a global organization responsible for centralized quality operations supporting Micron wafer fabrication sites across Asia and the United States. You will play a critical role in safeguarding product quality through automated quality screening, lot disposition, statistical risk assessment, and operational excellence initiatives.
In this role, you will leverage advanced statistical analysis, semiconductor process knowledge, automation, and data-driven decision-making to identify quality and reliability risks, recommend appropriate product dispositions, and drive network-wide quality improvements. You will collaborate closely with Site QA, Product Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Global Quality teams to ensure consistent execution of quality control strategies and defect containment actions across the Micron network.
You Will:
Design and Develop Quality Screening and Disposition Systems
Develop quality screening strategies, business rules, and disposition plans for deployment in Micron's centralized quality systems.
Configure and maintain automated lot hold, disposition, and containment workflows.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to establish risk-based quality control methodologies.
Support implementation and validation of quality system enhancements and screening improvements.
Ensure robust controls and interlocks are implemented to minimize quality escapes and operational risks.
Execute Wafer Lot Disposition and Quality Risk Assessment
Evaluate wafer lots impacted by planned or unplanned manufacturing deviations.
Assess quality and reliability risks using electrical test data, physical characterization results, process history, and statistical analysis.
Interpret outlier signals, defect signatures, and excursion indicators to determine appropriate disposition actions.
Support disposition activities related to Fab Conversions, Quality Deviations, Special Work Requests, and Manufacturing Excursions.
Document disposition decisions and provide technical justification to stakeholders.
Perform Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Monitoring
Analyze large manufacturing datasets to identify abnormal signatures, trends, and potential quality risks.
Develop statistical models and methodologies for outlier detection, screening optimization, and excursion monitoring.
Perform distribution analysis, SPC review, baseline trending, and risk assessment activities.
Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Drive data-based continuous improvement opportunities across Micron's manufacturing network.
Drive Automation and Digital Transformation Initiatives
Support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives for quality monitoring and disposition automation.
Reduce manual intervention by implementing fail-safe controls, automated workflows, and decision-support systems.
Partner with software development teams to define requirements and deploy scalable automation solutions.
Continuously identify opportunities to enhance system capability and throughput.
Collaborate Across Global Quality Organizations
Partner with Site QA teams to ensure consistent quality execution across all manufacturing locations.
Participate in global alignment teams focused on quality standards, operational excellence, and best practice sharing.
Support root cause investigations and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) development.
Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and business impacts to diverse stakeholders.
Contribute to the development and publication of global quality metrics and performance indicators.
Support Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
Identify process gaps and propose innovative solutions to improve quality operations.
Lead or participate in cross-functional projects focused on productivity, quality, and automation.
Develop and maintain operational procedures, business process documentation, and training materials.
Support audits, compliance reviews, and quality system assessments.
Drive standardization and scalability of centralized quality operations.
Education
Required: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Material Science, Statistics or related technical discipline.
Preferred: Master's Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related field.
Required Qualifications
3–5 years of experience in Semiconductor manufacturing, product engineering, quality, reliability, test engineering, or related industry experience.
Strong understanding of statistical methodologies, including:
Statistical Process Control (SPC)
Outlier Detection
Distribution Analysis
Trend Analysis
Data Visualization
Risk Assessment Methodologies
Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes, wafer fabrication, probe testing, and parametric testing methodologies.
Understanding of quality systems, risk management, and defect containment processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex manufacturing datasets.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.
Self-motivated with strong ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in quality engineering, reliability engineering, or semiconductor product disposition.
Knowledge of memory products, including DRAM, NAND, HBM, or emerging memory technologies.
Familiarity with machine learning, predictive analytics, or AI-based manufacturing applications.
Experience developing dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Spotfire, or similar platforms.
Exposure to enterprise automation, workflow systems, and digital transformation projects.
Knowledge of quality methodologies such as FMEA, CAPA, 8D, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing.
Experience supporting global operational teams across multiple manufacturing sites.

jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Senior Engineering Manager- TDP Insights and Data Resiliency
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. You will work closely with engineering teams in India and Australia and coordinate strategy, priorities, and execution with leadership in the United States.
Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.
TDP Insights provides the intelligence layer for the Trusted Data Platform. It helps teams understand where data lives, how it moves, what it costs, how reliably it operates, and how customers use TDP services. By transforming high-volume platform telemetry into actionable insights, it supports better decisions about reliability, capacity, cost, compliance, recovery readiness, and developer experience.
Atlassian Data Resiliency (ADR) strengthens end-to-end recovery across TDP. It provides common backup and restore capabilities, recovery assurance, RPO and RTO evidence, validation, restore exercises, and consistent resiliency standards across TDP data platforms.
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP Insights and ADR engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, storage and streaming teams, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to improve how Atlassian understands, protects, and recovers its data.
Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, delivering trusted platform insights and recovery capabilities, and translating complex customer, reliability, and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.
Team and organizational leadership
Lead, coach, and develop engineers and senior technical leaders, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to senior engineers and emerging leaders.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.
Build an effective distributed-team operating model across India and Australia, with clear alignment and communication with leadership in the United States.
Strategy and execution
Define and execute the TDP Insights and ADR strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, platform, and recovery requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP Insights, ADR, TDP data platforms, and partner teams.
Deliver actionable insights into platform health, customer adoption, cost, data movement, compliance, and recovery readiness.
Improve recovery confidence through common capabilities, clear standards, validation, and repeatable restore exercises.
Reliability and customer trust
Own the operational health of TDP Insights and ADR capabilities, including availability, data quality, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Establish trustworthy measures for backup coverage, restore validation, RPO and RTO performance, and recovery readiness.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure that TDP Insights and ADR support enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, disaster recovery, regulated environments, and multi-cloud operation.
Maintain clear visibility into customer and recovery commitments and intervene when delivery, reliability, or data-integrity risks threaten those outcomes.
Technical and platform leadership
Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the evolution of large-scale telemetry, analytics, backup, restore, and recovery capabilities across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, data locality, security, compliance, data quality, migration safety, operability, and reversibility.
Establish technical and operational standards for data collection, processing, analytics, recovery validation, and integration with TDP data platforms.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, cloud portability, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with storage, streaming, control-plane, infrastructure, and customer teams.
Cross-functional leadership and economics
Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, FinOps, and customer-facing teams.
Coordinate effectively across engineering teams in India and Australia and leadership stakeholders in the United States.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP Insights and ADR in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, architecture discussions, and portfolio planning.
Use platform telemetry and operational evidence to inform investment, reliability, capacity, and customer-adoption decisions.
Own the cost posture of the team’s capabilities, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.
Minimum qualifications:
Significant engineering leadership experience.
Demonstrated success building or operating a business-critical distributed system, data platform, analytics platform, storage service, resiliency platform, or comparable infrastructure product.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, organizational design, hiring, and succession planning.
Experience converting ambiguous strategies and customer requirements into clear roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, security, and operational risk.
Experience operating large-scale production systems with clear service-level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and sustainable operational practices.
Experience delivering enterprise capabilities such as data residency, encryption, compliance, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, or tenant isolation.
Proven ability to lead incident response and convert operational learning into lasting improvements.
Strong cross-functional influence and experience resolving dependencies between organizations with different priorities.
Experience leading teams and programs across multiple geographies and time zones.
Sound judgment when balancing reliability, strategic alignment, delivery speed, cost, and technical sustainability.
Clear communication skills appropriate for engineers, executives, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders.
Experience with high-scale telemetry and analytics systems, streaming and data-processing technologies such as Kafka or Flink, analytical query platforms, distributed storage, backup and restore systems, multi-cloud infrastructure, or internal developer platforms is beneficial but not required.
Benefits & Perks
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Full-Stack AI Engineer / Data Scientist with a deep sense of ownership. Rather than being a narrowly specialized Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or MLOps Engineer, you will combine these skill sets. You will build agentic generative AI systems and classical ML systems end-to-end, taking accountability from concept and exploratory data analysis all the way to production releases and monitoring.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role involves working deeply with multimodal foundation models, advanced agentic workflows (including Agent-to-Agent/A2A communication), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, other emerging AI technologies, and MLOps subsystems. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) alongside vector, graph, and traditional databases to develop scalable and robust AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Agentic & GenAI Application Development:
Design and build advanced AI agentic systems, state machines, search-based conversational systems that solve complex business problems.
Develop workflows leveraging Large Foundational Multimodal Models to process and reason across text, audio, and video modalities.
Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients to standardize context exchange between agents, data sources, and external tools.
Collaborate with AI Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers to integrate AI capabilities into scalable, fair, and ethical end-user applications focusing on relevance and real-time performance.
Full-Stack Engineering & Agentic SDLC:
Leverage AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles, maintaining high productivity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks.
Take end-to-end accountability for features: write high-quality, production-ready Python (and occasionally TypeScript) code with comprehensive testing and documentation.
Manage the DevOps/MLOps lifecycle: containerize applications using Docker, configure CI/CD pipelines, and architect high-throughput, reliable cloud-native solutions on AWS/multicloud.
Data Science, EDA & Strategy:
Perform thorough Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand dataset characteristics, uncover patterns, detect biases, and identify data quality issues.
Use statistical and visualization techniques to inform feature engineering, model selection, and optimization of foundation model-based applications.
Design robust data pipelines to curate, preprocess, and structure diverse datasets that maximize LLM effectiveness and reduce bias.
Algorithm Development & Optimization:
Design, customize, optimize, and fine-tune LLM-based and traditional AI algorithms for specific use cases (e.g., text generation, summarization, AI agents, sequence modeling).
Lead advanced prompt engineering strategies, utilizing zero-shot, few-shot and other paradigms to optimize model outputs without extensive fine-tuning.
Implement pre-generative AI models (e.g., classification, clustering, regression) when they provide a more efficient, interpretable, or cost-efficient solution compared to LLMs.
Optimize model inference speed, reduce latency (cold start reduction, caching strategies), and manage resource usage across cloud architectures.
Evaluation, Observability & Continuous Improvement:
Conduct rigorous experimentation (A/B testing) and implement automatic metric pipelines (e.g. BLEU/ROUGE, RAG retrieval accuracy, human rating frameworks, etc.) to evaluate generative and multimodal systems.
Implement real-time algorithms monitoring and observability practices, ensuring visibility into pipelines behavior, drift detection, and anomaly identification using telemetry tools.
Translate complex technical results into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, driving data-driven decision-making.
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
7+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and Data Science, with exposure to generative AI, agents and classical ML.
3+ years of hands-on experience with generative large language models and agents.
Proven experience managing the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle and deploying models at scale.
Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.
Skills:
Must-have:
Expert Python: Advanced production-grade proficiency in Python.
Cloud Platforms: Practical experience designing cloud solutions on AWS (familiarity with multicloud is a plus), utilizing GenAI-specific services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
AI/GenAI Frameworks: Deep expertise with LangChain, LangGraph or similar LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic system design, and state machine logic.
Building production-level AI systems including RAGs, Vector DBs, MCP, end-users, integrations, etc., but also observability, DevOps, durable and available system designs.
Software Engineering Best Practices: Expertise in API design, CI/CD, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and rigorous automated testing.
aSDLC expertise: Proven experience in leveraging agents for SDLC (software development lifecycle).
Databases: Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, and data lakes.
Data Skills: Strong background in statistics, data manipulation, synthetic data generation, and feature engineering.
Should-have:
Could-have:
Familiarity with TypeScript is considered an advantage - to have a common language with the full-stack Software Engineers.
Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical skills to tackle complex engineering and statistical challenges.
Ownership & Leadership: Deep sense of accountability, eager to define architectural patterns, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.
Consulting: Abilities to work closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to consult on the technological approaches to their business problems.
Ethics: Strong understanding of biases, fairness, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI deployment.

Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., Ph.D., or equivalent in Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Be deeply passionate about AI, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in foundational models, agentic approaches, and classical ML.

Be a great communicator, able to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.

Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):
Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization.
Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks.
Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals.

Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs.
Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration.
Develop specifications for dynamic Generative UI components and RAG pipeline context mappings.
Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:
Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications.
Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps.
Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows.
GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):
Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11.
Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports.
Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states.
AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:
Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied.
Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases.
Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:
Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards.
Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections.
Audit Readiness & Operational Support:
Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices.
Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions.
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes.
5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors.
3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies.
Hands-on AI/LLM Project Experience: Experience working directly on Generative AI or machine learning projects, supporting data preparation, prompt development, or AI application testing.
Proven track record of delivering computerized system validation or software assurance under industry-standard quality guidelines and electronic records regulations.
Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional, globally distributed engineering squads (including developers, architects, QA, and validation teams).
Agentic Workflow / aSDLC Experience: Proven experience leveraging AI productivity tools and writing/coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot) daily to accelerate elicitation, business process mapping, and requirements generation within an agentic software development lifecycle.
Skills
Must-have:
Advanced Requirements Lifecycle Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in elicitation, specification, modeling, verification, and traceability.
LLM Prompt Engineering & AI Prototyping: Proficient in designing, evaluating, and refining prompts for large language models. Ability to construct robust system prompts and templates that control model outputs and behavior.
Technical & Data Literacy (Analysis & Logical Assessment): Advanced ability to analyze complex data structures, logically assess AI model outputs, and trace data lineage. Strong technical aptitude to interpret technical specifications and evaluate system behaviors, with a focus on data-driven decision-making rather than hands-on coding or scripting.
Regulatory & Quality Expertise: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of industry-standard regulatory and quality protocols, software validation and quality assurance standards, and global guidelines for electronic records and digital signatures.
Process Modeling & Visualization: Advanced skills in process mapping, business workflow design, and data flow diagramming using tools like Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN engines.
Business Case & Financial Analysis: Experience conducting financial analyses, cost-benefit modeling, and calculating the total cost of ownership for enterprise platforms.
Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Outstanding active listening, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build consensus across conflicting viewpoints, push back on unrealistic business requests, and translate between "business speak" and "tech speak."
Should-have
Agile Product Ownership Capability: Strong product thinking and backlog management capabilities using JIRA and Confluence. Ability to confidently step in as a Proxy PO when necessary to define MVPs, prioritize backlogs, and drive sprint goals.
AI/ML and Agentic Architecture Familiarity: Broad understanding of LLM architectures, RAG/GraphRAG concepts, multi-agent frameworks, and vector/graph databases to effectively analyze requirements for advanced AI projects.
IT Service Management (ITSM): Solid understanding of ITIL-based change management, incident management, and CMDB architectures.
Testing and QA Partnership: Experience partnering with QA to review test plans, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and verify test coverage using Requirements Traceability Matrices.
Agentic SDLC: Strong drive to apply agentic Software Development Lifecycle practices and tools.
Could-have:
Professional Certifications: International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) credentials such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or CCBA; Project Management Institute (PMI-PBA) or Scrum Alliance (CSPO/PO) certifications.
Multicloud Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud service models (AWS/Azure) and cloud-native application deployments.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Dissect complex, ambiguous, and abstract business challenges into manageable, structured, and verifiable functional requirements.
Ownership & Decisiveness: High-ownership mindset with the confidence to make tough priority decisions, remove development roadblocks, and step in to lead product direction as a Proxy PO when necessary.
Consulting & Trust: Ability to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders, QA leads, and engineering teams, translating seamlessly between clinical business speak and technical developer speak.
Ethics & Empathy: Deep commitment to patient safety, product quality, data security, and ethical AI deployment, backed by a strong user-centric design approach.

Have a strong understanding of both AI applications and traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies.
Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with emerging digital trends, software architectures, prompt engineering, and validation practices.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a proven ability to thrive in a high-velocity, fluid, and multidisciplinary agile environment where roles are fluid.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
External Job Ad Text
Job description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems.
As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user.
Job Responsibilities
Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy.
Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends.
Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices.
Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases.
Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring.
Qualifications
Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies.
Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents.
Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases).
Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements.
Education / Experience
Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications.
Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery.
Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams.
Skills
Must-have:
Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces.
End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines.
Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle.
Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy.
Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics.
Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments.
Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement.
Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications.
Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems.
Should-have:
Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services.
Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub).
Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications.
Could-have:
Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries.
Additional Qualifications
Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+.
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Shift: CET time zone

Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.
The Opportunity
Engagement Delivery
In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology.
Your work will include but will not be limited to:
understanding the business goal(s) and value of the project and striving to deliver the defined benefits to the organization
leading or being part of global project teams ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and resource assignment to the project plan deliverables
ensuring that the critical success factors of reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time to value are managed throughout the entire lifecycle of the projects
effectively managing stakeholders through the establishment of key relationships and developing an understanding of their organizations
generating, maintaining and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan, project risk and issue log and ensuring the project status is timely and transparent
preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the project methodology and good project management practice
tracking project financials and seek governance approval when needed
applying organizational change management practices as needed and ensuring effective project communication
contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate
Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by:
Continuously improving the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics
Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team
Actively managing your project management upskilling
Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues
Who you are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:
Appropriate university degree and 5+ years of project management related work experience
Strong knowledge in project management fundamentals (waterfall, SCRUM and others) and related tools
Experience in leading global/complex projects, organizing and optimizing resources and establishing clear priorities
Ability to motivate and lead a project team or team members if required
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated proficiency in influencing, negotiating, and effective global collaboration.
Ability to effectively communicate across various levels of a complex, matrix organization. Ideally exposure to an additional field related to project management, such as project change management, business consulting, methodology coaching.
Experience in project management financials and resource management

Customer centricity
Collaborative ways of working
Presentation and influencing skills
Business acumen & systems thinking

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.
Job Responsibilities
Team Management
Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment.
Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work.
Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.
Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members.
Capability Development & Resource Management:
Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it.
Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution.

jobs.title: ASIC Digital Design (Functional safety), Sr. Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the space where hardware meets safety, and you know that a chip destined for an automotive system is not just about performance or power, it is about proving that when something goes wrong, the design catches it before it matters. You think in failure modes, diagnostic coverage, and safety mechanisms, not as compliance checkboxes but as engineering decisions that determine whether a product ships or gets recalled.
You have read ISO 26262 enough times that you can tell when a Technical Safety Concept is missing a dependency or when an FMEA is too shallow to survive an audit. You are comfortable sitting with RTL design architects who are sketching out a new IP block and asking the questions that surface safety gaps early, before RTL is written and before verification plans are locked. You do not wait for someone to hand you a safety requirement, you help shape it based on what the hardware can realistically deliver.
You have done the work. You have written safety analyses, reviewed fault injection results, defined safety mechanisms, and worked through assessor feedback without losing your patience or your clarity. At Synopsys, you will work on IP and SoC products where safety is not an afterthought, and where the rigor you bring will directly shape what our automotive customers can build.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive Functional Safety activities across ASIC IP and SoC development lifecycles, from early architecture through verification and release
Develop and review safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and safety work products in compliance with ISO 26262
Conduct safety analyses including FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis to identify and mitigate failure modes
Define, implement, and evaluate safety mechanisms at the IP, subsystem, and SoC level to meet diagnostic coverage and fault detection targets
Collaborate with Architecture, RTL Design, and Verification teams to integrate safety into design and validation workflows
Interface with customers, cross-functional teams, and external safety assessors to support audits, reviews, and certification activities
Document safety analyses, traceability matrices, and compliance evidence for internal reviews and external assessments
The Impact You Will Have
Enable Synopsys IP and SoC products to meet automotive safety standards and support customer certification timelines
Reduce late-stage design rework by identifying safety risks early in the architecture and design phases
Improve diagnostic coverage and fault detection capabilities across safety-critical semiconductor products
Strengthening customer confidence by delivering well-documented, auditable safety work products that pass assessor scrutiny
Influence hardware safety architectures that will be deployed in next-generation automotive systems
Build internal capability by mentoring design and verification engineers on Functional Safety principles and practices
Contribute to a culture where safety is embedded in engineering decisions, not bolted on at the end
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
2-4 years of experience in Functional Safety engineering, with a focus on automotive semiconductors, IP, or SoC development.
Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 standards, processes, and compliance requirements across hardware development lifecycles
Proven experience developing and reviewing safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and related safety work products
Hands-on experience in FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis methodologies
Experience defining and evaluating safety mechanisms, diagnostic coverage, and fault mitigation strategies at IP or SoC level
Understanding of semiconductor product development and verification flows, and the ability to work independently with cross-functional teams, customers, and assessors. Experience with automotive IPs, networking or communication IPs, or safety-critical products is a strong plus
Knowledge of CyberSecurity (ISO 21434) is a plus
Knowledge of any protocols such as I3C, AMBA, Ethernet, UFS, UNIPRO is a plus
Who You Are
You can walk into an architecture review and spot a safety gap that others miss, not because you are looking for problems but because you understand how failures propagate
You write safety analyses that are clear enough for an assessor to follow and detailed enough to survive a technical challenge from a design lead
You do not get stuck when requirements are incomplete or when a design decision has not been finalized, you work with what you have and flag what needs to be resolved
You can explain a complex safety mechanism to an RTL engineer in a way that makes sense within their workflow, not as an abstract concept but as something they can implement and verify
You are organized enough to track safety work products across multiple IP blocks and disciplined enough to maintain traceability without cutting corners
You push back when a proposed design does not meet safety targets, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward instead of shutting it down
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
