Description
As a Process Control System Engineer at Micron, you will play a crucial role in developing smart manufacturing solutions that set the standard for Industry 4.0. 1. Job Title & Role Overview
Senior SIEM Engineer — Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) Engineering and Detection Content Engineering. Experience required: 4 to 8 years.
Role Overview
The Senior SIEM Engineer is a senior technical contributor accountable for SIEM delivery and detection content engineering across the enterprise. You will design, build, test, deploy, tune, and continuously improve detections that draw on SIEM, Network Detection and Response (NDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), cloud, identity, network, endpoint, application, and email telemetry.
3. Responsibilities and Tasks
SIEM Engineering and Delivery
Drive the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of the enterprise SIEM platform.
Define and maintain the SIEM delivery roadmap in line with Global Security Organization strategy and business priorities.
Onboard security-relevant log sources with appropriate parsing, normalization, enrichment, correlation, retention, and searchability.
Monitor and improve platform availability, performance, scalability, capacity.
Keep SIEM components on supported versions and ensure relevant patches and updates are applied.
Troubleshoot data ingestion, pipeline, parsing, indexing, correlation, and platform performance issues.
Maintain engineering standards, technical documentation, architecture artifacts, and operating procedures for the SIEM environment.
Identify security-control and detection-coverage gaps and recommend prioritized improvements.
Define security key performance indicators and engineering metrics for SIEM and detection capabilities.
Maintain documented review of detection exceptions, accepted risks, suppressions, exclusions, and rule changes.
Link engineering outcomes to the Global Security Organization’s strategic roadmap and business needs.
4. Qualifications and Experience
4 to 8 years in cybersecurity, security engineering, SIEM engineering, detection engineering, or incident response With a BE/BTech graduation.
Strong hands-on experience operating and engineering an enterprise SIEM platform.
Experience integrating and analyzing telemetry from network, endpoint, cloud, identity, application, and email platforms.
Proven ability to convert threat intelligence, adversary behaviors, and incidents into technical detection content.
5. Required Technical Skills
Data pipeline fundamentals — log ingestion, parsing, normalization, enrichment, schema mapping, correlation, indexing, retention, and data quality.
Scripting — Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable, applied to automation and content engineering.
Engineering tooling — hands-on use of APIs, Git or another version-control platform, and structured content-development practices.
Analysis and documentation — strong analytical, troubleshooting, and technical-writing capabilities.
Detection query and analytics languages — proficiency in one or more of KQL, SPL, EQL, ES|QL, SQL, Lucene, Sigma, or equivalent.
6. Security Technology Knowledge
These technologies matter here as telemetry sources and broader security domain context. Next-generation firewalls such as Cisco or Palo Alto Networks, plus firewall management and monitoring solutions and Endpoint security Tools (EDR, PAM, PKI, DLP).
Web proxy and Secure Web Gateway technologies; Zscaler familiarity is preferred.
Remote-access and SSL VPN solutions.
Intrusion Prevention Systems such as Cisco Firepower or similar platforms.
IPsec tunnels, site-to-site connectivity, and business-to-business interconnects.
Stateful inspection, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, web protocols, and general networking concepts.
Network Detection and Response technologies, SSL/TLS certificates, certificate exchange, PKI, and certificate management.
Endpoint protection and EDR technologies such as SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, or Cylance.
Network data loss prevention technologies such as DarkTrace, McAfee
Access control, data classification, and data-loss-prevention concepts. Cloud, identity, application, email, and endpoint security telemetry.
Use AI-enabled security tools and automation to improve threat detection, incident response, and operational efficiency across cybersecurity environment.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive security tasks, reduce manual effort, and help build smarter, faster, and more scalable cyber operations.
Apply AI and data-driven insights to analyze security events, correlate signals, and support proactive protection of systems, data, and intellectual property
Understanding of AI/ML concepts and a strong willingness to learn and apply AI tools to improve cybersecurity operations, threat detection, and response efficiency.
Automation-first mindset with the ability to identify repetitive manual tasks and leverage scripting, workflow automation, and AI-enabled tools to secure Micron more effectively.

Define architectures for DDR, LPDDR, HBM, CXL-attached memory, and emerging memory technologies.

Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.

Proven ability to develop architecture recommendations using quantitative analysis and engineering tradeoffs.

This would include modeling and simulation for high speed signaling implementations and power supply design including power distribution network (PDN) simulations.

Technical Expertise:
Candidate should have in depth knowledge on PCIe interface Gen5 & Gen6, PCIe Base and CEM specs, LPDDR4/5, NAND memories, ONFI interface (preferred)
Strong knowledge on DC-DC converters, Buck and Boost, PMIC, Power Loss Protection (PLP), LDO, Load Switch devices

Document and communicate results with cross functional counterparts.

Experience in Hardware design, worst-case analysis, simulations, capture schematic, de-rating and assumes complete ownership of the SSD hardware through the product lifecycle.

Comfortable using AI tools

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer(Growth & ML), Hyderabad
jobs.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!
ㅤ
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad
Meet our Team
Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention.
Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks.
We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions.
About the Role
As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring.
Roles & Responsibilities:
ML System Design & Ownership
Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models.
Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs.
Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM).
Modeling & Experimentation
Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching.
Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case.
Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs.
Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR).
MLOps & Infrastructure
Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks.
Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency.
Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds.
Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design.
Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration
Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards.
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs.
Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Flagship Projects You’ll Work On
Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching.
Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms.
ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions.
Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion.
What You’ll Bring
Required
5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.).
Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records).
Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery.
Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda).
Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders.
Preferred:
Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context.
Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation.
Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration.
Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex.
Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications.

jobs.title: Facilities Cost Engineer (OPEX)
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
1. OPEX Budgeting (Annual & Quarterly)
Lead preparation of the annual OPEX budget for Construction & Facilities, covering utilities, O&M contracts, AMCs, repairs and maintenance, consumables, services, manpower contracts and other operating cost elements.
Prepare quarterly budget refreshes and rolling forecasts; incorporate operational changes, ramp-up plans, contract renewals, escalations and inflation assumptions.
Build cost models and bottom-up estimates with cost owners; maintain clear basis-of-estimate documentation and assumptions.
Align budgets to cost centers, GL accounts and WBS elements as per Micron Finance structure; support budget reviews and approvals with the Program Lead and Finance.
Identify cost-saving and cost-avoidance opportunities and incorporate them into budget plans.
2. OPEX QVS Performance Tracking
Track and report OPEX performance against QVS targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, including actuals, commitments, accruals and forecast-to-complete.
Perform variance analysis (budget vs. actual vs. forecast), identify root causes and drive corrective actions with cost owners.
Prepare dashboards and management reports for the Program Lead and site leadership; highlight risks, opportunities and spend trends.
Support month-end and quarter-end close, and respond to Finance and corporate queries on OPEX performance.
3. SAP Transactions – PR Issuance, GRN Adjustments & Accruals
Create, modify and track Purchase Requisitions (PRs) in SAP with correct account assignment (cost center, GL, WBS), and follow up through approval workflow to PO conversion.
Coordinate Goods/Service Receipts (GRN/SES) with requestors and perform GRN adjustments, reversals and corrections as required.
Estimate and post monthly accruals for services rendered but not invoiced; reverse and true-up accruals in line with corporate accounting policies and close calendars.
Monitor open POs, aged commitments and unutilized balances; drive PO closure and de-obligation of residual values.
Ensure all SAP transactions are accurate, timely, auditable and compliant with internal controls (SOX / delegation of authority).
4. OPEX P2P Tracking (PR to Payment)
Own end-to-end tracking of the Procure-to-Pay cycle: PR → PO → GRN/SES → Invoice → Payment for all Construction & Facilities OPEX spend.
Validate vendor invoices against PO terms, contract rates, GRN/SES quantities and service evidence (3-way match); resolve price/quantity mismatches and blocked invoices.
Verify statutory requirements on invoices, including GST compliance, TDS applicability and e-invoicing details, in coordination with Accounts Payable and Tax teams.
Maintain a P2P tracker with status, ageing and bottlenecks; follow up with Procurement, AP and vendors to ensure on-time payment and minimize vendor escalations.
Reconcile vendor statements and support vendor ledger clean-up and resolution of disputes.
5. Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to Micron procurement, finance and audit policies; support internal and external audits with complete documentation.
Standardize OPEX processes, templates and reporting; drive automation of trackers and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Excel/VBA, SAP reports).
Partner with Procurement on contract scope, rate validation, escalation clauses and renewals to ensure commercial accuracy.
6. AI-Enabled Ways of Working
Use approved AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise GenAI assistants) to speed up budget preparation, draft variance commentary, summarize contracts and SOWs, and prepare management reports, while checking all AI outputs for accuracy.
Use AI and advanced analytics for OPEX forecasting and spend trend analysis, such as predicting utility, maintenance and contract costs from historical consumption and operating data.
Apply AI and automation to P2P processes, including invoice data extraction, automated 3-way match exception flagging, duplicate or anomalous invoice detection, and accrual estimation support.
Find repetitive OPEX and SAP tasks that can be automated (AI agents, RPA, Power Automate, Power BI) and work with Finance, IT and digital teams to build and scale these solutions.
Keep financial data clean, structured and well governed so it can be used reliably by AI and analytics tools.
Follow Micron’s Responsible AI, data privacy, information security and confidentiality policies; never put confidential vendor, pricing or financial data into unapproved tools.
Share AI use cases and good practices with the Construction & Facilities team and support colleagues in adopting AI-enabled ways of working.

jobs.title: Project MIS & Coordination Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
1. Project MIS, Reporting & Dashboards
Design, own and maintain the program MIS framework: data structures, reporting templates, critical metrics and governance cadence.
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly progress reports, executive summaries and leadership review decks for the Program Lead, site leadership and global Facilities / Construction teams.
Build and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., Power BI) covering schedule performance, physical progress, cost and cash flow, workforce and equipment, safety statistics, quality and open issues.
Consolidate and validate data from contractors, consultants and internal teams; reconcile reported progress against site verification and measurement.
Track earned value metrics (SPI, CPI, S-curves) and highlight variances, trends and forecasts with clear commentary.
2. Planning & Schedule Coordination
Support the development and maintenance of the integrated master schedule (Level 1–4) in Primavera P6, aligning contractor schedules with Micron turning points such as building ready, cleanroom certification, tool move-in and production readiness.
Run periodic schedule updates, critical-path and float analyses, look-ahead (3-week / 6-week) plans and delay / impact assessments.
Review contractor baseline and update submissions for logic, resource loading and compliance with contract requirements.
Supervise interface breakthroughs between civil, structural, architectural, MEP, process utilities and tool install packages.
3. Project Coordination & Governance
Organise and facilitate program review meetings, contractor progress meetings and multi-functional coordination forums; publish minutes and drive action-item closure.
Maintain action, issue, RFI, submittal and decision logs; call out overdue or critical items to the Program Lead.
Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement / Supply Chain, Finance, EHS, Quality, IT and Operations to align priorities and resolve interface issues.
Serve as liaison with global Micron Facilities and Construction teams on reporting standards, templates and guidelines.
4. Cost, Commitment & Change Tracking
Track budgets, commitments (POs / contracts), actuals, accruals and forecasts in coordination with Finance and Procurement; support monthly financial close and cash-flow forecasting.
Maintain the change / variation register; support evaluation of change requests for cost and schedule impact and track approvals.
Monitor contractor billing against certified progress and support invoice verification workflows.
5. Risk Management
Maintain the program risk and opportunity register; facilitate periodic risk reviews and track mitigation actions and owners.
Identify emerging risks from data trends (e.g., productivity drops, long-lead procurement delays, manpower shortfalls) and raise early warnings.
6. Document Control & Information Management
Supervise document control processes in the Common Data Environment (e.g., Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint) – drawings, specifications, submittals, transmittals and as-builts.
Ensure version control, approval workflows, numbering conventions and records retention comply with Micron standards and audit requirements.
Support handover documentation, O&M manuals and close-out records for facility turnover to Operations.
7. Digital Tools & Continuous Improvement
Drive automation of data collection and reporting (Excel / Power Query, Power Automate, SharePoint lists, APIs) to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
Champion standardisation of WBS, cost codes and progress measurement methods across packages.
Chip in lessons learned and support adoption of digital construction practices (BIM 4D/5D linkage, mobile site reporting).
8. AI-Enabled Ways of Working
Use approved enterprise AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot and Micron-sanctioned AI assistants) to draft progress reports, meeting minutes, executive summaries and leadership presentations, then check every output for accuracy before it is issued.
Apply AI and analytics to project data to spot schedule slippage, cost overruns, productivity trends and emerging risks earlier, and to support forecasts of completion dates and cash flow.
Use AI-assisted search and summarisation to pull out key information from contracts, specifications, RFIs, submittals and meeting records in the CDE.
Find repetitive MIS and coordination tasks that can be automated or AI-assisted; build or pilot solutions with IT and digital teams and measure the time and quality gains.
Follow Micron's responsible-AI, data-privacy, confidentiality and IP policies: use only approved tools, never enter restricted data into unapproved platforms, and keep human review and accountability for all AI-assisted outputs.
Share AI good practice, prompts and templates with the project team, and help colleagues and contractor staff use AI-enabled reporting tools.
9. EHS, Quality & Compliance
Integrate EHS (incidents, man-hours, observations) and quality (NCRs, inspections, punch lists) metrics into program reporting.
Uphold Micron's Code of Business Conduct, EHS policies and data-confidentiality requirements in all project information handling.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Description
Job Purpose
The Facilities Senior Manager is responsible for continuous, safe, and compliant operation of all fab facilities and critical utilities supporting semiconductor manufacturing in Operation, Maintenance, Engineering and Hook Up. This includes bulk and high-purity gas distribution systems, chemicals, Ultra‑Pure Water (UPW), wastewater treatment, HVAC and cleanroom environmental control, electrical systems, and building infrastructure in a 24×7,
This role directly impacts yield, uptime, safety, and customer audit outcomes.
Core Responsibilities
Fab Facilities & Critical Utilities Operations/Maintenance and Engineering
Lead operations of bulk & specialty gas systems, chemical distribution systems, UPW, process cooling water, wastewater treatment, Electrical System, Building Infrastructure HVAC, and cleanroom environmental systems.
Ensure continuous availability of all utilities required for Manufacturing with minimal production impact.
On Time Hook Up of Production tools
Own facility incident response and serve as first responder for site‑wide facilities and hook up events.
2. Cleanroom & Environmental Control
Maintain clean room temperature, humidity, pressure, and contamination control within fab‑defined limits.
Coordinate filter maintenance, airflow verification, and critical environmental alarms to protect yield‑sensitive operations.
Support particulate, AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination), and vibration control programs aligned with fab standards (as referenced in semiconductor cleanroom roles).
3. EHSS & Regulatory Compliance
Ensure full compliance with EHSS, hazardous gas, chemical safety, wastewater discharge, and environmental regulations concerning semiconductor manufacturing.
Maintain 100% EHSS training certification for all facilities staff and contractors.
Lead corrective and preventive actions following incidents, audits, or near‑miss events.
4. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop facilities technicians, engineers, and supervisors in a shift‑based 24×7 operation.
Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.
5. Maintenance, Reliability & Performance Management
Establish and govern preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all fab utilities and infrastructure.
Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.
6. Commissioning, Projects & Expansion Support
Lead commissioning of new fab utilities, equipment, and facility expansions supporting ramp‑up or technology node changes.
Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.
7. Financial & Vendor Management
Own facilities budget, forecasting, and cost‑optimization initiatives.
Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.
8. Customer & Audit Readiness
Represent the site during customer audits, ISO, EHSS, and certification reviews.
Act as the site’s voice in global facilities forums to align with corporate standards.
Qualifications & Experience
Required
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or equivalent.
12–15+ years of experience in semiconductor fab facilities or similar high‑reliability industrial environments.
Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.
Key Competencies
Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management
Multi-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Process, and Equipment teams
Data‑driven reliability improvement
Typical benchmarks
Fab utility uptime
Safety & EHSS compliance score
Incident response time
PM compliance rate
Cost optimization vs budget

Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of software engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy custom Agentic AI applications integrated with our Salesforce ecosystem. Context Grounding & RAG Pipelines: Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connecting vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) to supply real-time context to LLMs while mitigating hallucinations. Workflow Automation & Agent Governance: Define function calling schemas, tool definitions, dynamic planning loops, and fallbacks. Implement safety guardrails, prompt evaluation suites, rate limiting, and seamless human-in-the-loop (HITL) handoffs. Observability & Reliability: Set up agent monitoring, evaluation metrics, and tracing to track execution paths, latency, context usage, and token costs. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Salesforce Architects, Product Managers, and security teams to translate complex CRM requirements into reliable AI features adhering to enterprise compliance and data governance standards. Agentic AI & LLM Systems: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing production AI agents, autonomous decision loops, multi-agent coordination, and function-calling/tool-use paradigms. Salesforce Core Knowledge: Proven experience interacting with Salesforce APIs (REST/Composite/Bulk), SOQL/SOSL queries, Connected Apps, OAuth flows, and Apex (Invocable Actions, Triggers). Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js for AI backend systems. Vector Databases & Embeddings: Direct experience with semantic search, embeddings generation, and vector engines (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, PGVector). Cloud & DevOps: Proficiency in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines. Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of B2B Sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), and the end-to-end Opportunity-to-Quote (Q2C) lifecycle . That means we're constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking boundaries of what the workplace can be!. jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities • Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. • Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. • Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. • Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. • Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. • Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. • Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). • Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. • Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. • Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. • Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. • Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. • A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. • Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. • Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. • Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. • A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. • Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). • Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. • Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. • Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. • Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. • Coming from a backend background? jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Title and Summary AI Engineer II Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities • Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. • Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. • Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. • Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. • Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. • Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. • Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). • Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. • Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. • Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. • Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. • Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. • A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. • Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. • Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. • Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. • A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. • Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). • Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. • Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. • Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. • Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. jobs.description: Oracle University is seeking an experienced technical leader to design, develop, deliver, and maintain advanced hands-on learning solutions for Oracle Fusion Applications, Oracle AI Agent Studio, and enterprise AI and agentic technologies. This Principal / IC4 individual-contributor role combines three critical capabilities: deep Oracle Fusion Applications technical expertise, hands-on AI agent and software development, and the ability to translate complex implementations into effective technical learning experiences. You will build, integrate, test, evaluate, and troubleshoot enterprise AI solutions and transform that experience into courses, labs, code samples, demonstrations, assessments, and certification-aligned learning assets. You will also collaborate closely with Oracle Product Development to validate implementation approaches, resolve technical challenges, and ensure training evolves alongside Oracle product capabilities and releases. Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities 1. Lead technical learning development: Own the end-to-end design, development, delivery, and maintenance of advanced technical learning for Oracle Fusion Applications, AI agents, agentic applications, extensibility, integrations, and enterprise AI development. 2. Develop enterprise-grade technical solutions: Build, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and document realistic Oracle Fusion and AI solutions using APIs, SDKs, developer tools, enterprise data, application services, and workflows. 3. Build and evaluate AI agents: Create, customize, integrate, evaluate, troubleshoot, and demonstrate AI agents using Oracle AI Agent Studio, including prompts, tools, workflows, enterprise data, security controls, and human oversight. 4. Create hands-on learning experiences: Develop technically rigorous courses, labs, reusable code repositories, walkthroughs, demonstrations, assessments, and certification-aligned learning using low-code and pro-code approaches. 5. Partner with Product Development: Collaborate with engineering, product management, and subject-matter experts to validate technical approaches, investigate issues, and incorporate emerging capabilities into learning solutions. 6. Apply AI-assisted development practices: Use enterprise-approved AI tools for prototyping, development, debugging, documentation, testing, evaluation, and content creation while validating outputs and following responsible AI practices. 7. Ensure technical quality and reproducibility: Maintain accurate, secure, reproducible, and maintainable code, labs, environments, dependencies, and technical guidance aligned with supported product capabilities. 8. Provide technical leadership: Establish technical standards, review complex learning assets, mentor colleagues, develop reusable technical patterns, and deliver selected workshops, demonstrations, and train-the-trainer sessions. Qualifications & SkillsMandatory Education and professional experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 10 years of hands-on experience developing, extending, integrating, or supporting Oracle Fusion Applications. Oracle Fusion Applications expertise Deep understanding of Oracle Fusion application architecture, extensibility, business objects, enterprise APIs, security, integrations, and data access across at least one application area, such as ERP, HCM, SCM, CX, or industry applications. Technical learning development Proven ability to independently learn emerging technologies and translate complex technical implementations into courses, tutorials, hands-on labs, code walkthroughs, recorded demonstrations, and assessments. Experience developing reusable sample repositories, lab environments, dependency documentation, and automated validation for technical learning solutions. Product collaboration and execution Experience working with prerelease software and collaborating with engineering or product-management teams to validate technical guidance, investigate issues, and manage changes across product releases. Ability to work independently, communicate risks and dependencies early, and deliver against agreed scope and timelines. Strong written technical communication, presentation, facilitation, train-the-trainer, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. Good-to-Have PREFERRED DIFFERENTIATORS Relevant Oracle Fusion Applications, OCI, AI, integration, or development certifications. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI/ML
jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities • Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. • Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). • Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. • Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. • Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. • Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications • 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. • Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. • Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). • Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. • Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. • Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. • Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills • Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. • Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. • Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). • Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #LI-Hybrid #LI-EDA

jobs.title: Scaled AI & Solution Architect
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The Scaled AI & Solution Architect is the senior technical design authority for the Digital Quality (DQ) organisation, which delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer. The role is a global individual contributor position accountable for setting and driving the AI and solution architecture direction across the entire DQ product portfolio, rather than for the delivery of any single product. The incumbent defines the target architecture, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering standards that every DQ solution is built against, so that capability is built once and reused many times rather than rebuilt product by product. The role leads the scaled adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI across the portfolio, translating enterprise AI platforms and emerging technology into GxP-compliant, validated, production-grade capability that measurably improves quality, safety and environmental outcomes at site level. Recognised as an expert within and beyond Digital Quality, the incumbent influences the strategic technology direction of the QSEO business, and partners with Solution Leads, the Platform and Solution Engineering team, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security to ensure architectural coherence, compliance and pace across a complex global portfolio. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Cross-Product Solution Architecture Own the target-state solution architecture for the Digital Quality portfolio, spanning quality management, laboratory, manufacturing quality, and safety, environment and occupational health solutions. Define how products, platforms, data and integrations fit together, and drive convergence of point solutions onto common architecture, avoiding duplicated capability and unmanaged technical debt across the portfolio. Architecture Standards, Patterns and Reusable Components Establish, publish and maintain the architecture standards, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering guardrails that DQ solutions are designed and built against, covering integration, data, identity, AI, validation and cyber security. Make reuse the path of least resistance for delivery teams, and measure adoption, reuse and the resulting delivery efficiency. Scaled AI Enablement Define and drive the AI and agentic AI architecture for the DQ portfolio, including use case patterns such as deviation and incident triage, leading-indicator prediction, automated document and content generation, and conversational access to standards and procedures. Determine where AI capability should be built once as a shared service versus configured per product, and ensure AI is delivered on enterprise platforms with appropriate human oversight, evaluation, model monitoring and lifecycle management. Design Authority and Technical Governance Act as design authority for significant DQ investments, reviewing and approving solution designs at key lifecycle gates and providing architectural assurance on build-versus-buy, platform selection and vendor technical fit. Identify multiple viable options for highly complex problems, set out the trade-offs in cost, risk, compliance and time to value, and make clear recommendations to Digital and business leadership and relevant governance forums. Technical Leadership and Capability Building Provide hands-on architectural leadership to Solution Leads, Product Managers, engineers and vendor teams across the portfolio without direct reporting authority, influencing through expertise, credibility and evidence. Mentor and raise the technical capability of architects and engineers across Digital Quality, and lead architecture and AI Communities of Practice that spread good practice across DQ and the wider Digital organisation. Compliance, Data Integrity and Security by Design Ensure architectural decisions embed GxP computerised system compliance, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements from the outset, in partnership with Quality, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Cyber Security. Define validation-efficient architecture patterns that allow AI and cloud capability to be deployed at pace while remaining inspection-ready. Innovation and Emerging Technology Exercise foresight in evaluating emerging AI, data and platform technologies, and act independently on self-initiated proofs of concept and technical experiments that challenge the status quo and shape the multi-year DQ technology roadmap. Take appropriate, well-governed technical risk, and translate proven experiments into scaled, supportable production capability with a defined adoption path. QUALIFICATIONS Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Engineering, Environmental or Occupational Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in in solution architecture, technical leadership or enterprise software delivery (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including demonstrable accountability for architecture across a portfolio of products rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI or machine learning capability into production, including an understanding of large language model and agentic architecture patterns, retrieval, evaluation and model lifecycle management. Strong experience with cloud, integration and data architecture, and with modern software engineering and Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Experience setting and driving adoption of technical standards across teams that do not report to the incumbent, influencing senior stakeholders through technical credibility. Experience across all stages of the system and application lifecycle, from value analysis and business case through deployment to value realisation and technical debt management. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leaders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation and data integrity expectations (e.g. GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11). Working knowledge of quality, or EHS business processes and the platforms that support them (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority). Experience deploying AI in a regulated context, including responsible AI governance, model risk assessment and human-in-the-loop design. Recognised architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF) or equivalent cloud architecture certification. Track record of external technical contribution — industry forums, working groups, publications or conference speaking. PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to work with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms – Digital Quality Lead. Key internal relationships include Enterprise Architecture, the enterprise AI and Data organization, Cyber Security, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation, Legal and Privacy, and senior business stakeholders across Quality and EHS in Pfizer Global Supply. External: strategic software and AI vendors, cloud and platform providers, implementation and managed service partners, and relevant industry and regulatory technical forums. RESOURCES MANAGED Financial Accountability No direct budget ownership. Influences the architecture and technology decisions underpinning the Digital Quality portfolio representing approximately $10M of annual software, services and transformation investment, and is accountable for identifying reuse and rationalization opportunities that improve return on that investment Supervision Individual contributor with no direct reports. Provides technical direction and design authority to matrixed teams of product, engineering, data, validation and vendor resources across the Digital Quality portfolio, and mentors architects and senior engineers across the organization. Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Information & Business Tech

jobs.description: Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work â whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI). You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo. Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally. We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture. If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact! At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms. What Youâll Do Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products. Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift. Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers. Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems. Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team. Your background Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production. Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment. Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code. Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems. Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.) Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL). Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity. It's great, but not required, if you have Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness. Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer(Growth & ML), Hyderabad
jobs.description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! ㅤ Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad Meet our Team Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention. Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks. We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions . About the Role As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. Roles & Responsibilities: ML System Design & Ownership Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). Modeling & Experimentation Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). MLOps & Infrastructure Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks. Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency. Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds. Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design. Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards. Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs. Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Flagship Projects You’ll Work On Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching. Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms. ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions. Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion. What You’ll Bring Required 5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.). Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records). Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery. Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda). Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization. Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders. Preferred: Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context. Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation. Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex. Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications. What We Offer: A Great Place to work Equal opportunity employer Fast track growth opportunities About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.
