jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. ServiceNow Engineer About Lilly At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. About the IT Organization Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Technology at Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise. Digital Core is at the forefront of digitalization to enable and advance the entire company, with increased productivity and best-in-class Customer experiences. This team provides a robust and sustainable infrastructure of hardware, software and services that are critical to enable our global workforce. As leaders in technology, this team defines and leads the overall company technology strategy. About the Team Global Service Management (GSM) team works to enable Lilly to enhance global productivity and protect our Brand. The team manages the industry leading ServiceNow enterprise platform. We enable our 69k global workforce to accelerate how they work, manage critical action plans, and enhance their working methods/environment, and manage key vendor contracts / spending. In addition to maintaining operational excellence for our existing services, we must boldly innovate and enhance capabilities such as generative AI, automation & workflows across the enterprise. This will enable us to enhance our return on investment, improve user efficiency and experience, and help support the broader Company purpose of making life better for people around the world. What You'll Be Doing As a ServiceNow Engineer on the ServiceNow platform, you'll serve as a senior technical SME and strategic leader within our Global Service Management organization. You'll drive platform innovation, lead technical delivery, and ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems. You'll collaborate with architects, developers, vendors, and business stakeholders to shape and evolve our ServiceNow ecosystem. In this role, you will also be expected to leverage and contribute to ServiceNow's rapidly evolving Agentic AI capabilities. This includes working with the ServiceNow Agentic AI Suite — encompassing Now Assist (Otto), ServiceNow's generative AI assistant that powers intelligent search, summarization, and conversational experiences across the platform — as well as Now Assist for Creator, which accelerates development by enabling AI-assisted flow design, code generation, and natural-language-to-configuration capabilities. You will be expected to evaluate, adopt, and operationalize these AI-native features to drive automation, improve developer productivity, and enhance the end-user experience across the enterprise. This is a Dev-Ops role, which means the position operates on a rotational shift basis. You will be required to work either morning shifts or evening shifts to ensure round-the-clock platform support, incident response, and operational continuity across global time zones. How You Will Succeed Platform Leadership: Own the technical roadmap for ServiceNow capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business goals. Solution Delivery: Lead end-to-end technical delivery for new features, including configuration, workflow design, UI customization, reporting, and integrations. Integration Strategy: Architect and implement integrations with LDAP/Active Directory, SSO (SAML, SiteMinder), REST/SOAP APIs, cloud platforms (AWS, VMware), and enterprise systems. Governance & Standards: Conduct impact analysis and code reviews to ensure conformance with architecture, data, and integration standards. Collaboration: Partner with Platform Architects, Technical Leads, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions. Support & Optimization: Provide expert-level troubleshooting and performance tuning across the platform. Documentation & Enablement: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and mentor junior engineers. Continuous Improvement: Stay current with ServiceNow releases and industry trends to drive platform evolution. What You Will Bring Deep technical expertise in the ServiceNow platform, including administration, scripting, and application development. Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, CMDB, and configuration management principles. Proven experience leading technical delivery across the full software lifecycle. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset and commitment to excellence. A passion for mentoring, learning, and driving cross-functional success. Basic Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in ServiceNow development. Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and ServiceNow scripting.Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and integration tools.Fluent in English for verbal and written communications, is essential. Additional Skills/Preferences ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is a plus. Applied knowledge of ITIL v3 or ITIL v4. Experience with AWS, VMware, JDBC/ODBC, and enterprise data management. Demonstrated ability to drive platform strategy and cross-functional alignment. jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect (DPO)
jobs.description: Job Summary Agentic QA Solution Architect Quality Solution Architect for AI Agents & Agentic Automation About the Role AI agents are non-deterministic: the same input can produce different outputs across runs. Testing them requires a fundamentally different discipline than scripted test automation - evaluation frameworks, scoring functions, and statistical judgment instead of exact-match assertions. As an Agentic QA Engineer, you will bring that discipline directly to our customers. This is a forward-deployed, customer-facing engineering role. You will work side by side with enterprise customers to design, build, test, and harden agentic workflows in their live environments - combining the hands-on coding of a software engineer, the quality mindset of a test automation expert, and the end-to-end design perspective of a solution architect. You will own the question every customer asks before putting an AI agent into production: "How do we know we can trust it?" Key Responsibilities What You Will Do Deploy and validate agentic solutions at customers. Work with enterprise customers to implement, integrate, and operationalize AI agents and agentic workflows in production environments - including APIs, data pipelines, and integration with existing customer systems. Design testing agents and evaluation strategies for deterministic and non-deterministic systems. Define what "quality" means for each agentic use case and turn it into measurable signals: evaluation suites, scoring functions, regression baselines, and pass/fail criteria that account for variability in agent behavior. Build and run evaluation frameworks. Implement automated evals (LLM-as-judge, semantic similarity, structured-output checks, human annotation rubrics) that track accuracy, latency, and cost across agent runs, and compare every release against baselines to catch regressions. Perform adversarial and safety testing. Probe agents for failure modes, hallucinations, prompt-injection vulnerabilities, and out-of-scope actions; validate guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and escalation paths before go-live. Automate the testing lifecycle. Build and maintain automated test suites for both deterministic components (integrations, workflows, UI) and agentic components, wired into CI/CD so quality gates run on every deployment. Act as a trusted technical advisor. Translate customer requirements into solution and test architecture; explain evaluation results, risks, and trade-offs to audiences ranging from QA engineers to non-technical executives. Architect for scale. Apply solution-architecture judgment to design quality strategies that span the full solution - agents, RPA/workflow/tools automation, integrations, and human-in-the-loop steps - and that customers can operate and extend themselves. Close the loop with product and engineering. Feed field findings - failure patterns, missing capabilities, evaluation gaps - back into the product roadmap and internal best practices, and contribute to reusable test assets and accelerators. Skill Requirements What You Bring (Required) Software engineering foundation. 7+ years of hands-on software development experience in Python, C#, VB.NET, or comparable languages, with the ability to write production-quality code and test harnesses. Testing and QA depth. 3+ years in software testing / test automation, including test strategy design, automated test frameworks, and CI/CD-integrated quality gates. Hands-on experience with AI agents. Practical experience building, deploying, or testing LLM-based agents and agentic workflows (e.g., tool/function calling, RAG, multi-step orchestration, frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph or the Model Context Protocol), ideally in customer or production settings. LLM evaluation literacy. Working understanding of non-determinism, prompting, grounding, and hallucination, and experience setting up evals - including LLM-as-judge approaches, rubric-based scoring, and regression testing of model or prompt changes. Customer-facing experience. Proven track record in a forward-deployed, professional services, implementation, or consulting role: leading technical workshops, managing stakeholder expectations, and delivering under real-world constraints in customer environments. Solution architecture background. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across applications, APIs, and automation platforms - able to see the whole system, not just the component under test. Communication. Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting technical findings and quality risks to executive stakeholders. Fluent English. Must Have Skill UiPath Agentic AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements What Sets You Apart (Preferred) Experience with agentic testing or AI-augmented QA platforms (e.g., UiPath Test Cloud / Test Manager, or comparable AI-powered testing tools) and with automation platforms more broadly (RPA, workflow orchestration). Experience with evaluation and observability tooling for LLM applications (e.g., LangSmith, Braintrust, Promptfoo, or custom pytest-based eval harnesses) and with tracing/monitoring agent behavior in production. Statistical literacy - able to distinguish signal from noise in non-deterministic outputs and reason about sample sizes, baselines, and confidence. Experience with test management and ALM tooling (e.g., ADO, Jira - Xray, TestRail, Test Manager) and requirements-to-test traceability. Knowledge of AI governance, safety, and compliance considerations for deploying agents in regulated industries. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. How Success Is Measured Customers move agentic use cases from pilot to production with documented, repeatable evaluation and test coverage. Evaluation suites catch regressions before customers do - measured by escaped-defect and eval-coverage trends. Customer stakeholders trust and understand the quality evidence behind every go-live decision. Field learnings are converted into reusable test assets, patterns, and product feedback.

Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). jobs.description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Sales Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. The Experience Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. The Builder Leadership Experience Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. What You'll Actually Be Doing Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm. Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months. Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration. Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies. Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes. Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed. You're Our Person If... Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments. You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent. You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value. You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects. You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it. Even Better If... Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails. Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines. Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist). Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. jobs.title: Staff, AI Product Manager
jobs.description: About the Role: GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and AI agents and workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes. We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager to own the Orchestration and Automation platform tower: the low and medium code platforms where GSK builds agents and automations, and the enablement model that lets thousands of non-engineers use them safely. The estate spans workflow and agent builders such as Power Platform, Copilot Studio and n8n, alongside the adjacent orchestration tooling that sits with them. You will own the roadmap and the governance model, and act as the platform consultant business teams come to when they need to turn demand into working automations. Why This Role Exists GSK runs various low and medium code platforms, and demand from business teams outpaces any central delivery team. This role exists to take consolidation decisions, and to build the self-enablement layer — guardrails, templates, training, support — that lets citizen developers build safely without engineering review on every change. In this role you will be the person who: Owns the Orchestration and Automation platform tower and its roadmap. Takes consolidation decisions across the low and medium code platform estate. Acts as the platform consultant for business teams building on the estate. Owns the governance model that defines what a citizen developer may build unsupervised. How This Differs from Traditional Product Management This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you: Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems. Work with probabilistic systems, defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight. Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to AI agents and workers, and how they hand off. Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Platform Portfolio & Consolidation Map capability against actual usage across the whole low and medium code estate, and recommend what consolidates, what stays, and what retires. Quantify value rigorously. Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, manual effort removed, licence cost avoided, automations running in production. Develop deep automation pattern recognition so you can spot the workflows worth automating and the ones that should be fixed at source instead. Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping Shape the platform roadmap. Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized platform work, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader AI Platforms & Tools portfolio. Make trade-off recommendations. When two business sponsors both want platform investment, define the success metrics, run the analysis, and recommend where effort goes. Protect engineering focus. Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes. Engineering Partnership & Enablement Consult on platform fit and design. Advise business teams and delivery squads on which platform fits, how to structure the build, and what it takes to reach production. Translate ambiguous requests into crisp problem statements and success metrics. Shape engagements end-to-end. Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute. Surface re-use and platform leverage when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability. Design the human and agent split. Decide which tasks the pod’s AI agents and workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe. Stakeholder Alignment & Communication Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders. Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements. Build sponsor coalitions that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements. Communicate impact clearly in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes. Measurement, Learning & Iteration Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework to every engagement and platform in the tower, and improve it with what you learn. Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons back into how the tower selects platforms and prioritizes demand Required Skills: 16+ years of progressive experience in enterprise platform leadership, with a meaningful part of it spent owning a platform or platform estate end to end: roadmap, architecture direction, operations, and lifecycle. Demonstrated track record of taking a platform from fragmented or underused to well run: consolidation calls made, adoption grown, and the operating model that sustained it. Experience running a platform in a regulated enterprise, with working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain and the data, decisions, and constraints inside it. Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML, covering LLMs, agentic systems, AI agents and workers, data and evaluation patterns, sufficient to set architecture direction, challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices. Experience leading engineers directly while also leading a far larger citizen developer community through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking. A platform product heritage: roadmap shaping, lifecycle and version management, vendor and licensing ownership, service levels, and stakeholder alignment across a large and varied user base. Preferred skills : Deep, hands-on Microsoft Power Platform experience is mandatory: Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse at enterprise scale, including environment strategy, ALM, licensing, and the governance model around them. Has owned a low or medium code automation platform at enterprise scale and run a citizen developer or self-service programme covering thousands of users, with guardrails that held under pressure. Fluent with the wider low and medium code agent and workflow stacks that sit alongside Power Platform, such as Copilot Studio, n8n, and the equivalents from the major cloud vendors. Skills AI Platforms, Change Management, Data Analysis, Microsoft ALM, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Power Platform, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Inclusion at GSK: As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs. Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

jobs.description: About the Role: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers direct that work and own the quality of what ships. Humans and digital workers both rely on a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them. The Data Engineer II independently owns a data domain. The role designs pipelines for complex use cases, owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in that domain, and keeps its context accurate and audit-ready. It also contributes reusable components to the platform and raises technical quality across the team. Why This Role Exists: Owns a data domain end-to-end, with clear accountability for the pipelines, models and datasets digital workers build and operate in it, and sound independent judgement on design choices. Makes digital workers more effective in that domain by improving the frameworks, tools and evaluations they use, so manual intervention falls measurably over time. Delivers quality-assured data to AI systems through data contracts, governed context and quality frameworks that hold up to audit. Key Responsibilities: Agent-Operated Data Engineering: Design pipelines for complex use cases and direct digital workers to build and operate them, with clear, defensible architectural trade-offs. Own the quality of agent-generated work in your domain: review, test and approve it within the remit EAI's operating model sets, and escalate what falls outside it. Improve how digital workers operate in your domain by refining the frameworks, tools and evaluations they use, iterating on reliability signals so manual intervention falls measurably over time. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID 72346 Category Enterprise Technology Location Chennai, India Work Type On-site Who You Are An agent orchestrator, not a typist. You don't want to be a faster keyboard. You want to be a manager of agents — handing off the heavy lifting, reviewing the output, and keeping your hands on the architecture. The IDE is a cockpit for orchestration, not a text editor. Productively lazy. Your dream workflow: describe the requirement, let the agent build it, verify, ship, next. You automate anything a human shouldn't be doing twice. Your biggest bottleneck should be deciding what to build — while AI executes the how . Fundamentals first. Data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, networking — you understand the machine, not just the library that wraps it. When a framework breaks, you fix it. When AI gives you the wrong answer, you catch it. Orchestrating agents only works if you can tell good output from garbage. First-principles thinker with vision. You break problems to their core, question the assumptions, and rebuild. A software engineer's job is to architect solutions, not wrestle with syntax. You don't copy an architecture because "that's how it's done" — you ask why and decide if there's a better way. High agency. You don't wait for perfect specs or permission. You find a path, propose it, and move. Large organizations have walls; you figure out which ones to go through, around, or remove — and you do it constructively. Bias for action. Requirements will be messy and priorities will shift. You ship v1, learn, and iterate instead of living in design review. Why This Role Ford is a 120-year-old company moving fast on AI, and that's the real challenge: building world-class AI applications inside a large enterprise with real constraints — security, compliance, legacy systems. The engineers who thrive here treat those constraints as problems to solve, not reasons to stop. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you're a 10x thinker who wants to build something that matters — and have the grit to push through the hard parts — let's talk. What You'll Do Orchestrate agents to build. Use AI as your default way of working — agents do the heavy lifting, you direct, review, and harden. You set the bar for how the team builds with AI. Build the AI use cases. Design and ship AI-powered applications and agents — RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, agentic workflows. Understand what's happening under the hood and make it work in production, at scale. Ship cloud-native systems on GCP. Design, deploy, operate. You own the architecture, the infrastructure-as-code, and the CI/CD pipeline. No throwing code over the wall. Connect systems that don't want to be connected. Build the integration layer across enterprise SaaS platforms. Expect messy APIs, legacy constraints, and creative problem-solving. Automate what shouldn't be manual. If a human repeats it, you write the code — or point an agent at it — to stop it. Make other engineers faster. Build the tools, agent workflows, and guardrails that remove friction. Developer productivity is a multiplier. Requirements BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. MS is a plus, not a substitute for shipping software. 2+ years building and deploying full-stack applications in production. 2+ years on cloud-native platforms (GCP preferred). Demonstrable experience building AI agents or applications — show us what you've built, not what you've read. What You Bring Python — deep. You write production systems, not just scripts. JavaScript / TypeScript — React, Node.js, or equivalent. A real frontend and a real API. Front-end strength is a big plus. AI engineering — LLMs, embeddings, vector stores, RAG. Comfortable building agents and evaluation pipelines. Bonus for fine-tuning or eval work. AI-assisted development — fluent with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows, and clear-eyed about where they help and where they don't. GCP — Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Storage. Deployed and operated, not just tutorials. Databases — relational and NoSQL. You know when to use what, and why. APIs & microservices — designed and built RESTful services at scale. Git, IaC & CI/CD — Terraform, Cloud Build, or equivalent. Reproducible, version-controlled infrastructure and disciplined code review.

We are currently seeking a Security Center Operations Sr. Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN). Application Security AnalystJob SummaryThe Application Security Analyst is responsible for supporting the organization's Application Security Program by identifying, assessing, tracking, and coordinating remediation of security vulnerabilities and technical issues within applications, APIs, and supporting platforms. The role works closely with development teams, OEM vendors, security teams, and operational stakeholders to ensure applications comply with organizational security requirements and industry best practices.The analyst will coordinate with OEM vendors to resolve security-related bugs, software defects, and technical issues, enforce security policies defined by the Account Security Team, and generate security and operational reports to support governance, risk management, and compliance activities.Key ResponsibilitiesApplication Security Assessment RemediationReview application security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, and penetration testing activities. Track application security vulnerabilities through the remediation lifecycle until closure. Coordinate with development, infrastructure, cloud, and application support teams to implement remediation recommendations. Validate remediation activities and perform retesting where applicable. Support secure application deployment and release processes. OEM Vendor CoordinationCoordinate with OEM vendors and third-party software providers to resolve security vulnerabilities, software bugs, patching issues, and technical defects affecting business applications. Review vendor security advisories and assess application impact. Track vendor remediation timelines and escalate critical security issues when necessary. Participate in technical discussions with OEM support teams regarding application security concerns. Ensure vendor-provided fixes are properly tested and implemented. Security Policy EnforcementEnforce application security policies, standards, and secure coding requirements as requested by the Account Security Team. Support implementation of security controls throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Verify compliance with secure coding standards such as OWASP Top 10, CWE, and organizational security baselines. Monitor application compliance with established security requirements. Support risk exception and remediation governance processes. Security Testing ValidationSupport and coordinate: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) Software Composition Analysis (SCA) API Security Assessments Penetration Testing activities Analyze findings and prioritize remediation activities based on risk and business impact. Review security testing results and provide remediation guidance to development teams. Reporting Metrics Generate security and operational reports mutually agreed with the Account Security Team. Produce dashboards and metrics related to: Open application vulnerabilities Critical and high-risk findings Remediation SLA compliance Application security testing coverage Secure SDLC compliance Present application security posture and remediation status to stakeholders and management. Security Governance Compliance Support compliance initiatives involving: OWASP ASVS OWASP Top 10 PCI DSS NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) ISO 27001 SOC Controls Assist with internal and external audits related to application security. Maintain application security documentation, risk registers, and remediation tracking records. Continuous ImprovementIdentify opportunities to improve application security processes and controls. Recommend enhancements to security testing methodologies and tooling. Assist in integrating security requirements into DevSecOps pipelines. Support Application Security Program maturity initiatives. Contribute to development of secure coding awareness and training materials. Required QualificationsEducationBachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field. Equivalent professional experience may be considered. ExperienceMid-Level Analyst3–5 years of experience in Application Security, Security Operations, Software Development, Vulnerability Management, or related cybersecurity functions. Senior Analyst5–8 years of experience supporting enterprise application security programs. Technical SkillsApplication Security ToolsExperience with one or more: SASTCheckmarx Fortify Veracode SonarQube DASTBurp Suite OWASP ZAP Acunetix SCASnyk Black Duck Mend (WhiteSource) API SecurityPostman Security Testing Burp Suite API Testing Salt Security Security KnowledgeOWASP Top 10 CWE/SANS Top 25 Secure SDLC DevSecOps Threat Modeling Secure Coding Practices PlatformsWeb Applications APIs Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure) Containers and Kubernetes CI/CD Pipelines Preferred CertificationsCompTIA Security+ CSSLP GWAPT GWEB CEH CISSP Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) AWS Security Specialty Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP) Desired CompetenciesStrong application security assessment skills Ability to work effectively with development teams Vendor management and coordination experience Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills Strong reporting and documentation capabilities Risk-based decision-making and prioritization Analytical problem-solving mindset Sample Day-to-Day ActivitiesReview application security scan findings. Coordinate remediation with development teams and OEM vendors. Validate security fixes and perform retesting. Track remediation SLA compliance. Enforce application security standards and policies. Generate weekly and monthly application security reports. Participate in vulnerability review meetings. Support secure SDLC and DevSecOps initiatives. Assist with audit and compliance activities. Interview Questions for This Role Application Security What is the difference between SAST, DAST, and SCA? How would you prioritize application security vulnerabilities? Explain the OWASP Top 10 and its importance. OEM Coordination Describe a situation where you worked with a vendor to resolve a security issue. How would you handle a critical vulnerability when a vendor patch is unavailable? Security Governance How do you enforce secure coding policies across development teams? What would you do if an application owner refuses to remediate a critical vulnerability? Technical How do you validate that a security finding has been fixed? What are common API security risks? How would you secure a CI/CD pipeline? Reporting Metrics What application security KPIs would you track? How would you present application security risk to leadership? This JD aligns well with an Application Security Analyst (L2–L3) role responsible for coordinating remediation activities, managing OEM engagements, enforcing application security policies, supporting secure SDLC practices, and providing governance reporting within an enterprise security environment. jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description: Overview: Analyst, Cockpit Reporting & AI-Enabled Solutions. Digital Planning Transformation | Global Finance Cockpit Team Why this role exists. Cockpit is the single reporting platform behind the organization's financial planning: 7,000+ users, 175,000+ views every month, with all Operating Units converging onto one standard. The dashboards are largely built. What we're building now is different. We want reporting that maintains itself: dashboards that validate their own numbers, documentation that writes itself, insights that reach people without someone spending a Tuesday assembling them by hand. That's where we intend to be in two years. We are not there yet, and we're hiring the person who helps us get there. Generative AI is already part of how this team works. It isn't a pilot or a side project. But we care far more about someone who can tell when a model is confidently wrong than someone who has collected prompting tricks. What you'll actually do. Build reporting people rely on (the core of the job)Sit with Operating Units and Finance teams to understand what they actually need, which is usually not what they first asked for. Build financial performance dashboards with real drill-down, following our standard frameworks Improve what already exists: faster, clearer, more consistent Watch how people really consume the data, from analysts to senior leaders, and redesign around what you see. Apply our data security and FP&A reporting standards. We'll teach you these, and you'll follow them carefully Make the work smarter (this part grows as you do)Use AI in daily delivery: drafting documentation, writing and debugging calculations and SQL, accelerating requirements analysis Build and refine prompts for the things we do repeatedly (validation, documentation, quality checks) and improve them based on whether the output actually got better Catch AI's mistakes before a business user does: invented logic, results that don't reconcile, errors that fail silently Find the manual, repetitive parts of our reporting cycle and propose how to automate them Grow into shaping our AI validation and quality frameworks alongside the teamwork with people. Partner with S&T so business requirements survive the translation into Cockpit Help train and support Cockpit usersTake on high-priority projects as they come upWhat we need from you Genuinely required0 to 2 years of experience in analytics, reporting, data or engineering. Internships, academic work and personal projects all count. Hands-on with at least one BI or data tool. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, or a data-engineering background built on SQL, Python and pipelines. We don't need a Tableau expert. We build them. Most people here are productive in Tableau within a few months. What we need is someone who has already built something real with data and can walk us through the decisions they made and why. You use generative AI for real work, not just chat. Show us one concrete thing you built, automated or solved faster because of it.Basic SQL. You can read a query, understand a join, and trace where a number came from. You check whether a number makes sense before you publish it. This matters more than any tool on this list. Decent English, written and spoken. Comfort with things being unfinished. Our tooling changes every few months. That's the job, not a defect in it.Helpful, but not expected Python, Databricks, or any cloud data platform APIs, automation tools, or anything you've built with AI beyond a chat window. Finance or FP&A background, or familiarity with P&L and performance reporting. Data modeling fundamentals (grain, joins, single source of truth)Not requiredTableau certification. Prior finance work experience. Having done this exact job before. If you're strong on judgment and genuinely fluent with AI, apply. We'll teach you the rest. What you'll be in 18 months. You'll understand how a global company actually plans and measures itself, and you'll have built reporting that thousands of people use to make real decisions. You'll be fluent in Tableau, working well past dashboard-building, and helping define how an AI-enabled reporting function operates. Very few people anywhere have done that yet. This role sits where finance, data and AI meet, and that intersection is where the interesting careers are being built right now. How we'll assess you1. A dashboard you build on your own time. We'll send you a dataset and a short brief. Build something you'd be comfortable putting in front of a finance team. Use whatever tool you're strongest in: Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Python, or something else. We are not testing which software you know.2. A conversation about what you built. You'll walk us through your reasoning: the design choices, what the data let you say and what it didn't, and where you weren't sure. Then we'll ask you to make a couple of changes to it live, with us. That's not a trap. It's the closest thing to how this job actually feels when a stakeholder changes their mind mid-review.3. A conversation about AI on real work. How you use it day to day, and how you decide whether to trust what it hands you. Using AI on the exercise is fine and expected. Just be ready to explain what you used it for and how you verified it. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Tableau dashboards, reports, and scorecards. Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into BI solutions. Write complex SQL queries and scripts to extract, transform, and validate data. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and business insights. Optimize Tableau workbooks and SQL queries for performance and scalability. Develop and maintain data models, data sources, and metadata documentation. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions. Work closely with business teams, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting requirements. Automate recurring reporting processes and improve operational efficiency. Troubleshoot data discrepancies and resolve dashboard-related issues. Participate in testing, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in Tableau dashboard development and SQL programming. Strong expertise in Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server/Cloud, and Tableau Prep. Advanced SQL skills with experience in writing complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning. Experience working with large datasets and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar. Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and data modeling. Experience gathering business requirements and working directly with stakeholders. Knowledge of KPI development, data visualization best practices, and dashboard design principles. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments. Exposure to FP&A, Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, or Operations reporting domains.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex business problems into technical AI solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams. Ability to lead and mentor a team, fostering a positive and innovative work environment. jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. About the Team: The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems. Key Responsibilities: Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack. Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture. Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes. Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization. Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies. Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling. Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware. Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance. Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements. Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms. Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements. Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust. Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior. Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools. Preferred Qualifications: Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8. Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent. Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms. Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling. Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions. Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects. Why Join This Team? This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span: Agentic AI & LLMs AI frameworks inference runtimes Linux server architecture silicon You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers. The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms. Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India) Primary Location: India, Bangalore Additional Locations: Posting Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.description: Function: AI Engineering / Applied AI Delivery About the Role We're hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production AI systems — not prototypes, not notebooks. This is a builder's role: you'll own the path from "we think an LLM/agent could solve this" to a system running reliably in production, under real load, with real failure modes. We are being deliberately selective here. This role is not for someone who has "used ChatGPT a lot" or built a weekend RAG demo. We want people who have shipped agentic or LLM-powered systems that other engineers depend on, who understand why those systems break, and who can hold their own in a room full of skeptical senior engineers. If that's not you yet, this probably isn't the right role yet either — and that's fine. Requirements What You'll Own Design and build production-grade AI/agentic systems — from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and iteration — not just model calls wrapped in a script Own the full lifecycle of at least one non-trivial AI capability: problem framing, evaluation strategy, prompt/context engineering, orchestration, deployment, and post-launch tuning Build deterministic guardrails around probabilistic components — retries, validation, fallback paths, human-in-the-loop checkpoints where confidence is low Design evaluation harnesses and offline/online eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not vanity metrics Make real architectural tradeoffs on latency, cost, and reliability — token economics is a design constraint you think about upfront, not an afterthought Integrate AI systems into existing production infrastructure (APIs, data pipelines, orchestration layers) without breaking what already works Push back on bad ideas — including ours — with technical reasoning, not opinions Who You Are 4+ years of strong software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years hands-on building and shipping LLM/agentic systems in production (not just experimentation) Fluent in Python and/or TypeScript, with the engineering discipline to write systems that survive contact with real users Real, hands-on depth with modern AI tooling — LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, or equivalent), vector stores/RAG pipelines, and prompt/context engineering — and a clear, opinionated point of view on where each of these breaks down Strong grasp of evaluation methodology — you know the difference between a model that looks good in a demo and one that's actually reliable Comfortable with orchestration and systems fundamentals: APIs, event-driven design, queuing, observability, CI/CD Able to reason clearly about cost, latency, and failure modes at design time, not just after something breaks in production Sharp communicator — can explain a technical tradeoff to both an engineer and a non-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down or overcomplicating it Genuinely curious and self-directed About Position: We are seeking an experienced SailPoint Lead to drive the design, implementation, and delivery of enterprise identity governance solutions using SailPoint IdentityIQ and IdentityNow. This role is responsible for translating business and security requirements into scalable identity governance architectures, leading technical delivery teams, and ensuring successful implementation of identity lifecycle management, access governance, provisioning, and compliance initiatives. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership while partnering with security, application, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to deliver robust identity governance solutions. Role: SailPoint Lead Location: Pune Experience: Between 12 to 15 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment What You'll Do: Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of SailPoint IdentityIQ and IdentityNow solutions across enterprise environments. Define solution strategies for identity lifecycle management, provisioning, access requests, role management, certifications, and access governance. Translate business, security, audit, and compliance requirements into scalable identity governance architectures and implementation roadmaps. Lead application onboarding initiatives and define connector, integration, and provisioning strategies for enterprise applications. Design and oversee implementation of Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes, access certifications, role-based access controls (RBAC), and segregation of duties controls. Review and approve workflows, rules, forms, customizations, provisioning configurations, and integration designs. Lead code reviews, technical assessments, release planning, deployment reviews, and quality assurance activities. Guide troubleshooting and resolution of complex workflow, reconciliation, provisioning, performance, and data-quality issues. Establish development standards, governance frameworks, reusable assets, and implementation best practices. Collaborate with enterprise architects, security teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to align IAM initiatives with organizational objectives. Support audit, compliance, governance, and risk management activities through robust identity controls and reporting. Drive continuous improvement, platform optimization, and innovation across SailPoint implementations. Mentor developers, engineers, and project teams while providing technical leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle. Expertise You'll Bring: 12-15 years of experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Cybersecurity, or Enterprise Security Engineering. Deep hands-on expertise with SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and/or SailPoint IdentityNow implementations in large enterprise environments. Proven experience leading complex IGA transformation programs and enterprise identity governance initiatives. Strong expertise in identity lifecycle management, provisioning, reconciliation, role management, access requests, certifications, and governance processes. Extensive experience with Java, BeanShell, REST APIs, Web Services, XML, SQL, LDAP, and enterprise application integrations. Strong understanding of Identity Governance concepts including RBAC, ABAC, JML processes, access reviews, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements. Experience integrating SailPoint with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, SAP, Oracle, Workday, ServiceNow, cloud platforms, and custom applications. Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and federation technologies. Proven experience designing scalable connector strategies, onboarding frameworks, and enterprise provisioning models. Strong experience leading solution architecture reviews, technical governance, project planning, and delivery management activities. Understanding of regulatory and security frameworks including SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and access governance requirements. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, documentation, presentation, and leadership abilities. Experience leading distributed engineering teams and mentoring SailPoint developers and IAM engineers. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline. SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, SailPoint IdentityNow Engineer, CISSP, CISM, or other IAM-related certifications are highly desirable. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Senior Staff Frontend Engineer, Admin Experience Zendesk is transforming the way businesses build meaningful customer relationships. Our products help organizations deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences at scale, and our Admin Experience is central to how customers configure, manage, and get value from the Zendesk platform. We are looking for a Senior Staff Frontend Engineer to help bring Zendesk’s Admin Experience vision to life for an AI-first future. This is a high-impact technical leadership role for someone who combines deep frontend expertise with product thinking, system design, and strong cross-functional leadership. In this role, you will strengthen and operationalize our vision by translating high-level concepts into technically sound, scalable, and actionable frontend strategies. You will work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to reimagine complex user journeys and deliver intuitive, intelligent, and cohesive experiences for Zendesk admins. What You’ll Do Translate the Admin Experience vision into a clear end-to-end strategy focused on the frontend, architecture, roadmap, and execution plan. Lead major initiatives across teams and product areas while remaining hands-on with writing code. Partner with Product and Design to deliver intuitive, scalable, and cohesive experiences for Zendesk admins. Establish reusable frontend patterns, components, and platform capabilities that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs while balancing near-term priorities with long-term maintainability. Advance performance, accessibility, reliability, testing, observability, and developer experience. Build and maintain scalable, unified CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker) for Admin Experience and Agent Workspace to improve delivery speed and reliability. Drive developer productivity by optimizing build systems, testing infrastructure (PlayWright), and local development tooling. Mentor engineers and raise the engineering bar through technical guidance, design reviews, and 1-1 coaching. What You Bring to the Role 15+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in frontend product development. Proven success delivering complex, enterprise-scale UI initiatives. Strong proficiency in Javascript or TypeScript, React, modern web standards, GraphQL, API integration, and frontend architecture. Deep knowledge of frontend best practices, including accessibility, performance, testing, and reliability. Ability to translate ambiguous product goals into pragmatic execution plans. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives from discovery through to delivery Ability to influence without direct authority, align teams, and communicate effectively with senior leaders. Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams. Nice to Have Experience leading major transformations or redesigns of existing user experiences, particularly to make them AI-first. Experience building enterprise SaaS products, configuration tools, or complex operational experiences. Familiarity with AI interaction patterns, including agents, recommendations, automation, conversational interfaces, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based. Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager. The intelligent heart of customer experience Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love. Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses. AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries. Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS. Key job responsibilities Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales A day in the life As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree or equivalent Experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent 10+ years of experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience working with or having knowledge of cloud computing and existing cloud technologies Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning Experience in making data driven business decisions Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
