Amazon Hyderabad WFO : 10544247 job id : Level 6 Hiring Individual Contributor : Senior Risk Manager, Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE) JOB LINK to apply: https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/10544247 Hi Candidate , If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career interests, I would encourage you to review the role and apply through the Amazon Jobs posting . Before moving forward, could you please share brief responses to the below screening questions? JOB LINK to apply: https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/10544247 Designation: Senior Risk Manager - Inspection, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience Team: Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE), Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership Location: Hyderabad, India (Work from Office) Level: L6 Job Type: Full Time, Regular OVERVIEW Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership. This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazons risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes, with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable (AR) and Payroll. You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with senior stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions. This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction. KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits, inspections, and risk assessments across Finance Operations, with particular focus on Accounts Receivable and Payroll. Conduct end to end assessments spanning process design, policy, organization structure, systems, technology, regulatory requirements, and internal controls. Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identify control gaps, and quantify the potential impact of identified risks. Identify emerging and material risks across Finance Operations and develop data driven recommendations to mitigate them. Own the full lifecycle of high impact, cross functional risk and governance programs from problem definition through implementation, measurement, and closure. Define program objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics, and establish mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of remediation. Partner with Finance, Controllership, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Internal Audit to prioritize risks and drive sustainable remediation. Influence senior stakeholders to adopt scalable, automated, and sustainable controls rather than manual or recurring interventions. Evaluate policy and process exceptions, determine the associated risk, and recommend appropriate mitigation. Perform deep dives into complex processes and data to identify root causes, systemic risks, control weaknesses, and process improvement opportunities. Produce clear, data driven audit reports, risk assessments, executive narratives, and recommendations for senior leadership. Support external regulatory, statutory, and internal audit requests, including evidence gathering, issue resolution, and remediation tracking. Build and deliver training and awareness programs that raise the bar on controllership, risk management, policy adherence, and control ownership across Finance Operations. Leverage data analytics, automation, and technology to improve risk identification, continuous monitoring, audit efficiency, and control effectiveness. Establish mechanisms that prevent recurring risks and embed remediation into business processes and operating routines. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. You will own the questions that matter most to the health of Finance Operations. 2. Where are the material risks within complex Finance Operations processes? 3. Are existing controls appropriately designed to mitigate those risks, and are they operating effectively in practice? 4. What breaks when a process spans multiple systems, teams, or geographies? 5. Are recurring issues being resolved at the root cause, or simply remediated repeatedly? 6. How can technology, automation, and data detect and prevent risks earlier? 7. What mechanisms can make risk management scalable as Finance Operations grows? 8. You will turn these questions into actionable insights, sustainable mechanisms, and measurable risk reduction. A DAY IN THE LIFE A typical day might start with leading a risk assessment of a complex Accounts Receivable or Payroll process, analyzing operational and financial data to identify control weaknesses, reviewing findings with process owners, and working with Technology and Finance teams to design an automated control. You may also prepare an executive level risk narrative, challenge a remediation plan, review policy exceptions, facilitate a cross functional risk review, or support a statutory auditor request. The role moves fluidly between deep process analysis and senior level stakeholder influence. Some days will be highly analytical, while others will require aligning multiple teams on a risk response and executing against it. ABOUT THE TEAM The Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team strengthens the risk, governance, control, and operational mechanisms that enable Finance Operations to scale. FORGE partners across Finance Operations and the broader Amazon organization to identify risks, strengthen controls, improve governance, and drive sustainable process transformation. We combine risk expertise, operational understanding, data, technology, and durable mechanisms to build a Finance Operations environment that is resilient, scalable, and ready for the future. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Risk Management, or a related field. 10 or more years of experience in risk management, internal audit, controllership, finance operations, compliance, or a related field. Experience leading complex audits, risk assessments, control assessments, or large scale process improvement programs. Experience with Accounts Receivable, Order to Cash, O2C, OTC, Payroll, Hire to Retire, H2R, Finance Operations, or Controllership processes. Experience identifying control gaps, assessing risk, developing recommendations, and driving remediation. Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to work across complex data and processes. Experience influencing cross functional stakeholders and operating effectively in a matrixed environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Masters degree, MBA, or a professional certification such as CA, CPA, CMA, CIA, or CISA. Experience with global Finance Operations or multinational organizations. Experience with finance, process, or controllership transformation initiatives. Experience designing or implementing automated and technology enabled controls. Experience applying data analytics, automation, or continuous monitoring techniques to risk identification and audit. Experience supporting regulatory, statutory, or external audit engagements. Strong track record creating executive level presentations, risk narratives, and data driven recommendations. Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments. Experience leading large, cross functional programs from strategy through execution. Knowledge of financial systems, ERP environments, and integration between finance and operational systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex risk clearly to senior leadership. AMAZON LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES The successful candidate will demonstrate strength across Amazons Leadership Principles, particularly Ownership, Dive Deep, Deliver Results, Earn Trust, Invent and Simplify, Think Big, Have Backbone, Disagree and Commit, and Customer Obsession. This role is ideal for a risk professional who can dive deep into complex problems, challenge existing mechanisms, influence without authority, and turn risk insights into scalable business solutions. Key job responsibilities Successful candidates should have strong audit and risk management capabilities, excellent problem solving skills, and a deep understanding of Finance Operations processes, systems, and controls. 1. jobs.description:

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered from desktop to doorstep. Across the globe we have more than thousand Fulfillment Centers, thousands of Delivery Stations, tens of thousands of machines, and hundreds of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world. Join us in the Amazon Maintenance Operation centre team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network. Purpose of job We are seeking a seasoned Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join our current team and support one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, coupled with good HVAC understanding. The successful candidate will spearhead efforts to maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences. Key job responsibilities • Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics of the BMS. • Monitor and maintain ticket/work order processes and queues while ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar. • Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings. • Design, implement and manage BMS Standard Operating Procedures, Policies and Processes which are scalable across the globe. • Support the development and execute a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services. • Collaborate closely with WWRE, D&C, Sustainability, RME and other stakeholders to comprehend customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs. • Uphold compliance with the change management processes. • Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach. • Provides strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies. • Take ownership of BMS initiatives, documenting white papers, managing timelines and stakeholders. • Lead training sessions and development programs for internal teams and individuals to continuously enhance the capability, technical skills of field RME teams, and BMS Specialists. • Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team. • Willing to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support, ensuring global customers receive timely and reliable assistance. Basic qualifications Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent, or 5+ years of professional or military experience Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS devices and communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, SNMP). Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization. Preferred qualifications Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems such as Tridium Niagara Experience in BMS programming and commissioning, with a minimum of 3 years in building controls and HVAC or related field.

jobs.description:
Experience range: 5-10 Yrs
Job Summary We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Lead / Staff Software Engineer to join our growing team in AI (Artificial Intelligence) group. In this role, the individual will be responsible for developing AI/ML specific C/C++ kernels and dataflow schedules for AMD Ryzen Processors built on XDNA Neural Processor Units (NPU) to map LLMs, Stable Diffusion networks on NPU. As a C++ Kernel Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing, optimizing, and implementing machine learning kernels specifically tailored for vector processors. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, speed, and accuracy of our machine learning models. Key Responsibilities Kernel Development: Design and implement highly optimized C++ kernel library for NPU/GPU. Collaborate with the research and software teams to integrate these kernels into the existing software stack. Vector Processor Optimization: Work closely with hardware engineers to understand the architecture of VLIW vector core units such as MAC, GeMM, and non-linear functions. Develop vectorized code that leverages SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) and ILP (instruction level parallelism) for maximum performance. Performance Profiling and Tuning: Profile and analyze the performance of existing kernels. Identify bottlenecks and optimize critical sections for better throughput. Testing and Validation: Develop CPU models for the ML operators in C++/ Python to validate accuracy. Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure correctness and reliability. Validate kernel performance across different hardware platforms. Documentation and Collaboration: Document design specs for new kernels and the performance improvements. Follow coding guidelines, use tools like git to maintain code and create pull-requests, and documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including machine learning researchers and software engineers. Preferred Experience Excellent C/C++ and Python coding skills Good understanding of SIMD/Tensor/VLIW processor architecture to exploit parallelism. Experience with vectorized programming (SIMD) and parallel computing. Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus. Experience with silicon bring-up and pre-silicon validation on Emulation platforms is a plus. Knowledge of low-level hardware details (cache hierarchy, memory access patterns) is desirable. Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for performance optimization. Academic Credentials BS/Masters/PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with around 10/8/5 year experience. We believe in creating a workplace where you not only excel professionally but also thrive personally. Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable them to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world. In one sentence We are looking for an experienced L2 Production Support Engineer specializing in Order Management / OSS/BSS to manage complex production issues, troubleshoot order-management workflows and integrations, perform root cause analysis, and improve system reliability and operational efficiency. The candidate will work closely with L1 support, development, infrastructure, database, integration, security, and business teams to resolve incidents within SLA and implement permanent corrective actions. What will your job look like? Provide L2 production support for Order Management and associated OSS/BSS components. Troubleshoot complex order failures, stuck orders, orchestration/provisioning failures, and integration errors. Analyze the complete order lifecycle and identify failure points across upstream/downstream systems. Troubleshoot Order Management integrations with CRM, Product/Order Catalog, Provisioning, Billing, Inventory, Mediation, and other OSS/BSS platforms. Analyze application logs, database records, middleware/API transactions, and system events. Investigate message/API failures, timeouts, queue backlogs, and integration issues. Perform SQL-based data analysis and corrective actions where appropriate. Troubleshoot application services in Linux/Unix environments. Analyze performance, resource utilization, connectivity, and application errors. Perform RCA for recurring incidents and production failures; implement permanent fixes and preventive measures. Support deployments, upgrades, patches, configuration changes, and post-deployment validation. Collaborate with development teams to identify defects and provide technical evidence. Work with infrastructure/network/security teams on OS, network, firewall, SSL/TLS, DNS, and connectivity issues. Automate operational and troubleshooting activities using Shell/Python or other scripting languages. Develop and maintain operational scripts, monitoring checks, and health-check utilities. Support monitoring and alerting improvements for Hansen Order Management. Participate in Problem, Change, and Major Incident Management. Support capacity planning, availability improvements, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery. Review L1 escalations and improve SOPs/runbooks to reduce recurring incidents. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to L1 support engineers. Participate in 24x7 support/on-call rotation as required. Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience with Hansen Order Management / Hansen OSS/BSS. Enhanced team productivity and engagement. Decision-making and people development. Strong understanding of telecom OSS/BSS architecture and Order Management workflows. Good understanding of order capture/validation, decomposition, orchestration, fulfillment, lifecycle/status management, provisioning, product/catalog integration, and customer/order management. Strong troubleshooting experience across integrated OSS/BSS platforms. Strong Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting skills. Good SQL/database troubleshooting skills. Complex troubleshooting, RCA, permanent fixes, and reliability improvement. Investigate complex issues, including P1/P2 incidents and recurring failures. Strong Shell/Python scripting skills. Analyze the complete order lifecycle and identify cross-system failure points. Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, XML, JSON, web services, and middleware. Hands-on experience with application logs and monitoring tools such as ELK, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Prometheus. Understanding of Docker/Podman and containerized environments is preferred. Good knowledge of CI/CD concepts/tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Strong understanding of DNS, load balancers, firewalls, TCP/IP, and SSL/TLS. Knowledge of security practices and vulnerability management. Understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Management. All you need is... Experience & Leadership Strong experience supporting OSS/BSS and telecom applications. Hands-on experience with Hansen Order Management is strongly preferred. Experience in complex, high-availability production environments. Experience handling P1/P2 incidents and working within defined SLAs. Experience performing RCA and implementing permanent fixes. Experience working in 24x7 production support/on-call environments. Leadership & Ownership: Takes end-to-end ownership and drives the team toward defined goals. Team Management: Guides, motivates, and supports team members while ensuring effective workload distribution. Technical/Functional Expertise: Provides hands-on guidance and supports troubleshooting and decision-making. Stakeholder Management: Coordinates effectively across business, development, operations, and other dependent teams. Key Competencies Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to investigate complex cross-system issues independently. Strong ownership of production incidents and problems. Ability to work under pressure during major incidents. Strong collaboration with development, infrastructure, database, network, security, and business teams. Good technical documentation and communication skills. Ability to mentor L1 engineers and drive continuous operational improvements. Open to working in a 24x7 environment, including rotational and night shifts. Mandatory Work from Office for 3 days per week from the base location. Link to apply: https://jobs.amdocs.com/careers/job/563431015137141 Why you will love this job: The chance to serve as a specialist in software and technology. You will take an active role in technical mentoring within the team. We provide stellar benefits from health to dental to paid time off and parental leave! Amdocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce

In this role, you will help define the future of software and application development. You will shape how developers interact with our platform—from programming models and user experiences to the design of a managed, distributed runtime that orchestrates agent-based AI applications at scale with enterprise-grade guarantees. You’ll work at the cutting edge of AI research, collaborating with some of the brightest minds in generative AI, and integrating the latest breakthroughs in multi-modal capabilities (text, audio, video) into real-world agentic applications. At Microsoft, our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We live this mission every day through a culture that embraces a growth mindset, values diverse perspectives, and encourages continuous learning. We believe in creating an environment where individuals bring their best selves to work, collaborate openly, and build technology that makes a meaningful impact. Join us and help shape the future of the world. Responsibilities Responsibilities Creates and implements code for a product, service, or feature, reusing code as applicable. Provides feedback for proposals for architecture, with technical leadership from others. Tests and explores various design options for a product/solution feature, outlining strengths and weaknesses of each option. Contributes to the development of design documents that support user stories and other product requirements with oversight. Contributes to the refinement of product features by escalating findings from analyses to inform decisions regarding the engineering of products. Build Foundational Capabilities: Contribute to and lead the development of core platform components and reusable building blocks that accelerate team velocity and product innovation. Champion Customer-Centric Development: Engage directly with customers and product teams to capture feedback, understand demand signals, and refine product messaging—ensuring the voice of the customer shapes product evolution. Lead Live Site Excellence: Drive operational excellence in managing and operating large-scale distributed systems with a high bar for service-level agreements (SLAs). Experience engaging with customers during integration or deployment phases, with a focus on delivering value and incorporating feedback into product evolution. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description Overview The AI Application Software Engineer designs, builds, ships, and operates applications whose core behavior is model-driven rather than explicitly authored — conversational and agentic experiences that interpret user intent, reason over context, invoke tools, and act on the user's behalf. In Field Service Management, this means building AI-native experiences for scheduling, dispatch, and service workflows that automate routine work, escalate exceptions, and improve customer outcomes. This is a hands-on, forward deployed role for a senior engineer whose first instinct is AI — someone who can shape ambiguous customer problems into precise specifications, author the instructions and prompts that govern agent behavior, build the application and integrations around them, and prove through automated evaluation that the result behaves correctly. This is not a machine learning or AI research role; you will not train foundation models. You own what ships, whether a human or an agent produced it. What You Get to Do Build AI-native applications. Design and ship applications built around agentic behavior across Field Service Management — scheduling, dispatch, and workflows that reason over context, automate routine work, and escalate exceptions. Work AI-first in delivery. Direct coding agents to build, refactor, and test; use AI to think more sharply in front of customers; and apply it as part of everyday engineering practice rather than as a side tool. Deliver forward deployed. Work embedded in customer environments, tuning instructions and evaluation sets on the ground, using AI to compress turnaround without cutting quality. Author and maintain agentic instructions. Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation rules that govern agent behavior — treating them as reviewed, regression-covered engineering artifacts. Build automated evaluation and test non-deterministic behavior. Design and operate golden datasets, multi-turn conversation suites, model-as-judge scoring, CI gates, drift detection, adversarial testing, and grounding checks that make change safe. Design conversational experiences. Build experiences that hold context, confirm before consequential actions, and hand off cleanly to humans. Collaborate across product, UX, and documentation. Bring the AI-first instinct into cross-functional partnerships, not just your own code. Own quality and safety in production. Monitor containment, hallucination, prompt injection, and data leakage, then feed failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Qualifications Experience A demonstrated track record of building, shipping, and operating production software, including hands-on delivery of AI-native application features that real users depend on rather than demos. Direct experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing AI-driven workflows, and building evaluation and testing for non-deterministic behavior is required. Experience with chat experiences is required; voice or multi-channel experience is strongly preferred. Willingness to work directly with customers in a forward deployed capacity is required; prior forward deployed experience is an advantage. Education Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience. Key competencies Software engineering fundamentals. Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing. Good to have technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Java. AI-native application development. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration at the application layer, tool and function calling, context assembly, grounding against enterprise data, and handling latency, cost, and failure. Agentic instruction and prompt engineering. Demonstrated skill with instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, structured outputs, grounding, citation, graceful failure, and disciplined iteration against measured outcomes. Specification precision. Ability to define a problem rigorously enough that another engineer or an AI agent implements it correctly, and to judge when to solve it in code, in instructions, or by delegating. Customer-facing delivery with AI-native speed. Comfort working directly with customers under real constraints, using AI to cut turnaround, and communicating capability and risk credibly to non-engineers. AI safety and data handling. Working knowledge of prompt injection, data leakage, over-broad tool access, and unsafe autonomous action, translated into concrete guardrails and least-privilege controls. Desired experience Forward deployed or customer-embedded delivery. Prior work as a forward deployed engineer, solution engineer, or in professional services, delivering software inside a customer's environment. A platform-level view. Experience with agent runtimes, context engineering, retrieval, and memory. Domain depth. Experience in Field Service Management, scheduling, or workforce management is valued but not required; the right engineer can learn the domain. Evaluation and observability tooling. Experience with evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for LLM applications, and analysis of production transcripts at scale. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations. Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents. Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence. Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations. Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations. Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. You will: Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses : tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients , and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. Integrate and serve LLMs , both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store. Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area. Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps : deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). Experience implementing AI guardrails , red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. #LI-PG1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust . Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama.cpp, and ONNX Runtime ; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. Own the full delivery path : CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. Bonus Points Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama.cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings , and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. #LI-VB1

jobs.description: LNT/RE-/1909389 WET-Water & Effluent Treatment IC Kancheepuram Posted On 31 Oct 2026 End Date 29 Apr 2027 Required Experience8 - 10 years Skills Knowledge & Posting Location PLC SCADA Simulation and modeling Minimum Qualification Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) Job Description Job Purpose We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Modeling and Simulation Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will lead efforts in developing and applying models to enhance water treatment processes, biological processes, and desalination techniques. This role requires a deep understanding of simulation methods and an ability to contribute to the improvement of environmental processes. The candidate will leverage advanced modeling tools to drive innovation and solve complex process and water-related challenges, delivering significant business impact. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute modeling and simulation projects related to chemical processes, water treatment, wastewater processes namely biological treatments, anaerobic and aerobic processes, precipitation, flocculation, coagulation, and desalination. Apply advanced modeling techniques to analyze, optimize and control process and water treatment processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate models into broader operational strategies. Conduct sensitivity, uncertainty analysis, and optimization of models. Present simulation results and insights to senior management. Utilize platforms like HYSYS, ASPEN Plus, or equivalent. Location Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

jobs.description: OUR STORY At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE ABOUT THE TEAM & YOUR ROLE Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI. As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place. Responsibilities: End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment. Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing). LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management. Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams. Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production Required Background & Skills: AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints. Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub. Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable. Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch). Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.title: Senior Architect - Data Science
jobs.description: Skill: Senior Architect - Data Science Exp: 9 to 13 years Location : Hyderabad Shift: Flexible to work in Shifts The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results. At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models. Responsibilities Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams. Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes. Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns. Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end-to-end architecture. Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse. Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable. Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale. Delivery and Consulting Excellence Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies. Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact. Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives. Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest. Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity. Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery. Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones. Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback. Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language. Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required. Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting. Mentorship and Team Development Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams. Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified. Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects. Growth and Innovation Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them. Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value. Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions. Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction. Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams. Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way. Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. Requirements 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain. 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts. 8-10 years in data science, machine learning, and Azure cloud technologies. Deep expertise across most of the following: Machine Learning Systems & MLOps – designing model pipelines, retraining workflows, and model monitoring using Azure ML, Databricks MLflow, or equivalent frameworks. Data Engineering & Integration – building data pipelines with Spark, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or Fabric; applying governance, lineage, and quality controls. Feature Engineering & Model Development – applying supervised and unsupervised learning, time series, and advanced modeling techniques using Python and Spark. Model Deployment & Operations – integrating ML models into production systems with APIs, containers, and DevOps practices. Data Architecture & Storage – implementing scalable solutions using Azure Data Lake, Delta Lake, and Blob Storage. Responsible AI & Compliance – applying fairness, interpretability, and privacy best practices within ML lifecycle governance. Analytics & Visualization – developing insights through Power BI or similar tools. Familiarity with generative and agentic AI concepts (Prompt Flow, RAG, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI) is a plus. Proficiency with modern development tools such as GitHub, Copilot, and CI/CD systems. Familiarity with data governance and metadata management practices. Relevant Azure or Databricks certifications in AI, Data, or Architecture. Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs. Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and solid delivery practices. Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones. Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale. Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services. Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and dependency handling. Experience in consulting or professional services. Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data, security, networking, and integration. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication. Demonstrated interest in learning new cloud technologies and turning that learning into practical improvements for teams. Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex cloud solutions across teams.

jobs.title: VLSI - DFT Architect
jobs.description: Your Role Lead DFT execution across IP and SoC programs from architecture to silicon production. Define and implement Scan, Scan Compression (EDT), ATPG, MBIST, JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), IEEE 1500, and IEEE 1687 (iJTAG) solutions. Drive scan insertion, DFT integration, and sign-off using industry-standard EDA tools. Generate and optimize ATPG patterns to achieve high fault coverage and production test goals. Perform DFT DRC checks, coverage analysis, and debug scan, compression, and ATPG issues. Develop and validate STA constraints for various test modes. Support silicon bring-up, failure diagnosis, yield improvement, and production ramp activities. Collaborate with RTL, Verification, Physical Design, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to resolve test-related challenges. Develop automation solutions using TCL, Perl, Python, and Shell scripting to improve productivity and quality. Mentor junior engineers, drive technical excellence, and contribute to DFT methodology improvements across programs. Your Profile 15 to 20+ years of hands-on experience in Design-for-Test (DFT) for ASIC and SoC development. Proven experience leading end-to-end DFT implementation for multiple successful SoC tape-outs. Strong expertise in Scan Insertion, Scan Compression (EDT), ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), IEEE 1500, and IEEE 1687 (iJTAG). Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX/DFTMAX, TetraMAX, Fusion Compiler, Siemens Tessent Suite, or Cadence Modus tools. Deep understanding of fault models including Stuck-at, Transition, Path Delay, Bridge Fault, and Cell-Aware ATPG methodologies. Experience in DFT verification, DRC closure, ATPG pattern validation, and fault coverage optimization. Strong knowledge of timing constraints, STA for test modes, clocking architectures, and low-power DFT methodologies. Experience supporting silicon bring-up, tester debug, diagnosis, yield improvement, and production ramp activities. Proficiency in TCL, Perl, Python, and Shell scripting for automation and methodology development. What Will You Love Working at Capgemini? Work with some of the world’s leading semiconductor and technology companies on cutting-edge ASIC, SoC, AI, Automotive, Networking, and HPC programs. Gain exposure to the complete silicon lifecycle, from architecture, design, verification, DFT, physical implementation, tape-out, silicon bring-up, and production support. Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams across North America, Europe, and Asia.Access continuous learning opportunities through Capgemini’s training, certification, and technical upskilling programs.

jobs.description: Job Description The FCC Leader role focuses on transformation through data, predictive AI, generative AI and AI agents for banking and financial services clients. The ideal candidate brings first- and second-line FCC business expertise and practical AI delivery experience, supported by strong data capabilities, compliance operations experience and third-line assurance knowledge. The role includes client leadership and FCC practice growth within Insights & Data. Key responsibilities Domain Leadership and Practice Growth: Proven expertise in FCC strategy, AI-first solutions, GTM and senior client engagement. A track record of shaping pursuits and growing banking and financial services accounts. Client Transformation and Solution Productization: Demonstrated experience modernizing FCC through predictive models, GenAI and governed agents. Experience productizing reusable solutions and data assets that improve detection, controls and operating efficiency. Thought Leadership: Established capability to develop FCC and AI perspectives, present at industry forums and demonstrate practical solutions to financial services clients. Talent Development: Proven ability to build and mentor FCC consultants, data specialists, AI engineers and data scientists across business design, data mapping, model evaluation and agent delivery. FCC business expertise across the first and second lines Proven expertise in FCC strategy, risk assessments, policies, controls and remediation, including translation of obligations and typologies into business requirements. Deep knowledge of BSA/AML, counter-terrorist financing, KYC, CDD/EDD, beneficial ownership, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting. Broader knowledge of fraud prevention, insider misconduct, trade surveillance, insider trading, and anti-bribery and corruption. Demonstrated experience with first-line customer acceptance, risk identification, controls, escalation and issue ownership; and second-line policy, advisory, oversight, monitoring, testing and effective challenge. Strong understanding of FCC operating models, decision rights and accountabilities, with clear separation of control ownership and independent oversight. FCC data knowledge and mapping Proven expertise in source-to-target and field-level mapping across customer, account, beneficial owner, payment, transaction, screening, case and surveillance data, including identifiers, joins, transformations, reference data, reconciliation and exceptions. Demonstrated ability to map obligations and typologies to controls, scenarios, data attributes and AI features, with traceability through AI outputs, human decisions and retained evidence. Strong knowledge of entity resolution, customer hierarchies, master data, lineage, ownership, business glossaries, semantic models, ontologies and knowledge graphs. Practical experience assessing training, testing and retrieval data quality, representativeness, labeling and leakage, including access, retention, privacy and residency requirements. Job Description cont'd AI strategy and practical model and agent experience Prioritize FCC AI use cases by control effectiveness, value, data readiness, feasibility, risk and adoption needs, supported by business cases and roadmaps. Demonstrable ability to select predictive ML, NLP, GenAI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), graph or agentic approaches for KYC/EDD, adverse media, sanctions, AML, fraud, surveillance and evidence-grounded SAR/STR support, with appropriate human judgment. Proven expertise in defining model inputs, outputs, features, grounding sources, evaluation datasets and acceptance criteria, with practical knowledge of prompt design, retrieval quality and FCC integration. Demonstrated experience designing agent workflows with controlled tool/API access, permissions, orchestration, human approvals, action logs, escalation and stop conditions. AI governance and control effectiveness Practical experience with AI intake, inventory, risk tiering, impact assessment and control mapping, including use case, model, system and agent cards with owners, limitations and approval evidence. Proven expertise in controls for hallucination, unsupported conclusions, bias, explainability, prompt injection, data exposure and excessive agent permissions, including human review and autonomy limits. Demonstrated ability to evaluate detection coverage, precision, recall, false negatives, groundedness, drift, agent completion and policy breaches, balancing false-positive reduction with missed risk and control quality. Experience coordinating independent review, vendor diligence, approvals, change control, incidents, rollback and retirement with Compliance, Model Risk, Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance. Compliance operations transformation Demonstrated experience redesigning onboarding, periodic and event-driven reviews, screening, triage, investigations, case management and reporting, with clear handoffs and quality controls. Proven expertise in translating operational needs into user stories, workflow rules, service levels and acceptance criteria. Practical experience with domain validation, user acceptance testing, training and adoption of FCC data and AI solutions. Demonstrated ability to improve investigation quality, turnaround, backlog aging and cost per case against baselines while maintaining control coverage and documentation. Client delivery and FCC practice growth Lead FCC discovery and solution workshops and communicate recommendations and business cases to senior stakeholders. Manage scope, plans, estimates, dependencies, risks and quality across multidisciplinary FCC, data and AI teams. Commercial experience supporting account growth, proposals, RFPs, demonstrations and engagement shaping within banking and financial services. Established capability to develop reusable FCC assets, coach teams and support adoption from solution design through implementation. Our ideal candidate: Primary skills 15+ years in banking or financial services FCC, advisory or transformation; 5+ years leading workstreams or teams. First- and second-line experience, with deep expertise in at least two FCC domains. Proven delivery of at least 2-3 FCC AI use cases through a controlled pilot or production, with responsibility for business design, model or agent evaluation, governance and measured results. Strong data analysis and source-to-target mapping skills, with working SQL knowledge. Practical knowledge of FCC operations, independent assurance, AI/model risk governance, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, law, computer science, data science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Strong consulting, stakeholder management, executive communication and team leadership skills. Preferred experience Production FCC AI delivery, Python analysis or prototyping, and cloud data/AI experience, including model monitoring, registries or governance platforms. Familiarity with NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, SAS, Quantexa or comparable platforms and their integration with customer, payments, data and case management systems. Consulting, proposal development and reusable solution experience across banking and financial services sectors or jurisdictions. CAMS, CGSS, CFE, CISA or AI governance certification; relevant advanced degree. Success measures for this role Controlled FCC AI adoption; stronger controls and operational quality; reliable data mappings and evidence; delivery performance and client satisfaction; qualified opportunities, reusable assets and team development.

Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains. jobs.description: Overview: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. Responsibilities: Physical Design Engineer : EMIR / PDN Domain : ASIC / SoC Physical Design, EMIR THE ROLE: We are looking for an adaptive, self-motivated Senior Silicon Design Engineer with strong experience in Electromigration and IR Drop (EMIR) analysis to join our growing team. As a key contributor, you will be responsible for driving EMIR analysis, debug, and signoff closure for complex, high-performance SoC designs using industry-standard tools such as Ansys RedHawk-SC and Cadence Voltus. You will collaborate closely with Physical Design, Power, Package, and other cross-functional teams to identify power integrity risks, perform root-cause analysis, recommend design improvements, and drive issues to closure. You will also contribute to improving EMIR methodologies, automation, flow efficiency, and overall design quality to enable robust and reliable silicon. THE PERSON : You have a passion for silicon design, physical design, and solving complex EMIR challenges. You possess a strong understanding of power delivery networks and the interaction between floorplan, power grid, placement, routing, bumps, power distribution, and design activity. You are a team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills and are comfortable working with engineers across different teams, sites, and time zones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently debug complex EMIR issues, identify root causes, propose practical design solutions, and drive issues to closure. You are self-motivated, willing to learn, and continuously look for opportunities to improve methodologies, automation, debug efficiency, and overall design convergence. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Perform static and dynamic IR-drop and Electromigration analysis using industry-standard EMIR tools such as Ansys RedHawk-SC and Cadence Voltus for complex SoC designs. Develop, maintain, and validate EMIR flows and analysis setups across different stages of the physical design cycle. Perform power-grid validation and identify weak-grid regions, voltage-drop hotspots, current-density violations, and power connectivity issues. Validate EMIR database quality and input data integrity, and identify setup or data-related issues that could impact the accuracy and quality of EMIR analysis. Perform detailed root-cause analysis of EMIR violations and provide actionable recommendations to Physical Design and other related teams. Work closely with Physical Design teams to drive power-grid optimization, via enhancement, metal strengthening, floorplan updates, placement optimization, and ECO-based fixes. Analyze EMIR challenges associated with voltage islands, multiple power domains, power-domain boundaries, bump distribution, and power-grid connectivity. Identify critical issues early in the design cycle that may require floorplan, bump, or power-grid architecture changes. Analyze results across multiple design iterations to identify new violations, regressions, and unexpected changes, and drive them toward resolution. Work closely with design teams to determine whether identified EMIR issues can be addressed through ECO changes or require more significant power-grid/design modifications. Drive assigned blocks/subsystems toward EMIR signoff and design convergence, while meeting project quality and schedule requirements. Develop and improve automation for EMIR flow execution, data processing, analysis, debug, and reporting. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and provide technical guidance and support on EMIR related issues. Contribute to continuous improvement of EMIR methodologies, checks, best practices, and design closure processes. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: 7 +Years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC Physical Design with significant experience in EMIR analysis and signoff. Strong hands-on experience with Ansys RedHawk-SC and/or Cadence Voltus for Electromigration and IR-drop analysis. Experience with both tools is highly preferred. Strong understanding of Power Delivery Networks (PDN), static IR drop, dynamic IR drop, Electromigration, current density, and power-grid reliability. Experience with EMIR flow setup, database validation, debug, analysis, and signoff closure. Strong understanding of the impact of floorplan, placement, routing, power-grid design, vias, and bumps on EMIR. Experience in debugging EMIR violations and providing effective and practical design recommendations for issue resolution. Good understanding of multi-voltage designs, voltage islands, and power-domain interactions. Experience in power-grid robustness analysis and validation and identifying potential design weaknesses early in the implementation cycle. Familiarity with physical design inputs and data such as LEF/DEF, parasitics, power/activity data, technology files, power intent, and design databases. Good understanding of the overall ASIC Physical Design flow from floorplanning through implementation, ECO, and signoff. Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Tcl, Perl, and/or Shell for flow automation, data analysis, reporting, and productivity improvement. Experience working on advanced-node, high-performance, or large-scale SoC designs is preferred. Experience with hierarchical/block-to-top EMIR analysis methodologies is an added advantage.
