We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building Teradata’s vector store and retrieval infrastructure , powering RAG, multimodal AI, agentic workflows, and semantic search at enterprise scale. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, information retrieval, and distributed systems , and wants to work on core platform capabilities , not just application demos. You will: Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata’s vector store and retrieval stack. Define design patterns and best practices for RAG, semantic search, and agentic AI systems . Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions. Identify scalability, performance, and reliability risks and drive solutions proactively. Design agentic AI patterns, including tool calling, planning, memory, and orchestration. Design and implement core vector store capabilities , including indexing strategies, storage layouts, retrieval algorithms, and APIs. Build and maintain RAG evaluation frameworks , including relevance, faithfulness, accuracy, and cost metrics. Collaborate with product, research, and platform teams to translate customer use cases into scalable features. Benchmark Teradata’s vector store and RAG capabilities against industry alternatives (e.g., cloud and open-source solutions). Contribute to technical design reviews, architecture decisions, and long-term AI platform strategy. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers, and domain experts at Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions align with real-world business problems in regulated industries. Infrastructure and platform teams responsible for training, evaluation, and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of complex systems. Deep expertise in vector search, information retrieval, or semantic search systems . Proven experience designing and deploying production-grade RAG platforms. Strong understanding of: Embeddings and similarity search Data chunking and context optimization Dense vs sparse vs hybrid retrieval Semantic search and relevance ranking Proficiency in Python (and/or Java); experience with production-grade systems. Experience working with large-scale data and performance-sensitive systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with multimodal embeddings and retrieval. Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent). Experience implementing AI guardrails and evaluation frameworks. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience with distributed systems or analytics platforms. Open-source contributions or published work in AI, IR, or GenAI. #LI-NM1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.description: Partner Account Executive – North& East India Role Summary As a Partner Account Executive, you will own and grow strategic business relationships with Cisco’s Growth Partners across the North& East India region. You will serve as a trusted advisor to partner leadership, developing joint business strategies that strengthen partner capabilities, accelerate Cisco adoption, create new market opportunities, and drive sustainable year-over-year revenue growth. Working closely with Cisco Sales, Systems Engineering, Portfolio and Specialist teams, you will orchestrate partner ecosystems and execute differentiated go-to-market strategies that expand Cisco’s footprint and strengthen partner profitability. What You’ll Do Own and grow a portfolio of Growth Partners across North& East India, building trusted relationships across partner leadership, sales, technical and business teams. Develop and execute joint partner business plans aligned to Cisco’s strategic priorities, partner capabilities, customer needs and revenue objectives. Drive year-over-year partner revenue growth by identifying new opportunities, expanding Cisco solution adoption and increasing partner preference for Cisco. Develop partner capabilities and practices across key technology areas, enabling partners to build differentiated offerings and go-to-market motions. Identify market trends, customer needs and competitive insights to shape partner strategies and position Cisco effectively within the partner ecosystem. Create and execute joint go-to-market and demand-generation initiatives that generate pipeline and accelerate partner-led sales. Enable partners through Cisco programs, incentives, investments, training and resources to strengthen their sales and technical capabilities. Orchestrate Cisco Sales, Systems Engineering, Portfolio and Specialist teams to support partner readiness, solution development, co-sell opportunities and customer engagement. Advocate for partner priorities internally and ensure partner capabilities are incorporated into relevant account and territory strategies. Monitor partner performance through business reviews, pipeline, revenue and profitability metrics, identifying opportunities for optimization and growth. Lead regular business reviews and performance planning with partners, using data and market insights to drive continuous improvement. Build strong competitive awareness and help partners differentiate Cisco solutions within their respective markets. Who You’ll Work With You will work across a highly collaborative ecosystem including: Partner leadership and sales/technical teams Cisco Account Executives and Sales Leaders Systems Engineers and Solution Specialists Portfolio and Practice Sellers Marketing and Partner Enablement teams Regional and Business Entity leadership Who You Are You are a commercially driven partner/channel sales professional who understands how technology partners build businesses and how vendors can jointly create growth. You are comfortable operating with senior partner stakeholders, developing business strategies, influencing without authority and bringing together multiple teams to execute against shared goals. You combine strong relationship management with agrowth mindset, business acumen and the ability to turn partner capabilities into revenue opportunities. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 8+ years of relevant experience in Channel Sales, Partner Sales, Alliances or related IT sales roles. Strong understanding of indirect sales models and the India IT partner ecosystem. Demonstrated experience managing partner portfolios and driving revenue growth. Experience developing joint business plans and go-to-market strategies with technology partners. Proven ability to influence partner leadership and collaborate across internal and external teams. Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation and business-development skills. Willingness to travel across the assigned region as required. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Systems Integrators, Resellers, Distributors, Managed Service Providers or other technology partners. Experience across networking, cybersecurity, cloud, SaaS or related technology solutions. Knowledge of Cisco solutions, partner programs and incentive structures. Existing understanding of the North& East India partner ecosystem. Experience developing new partner practices, capabilities or GTM motions. Strong analytical skills with experience using business performance and pipeline data to drive decisions. Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business or a related field. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.description: About Xerox Holdings Corporation For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. Produce clear, current design artifacts: architecture diagrams, data models, integration specs, and decision records. DevOps and application lifecycle management Own and evolve our ALM strategy: environment design, solution layering, managed solutions, and branching. Drive operational readiness: monitoring, telemetry with Application Insights, alerting, and runbooks. Plan and lead adoption of Microsoft's release waves to maximize platform value and minimize regression risk. Partnership and communication Work alongside delivery teams in an agile environment to see designs through to adoption, not just hand-off. Summarize options, risks, and recommendations clearly for executive audiences. Required Qualifications 7+ years in software development or solution architecture, including 4+ years designing and building on Dynamics 365 or Power Platform. Deep hands-on development experience: C#/.NET plugins and custom APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, PCF controls, Power Automate, and the Dataverse Web API. Hands-on technical delivery experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service and/or Field Service. Proven experience building and supporting Power Pages (or Power Apps portals) sites. Practical DevOps experience: source control, CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform solutions, and environment and release management. Experience working in a heavily customized, integrated D365 environment. Ability to analyze business processes and turn requirements into sound technical designs. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to developers, business stakeholders, and executives. Comfort balancing multiple priorities and adapting as they change. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales and Project Operations. Field Service mobile configuration and offline design, or Resource Scheduling Optimization. Omnichannel for Customer Service, Copilot Studio, or other AI capabilities in Dynamics 365. Azure integration services: Function Apps, Service Bus, Logic Apps, API Management, and Key Vault. Data migration and integration using SSIS with KingswaySoft or Azure Data Factory. SQL Server, T-SQL, and stored procedures. Microsoft certifications such as Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600), Power Platform Developer (PL-400), Dynamics 365 Customer Service or Field Service Functional Consultant, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400). Knowledge, skills & abilities You take ownership and act before being asked. You solve problems creatively and stay pragmatic when trade-offs get hard. You collaborate easily across teams and levels, from developers to senior leaders. You stay organized and deliver in a fast-moving environment. You keep current with Microsoft's roadmap and bring new ideas to the team. Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent required.

jobs.description: Project Role : Network & Svcs Operations Representative Project Role Description : Configure, integrate and manage the life cycle of telecommunication network elements and associated configuration across Fulfillment and Assurance. Manage back office system data records. Support customer activations and configuration adjustments. Must have skills : SAP Manufacturing Integration & Intelligence (MII) Good to have skills : NA Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As an SAP MII Manufacturing Integration, you will hold design authority and delivery accountability for the process area, leading multiple workstreams through their Managers while remaining personally hands-on on the hardest design and configuration for Manufacturing Execution within the Manufacturing tower of the DRS SAP programme. The role exists to connect the shop floor to SAP, where integration must remain resilient while production continues and plant connectivity is not guaranteed. You carry delivery risk for the process area and are expected to enter a drifting workstream, establish an evidenced position and reset the plan. You remain hands-on: the most difficult design and configuration work is yours, as is the review gate before work leaves the process area. Quality, defect trend and release readiness sit with you, together with the AI standard and the technical development of the Managers you lead. Roles & Responsibilities: Scope & Decision Rights: Hold design authority for the process area and remain hands-on. The hardest design calls are taken by you personally, and you prove the pattern before the team builds to it. You approve decisions that carry downstream cost, hold the review gate on work leaving the process area, set the quality gates Managers deliver to, and own the delivery risk position reported to programme governance. MII Development: Build and maintain MII content: business logic services, query templates, message services, transactions and shop-floor dashboards. Plant Connectivity: Configure Plant Connectivity and tag-level integration with control systems over OPC UA or equivalent, including buffering behaviour when connectivity drops. ERP to Shop Floor Flow: Design and support the data exchange between ERP and the shop floor: production order download, confirmations, goods movements and status feedback, with reconciliation when messages fail. Shop-Floor Visibility: Build dashboards and KPI and OEE reporting that plant operations use in the plant, and keep them fast enough to be trusted during a shift. Integration & Dependencies: Work with Production Planning and Plant Operations for order and confirmation flow, with Inventory for goods movements, and with plant automation teams on the control-system side. Solution & Delivery Governance: Own solution design and delivery quality across the process area: set the design standards, approve decisions carrying downstream cost, and hold accountability for delivery risk, defect trend and release readiness across workstreams. Delivery Recovery Leadership: Lead recovery of stressed workstreams, including shop-floor integration dropping messages or confirmations failing to reach ERP during a running shift: establish an evidenced position, re-plan, reallocate, remove the structural cause and report a defensible trajectory to programme leadership. AI-Native Delivery Standards & Joule Governance: Define how AI is applied across the process area, including AI-assisted manufacturing integration design review, anomaly detection across plant data and reliability analysis govern the accelerator library, set validation and IP controls, and report productivity and quality outcomes. Set the standard for SAP Joule for Consultants use and the governance of its grounding content, and decide where a Joule agent is warranted against standard configuration, holding the specification and acceptance standard with the AI and AIDLC tower. Mentoring & Capability Building: Develop the Managers who lead the workstreams: run design reviews as teaching, pair on configuration they have not done before, and codify the resulting patterns so the capability outlives the individual. Set the technical standard across the process area and own succession for its scarce skills. Executive & Client Engagement: Represent the process area in client leadership and programme governance forums, defend design decisions, and negotiate scope and timeline against capacity. Professional & Technical Skills: Must-Have Skills SAP MII: Recognised design authority in the MII workbench: business logic services, query templates, message services and transaction development. Plant Connectivity & OPC: Extensive experience with SAP Plant Connectivity and OPC UA or DA tag integration with control systems. ERP Integration: Expert-level expertise in production order, confirmation and goods movement integration between ERP and shop-floor systems. Resilience & Buffering: Extensive experience designing message buffering, retry and reconciliation for an environment where connectivity is not guaranteed. Plant-Floor Working: Proven capability to work with plant operations and troubleshoot at the line as well as remotely. Hands-On Technical Depth: Current, hands-on command of the primary skill. This is a working design authority role, not an oversight role: the hardest configuration in the process area is expected to be done by the post-holder. Hands-On Currency: Hands-on configuration or design-level build work on the primary skill within the last 24 months. Advisory, pre-sales, governance or oversight-only experience during that period does not satisfy this requirement. Where recent experience is advisory, a technical validation forms part of selection. Technical Mentoring & Capability Building: Demonstrated development of Managers and senior engineers through design review, pairing and codified patterns, evidenced by capability the team retained rather than output the individual delivered. AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership: Demonstrated definition of AI standards across an SAP delivery team or tower, including validation controls, accelerator ownership and measured productivity outcomes. SAP Joule for Consultants & Agent Governance: Working use of SAP Joule for Consultants and the capability to set how a team uses it, covering grounding content curation and client-confidentiality controls, together with the judgement to determine where a Joule agent is warranted against standard configuration. Equivalent experience setting AI tooling standards for a delivery team is accepted in place of prior Joule exposure, with working proficiency expected within 90 days of joining. Evidence of AI Adoption: Demonstrable record of raising delivery productivity through AI or equivalent means: AI assistant adoption, delivery accelerators, reference architectures or codified playbooks built for reuse across teams, with measurable effect on throughput or quality. Multi-Workstream Delivery & Recovery: Demonstrated leadership across multiple SAP workstreams, including at least one engagement behind plan or under quality pressure, with personal accountability for the recovery. Executive Stakeholder Management: Credible in client leadership forums, with demonstrated capability to make and defend design and delivery decisions under incomplete information and commercial pressure. Good to Have Skills SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC) and the MII migration path SAP ME and manufacturing execution scenarios OEE management and downtime analytics Edge computing, IIoT platforms and OPC UA security Additional Information: A 15-year full-time education is required, as stated in the approved demand record. Minimum 15 years of experience on the primary skill, as specified in the approved demand record. Hands-on configuration or design-level build work on the primary skill within the last 24 months. Solution and delivery leadership across multiple full lifecycle SAP programmes, including at least one recovery or high-pressure delivery situation. Evidenced record of setting AI-enabled or equivalent delivery productivity standards for a team or tower. 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Industries - BFSI
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive, Industries - BFSI to pioneer Anthropic's enterprise AI adoption across India's banking, financial services, and insurance sector. You will build our presence from the ground up, securing transformative deals with leading banks, NBFCs, insurers, and fintechs, and establishing Anthropic as their trusted AI partner for digital transformation. You will navigate the complex, regulated environment of Indian financial institutions and position Claude as the AI solution that drives both efficiency and innovation while maintaining the highest standards of safety and reliability. As one of our first industry specialists in India, you will shape our BFSI go-to-market strategy and build the playbook for how Anthropic serves financial institutions, working closely with global teams while adapting our approach to local market dynamics. This position is based in Bangalore, Mumbai, or NCR, with travel across India. Key responsibilities Establish Anthropic's enterprise presence across India's BFSI sector, including public and private sector banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, and fintechs Develop BFSI-specific strategies that account for RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data localization needs, and sector compliance standards Build relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs, Chief Risk and Compliance Officers, digital transformation leaders, and innovation heads at India's top financial institutions Create the India BFSI playbook for enterprise AI adoption, documenting successful approaches that can scale across the region Own end-to-end sales cycles for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, often involving board-level decisions Drive strategic expansion within lighthouse accounts that can serve as references for the entire BFSI industry Navigate procurement processes unique to Indian financial institutions, including vendor risk assessments, rate contracts, empanelment procedures, and multi-year agreements Collaborate with system integrators and consulting partners who often influence technology decisions at banks and insurers Co-innovate with customers to develop BFSI use cases, from vernacular customer service and fraud detection to credit underwriting and automated compliance reporting Understand sector-specific challenges such as financial inclusion, legacy core banking modernization, and data security in regulated environments Position AI strategically within the context of Digital India initiatives and financial sector modernization programs Ensure successful deployments that can scale from proof-of-concept to enterprise-wide implementation Partner with global product teams to prioritize features critical for Indian financial institutions, such as multi-language support, data residency, auditability, and integration with local systems Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to navigate India's evolving AI and data protection regulations Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, pricing expectations, and emerging BFSI use cases unique to India Build internal alignment between Anthropic's global strategy and India's market requirements Minimum qualifications 15+ years of enterprise sales experience in the Indian market, with a proven track record of closing large, complex deals, ideally across BFSI sector Deep understanding of how Indian financial institutions operate, including decision-making processes, budget cycles, and stakeholder dynamics Experience selling transformational technology (Cloud, AI/ML, Digital Transformation platforms) to Indian enterprises Established relationships with senior executives across banks, NBFCs, insurers, or fintechs Understanding of the Indian regulatory landscape, including RBI, NSE, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data protection laws, and sector-specific compliance Consultative selling expertise, with the ability to position AI as a strategic business driver rather than just a technology solution Complex deal structuring experience, including multi-year contracts, phased deployments, and outcome-based pricing Technical acumen to engage credibly with CTOs, architects, and data science teams Cross-cultural communication skills to work effectively with both Indian stakeholders and global teams Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to build a market from scratch with limited local resources initially Patient yet persistent approach to long enterprise sales cycles, while maintaining momentum Preferred qualifications Experience selling directly into large Indian banks, insurers, or financial conglomerates Relationships with Indian system integrators such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL, particularly their BFSI practices Familiarity with Indian business groups and conglomerates, and how decisions flow within these complex organizations Track record of first-in-market roles or launching new products in India Domain expertise in areas critical to Indian financial services, such as UPI payments, core banking systems, KYC/AML compliance, Aadhaar integration, or insurance underwriting Knowledge of government initiatives such as Digital India and their impact on financial sector technology adoption Experience navigating public sector bank and PSU sales processes is a plus Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software. Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership. Application Software Management Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies. Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting. Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM. Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health. Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements. Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation. Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours. jobs.title: AI ENGINEER - ODIN - Global Markets IT
jobs.description: Job Title: AI Engineer Department: ISPL Data Office, CIB IT Transversal About Business Line/Function Global Markets The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas helps its corporate and institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT work load, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. Position Purpose The AI Engineer will design, build and deploy production-grade data and AI solutions. The role combines strong Python and data engineering fundamentals (ETL, relational databases, REST APIs) with hands-on development of AI capabilities such as LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic workflows. The position requires working in a virtual team and international environment and is multidisciplinary in nature. It involves coordination with other locations and divisions of BNP Paribas as necessary. The candidate should have strong engineering discipline, a problem-solving mindset and the ability to turn business requirements into reliable, secure and scalable solutions. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain scalable Python applications and data pipelines using Pandas for data extraction, transformation and loading (ETL). Build and expose secure, well-documented REST APIs using FastAPI, applying data validation (e.g. Pydantic) and API best practices. Write efficient SQL and work with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server, including data modelling, query optimization and performance tuning. Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment across development, test and production environments. Develop Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions – LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI. Integrate Large Language Models through provider APIs (e.g. OpenAI / Azure OpenAI) and open-source models (e.g. Hugging Face), applying prompt engineering, structured outputs and function / tool calling. Build natural-language interfaces to data (e.g. Text-to-SQL agents) that allow business users to query databases in plain English. Automate business workflows by combining AI capabilities with APIs, scheduling / workflow tools (e.g. n8n) and messaging integrations. Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data sources and tools, including vector databases and Model Context Protocol (MCP) based tool integrations. Implement LLM observability, tracing and evaluation (e.g. Langfuse) to monitor quality, cost, latency and reliability of AI applications. Develop, train and evaluate Machine Learning models where appropriate, using libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and NumPy. Follow sound engineering practices: version control with Git, code reviews, unit / integration testing and clear technical documentation. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions / Jenkins) and support deployment of AI services on on-premise or cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure). Translate business requirements into technical designs and work closely with business users, data teams and other stakeholders throughout implementation and delivery. Contributing Responsibilities Contribute to the design of reusable components, frameworks and best practices for data engineering and AI development within the team. Ensure solutions comply with the Group’s standards on data security, privacy, Responsible AI, risk and compliance. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and propose AI-driven solutions. Participate in knowledge sharing, mentoring and cross-training to build AI capabilities within the team. Stay up to date with the evolving AI / LLM ecosystem and assess new tools and techniques for adoption. Technical & Behavioral Competencies Strong programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in data manipulation and analysis using Pandas. Solid working knowledge of SQL and relational databases – Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server. Experience designing and building REST APIs, preferably with FastAPI. Good understanding of ETL concepts, data pipelines, data quality and data integration. Practical experience with Docker and Git based development workflows. Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI), Hugging Face models, prompt engineering, LLM application frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI), RAG pipelines, vector databases and LLM observability tools (e.g. Langfuse) is a strong plus. Familiarity with ClickHouse, front-end frameworks (React / Angular), Machine Learning libraries (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy), CI/CD and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure) is an added advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail; ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Specific Qualifications Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Python development / data engineering, with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience. Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI / LLM based applications (Generative AI, RAG, Agentic AI) will be preferred. Prior experience in the Banking / Financial Services domain is desirable. Technical Skills Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities) Must Have Python Pandas Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server REST API FastAPI Docker Git ETL Concepts Good to Have ClickHouse React / Angular Agentic AI – LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain LLM APIs – OpenAI / Azure OpenAI; Prompt Engineering Hugging Face (open-source LLMs, embeddings) Text-to-SQL / Natural-language data querying agents LLM Observability – Langfuse Model Context Protocol (MCP) RAG Pipelines and Vector Databases Machine Learning – Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy Pydantic Workflow Automation – n8n CI/CD – GitHub Actions / Jenkins Cloud Platforms – AWS / GCP / Azure Behavioral Skills Communication skills – oral & written Analytical Ability Problem Solving / Critical Thinking Team Player / Ability to collaborate Ability to deliver / Results driven Adaptability and continuous learning Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT or related field) Location: Mumbai About BNP Paribas Group BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
jobs.description: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 11 Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems) Role Summary As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization’s next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously. Responsibilities Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments. State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks. Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability. Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i.e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models. Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure. Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents. Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance. Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability. Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production. Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making. Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment. Technical Leadership & Strategy Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap. Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies. Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e.g., new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap. Qualifications Required Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning. GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production. Database & Lakehouse Mastery: Experience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake). Cloud & Infrastructure: Expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications. LLM Ecosystem: Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management. Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability). Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. Preferred Advanced Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field. NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e.g., text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures. Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling. Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph, LiteLLM, Langfuse, AWS AgentCore, or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows. Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e.g., FinTech, Energy, Logistics). Why This Role Matters You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization’s "central nervous system." As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design—capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks—will fundamentally change how we operate, moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry. jobs.title: IAM Enterprise Architect (India, Malaysia)
jobs.description: Job Summary This role could be based in India or Malaysia. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. • Standard Chartered’s diverse footprint across 63 of the fastest growing markets in Asia, Africa and the Middle East creates unique opportunities for passionate, motivated, and highly skilled people who want to make a difference. We are changing the way people think about banking. We are changing the way we do business – becoming the digital bank with a human touch. This is your opportunity to be part of a growth story in an industry that is reimagining how customers are getting better, faster experiences and convenience through digital technology. • Our Information & Cyber Security (ICS) team sits within the Transformation, Technology & Operations (TTO) function and is responsible for all mission-critical and enterprise-wide areas of cybersecurity, including identity and access management, global threat intelligence, data protection, malware protection, and application and infrastructure security. These are challenges that impact our clients globally. • Our ICS Portfolio team develops the platforms, drives the processes and builds partnerships on behalf of ICS. We thrive on providing solutions to complex issues, devoting time and energy to designing and delivering new and innovative solutions, and all in an environment that demands being risk-aware, not risk-averse. ICS chooses progress over perfection and aims to always participate with a constructive purpose. The team makes an impact wherever they are based, be it in our offices around the world, our Global Business Solution centres in China, India, Malaysia and Poland, or even from our home. • If tackling complex challenges excites you, then join our ICS Identity & Access Management team where you will get to collaborate and work on solutions across business and functions to drive the transformation and deliver better experiences to our customers. We constantly strive to reduce time-to-market and streamline our processes. We follow agile methodology and work to embed an improvement habit across the bank. • Now you have an opportunity to make a meaningful impact with a diverse and passionate team of creators, innovators, and achievers. With us, you’ll learn, be inspired, and make an impact every day. The success of our work hinges on how we use the unique diversity of our people to realise the effects we seek to achieve: Always on. Always safe. Always Simple. Key Responsibilities • We are seeking an accomplished and highly delivery driven and strategic thinking IAM Enterprise Architect with experience in securing AI identities to join our Threats, Architecture and Controls within the Identity & Access Management organization. • The IAM Enterprise Architect will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, architectural patterns, and control frameworks for managing identities in an AI-drive ecosystem. This includes securing the “Human-to-AI” interface, managing the identities of autonomous AI agents, and ensuring theat AI model training and inference processes adhere to Zero Trust Principles. • The IAM Enterprise Architect will ensure the tactical and strategic plans and solutions are continuously strengthen to respond to the increasing threats and changing sophistication in attack tactics while keeping up with the growth and changes of business. • The IAM Enterprise Architect will bridge the gap between business priorities, cybersecurity policies, and technical delivery teams to deliver next-generation cyber defences against identity threats to protect our Customers. • The successful candidate will provide strong technical security direction for identity access controls and capabilities for securing identities in Enterprise AI Solution, and lead and partner with engineers, architects, compliance teams, and business stakeholders to deliver against the capabilities roadmap, enhance user experience, and align with regulatory and cybersecurity standards. The role demands a strong awareness of the cyber threat landscape and understanding of cyber threat actors and their attack tactics, identity access controls, and AI technologies and capabilities. This individual will drive delivery health, ensure achievement of OKRs, and shape the future of IAM solutions, reporting directly to the Head of IAM Threats Architecture and Controls. Strategy • Design and Develop granular access control capabilities for Large Language Models, Vector Databases, Agentic Agents, and AI training environments, • Architect and implement specialised solutions such as Just-in-Time access, Attribute based Access Control for AI agents, automated secret rotation, and identity-aware gateways for AI workloads. • Define how identity is managed throughout AI lifecycle, from data ingestion, model deployment, agent deployment to human-to-agent/model use case. • Align AI-specific identity threats with framework like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI Risk Management frameworks. • Develop and define a multi-year strategy for identity access controls and capabilities to secure AI, products vision roadmap and KPIs that aligned with the Business Goals • Act as the expert in identity threats in AI and take ownership of the securing AI identity controls and solutions. • Act as a liaison between business and technical teams to ensure business and technical objectives and requirements are well communicated and understood. • Stay relevant on matters such as cyber threat landscape, emerging threats, active threat campaigns and emerging identity access control technologies. • Create and update related IAM policies, standards, controls and solutions documents. • Partner with the Bank Security Architects and Risk Teams to ensure alignment with Enterprise Security approach and Regulatory standards. • Partner with the Bank Analytics and Strategy teams to translate insights into execution roadmaps. • Enable Compliance & Audit Readiness Central audit trail for identity access controls and identity threats detection response controls to aligned with internal and regulatory requirements. • Continuously identify opportunities for cost optimization, increase efficiency and process simplification. Business • Facilitate integration of business priorities and strategic objectives into delivery roadmaps. • Translate technical requirements into business value statements for leadership stakeholders. • Ensure that processes are optimized for transparency, accountability, user experience and continuous improvement. • Partner with business owners to validate outcomes and benefits realization. • Work closely with ICS and Stakeholders to ensure that requirements are in line with the bank’s strategy • Responsible to evolve the craft towards improving automation, simplification and innovative use of latest market trends • Engage with third-party vendors as appropriate for the project Processes • Map, analyse, and optimize end-to-end business processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and user experience. • Identify automation and digital enablement opportunities (e.g., workflow, integration, self-service). • Partner with process owners, operations, and compliance teams to ensure business alignment. • Successful grooming of delivery backlog facilitating planning ceremonies with clear, aligned outcomes. • Stakeholder alignment score (measured via feedback from Product Owners & leadership). People & Talent • Act as the primary liaison between business, cybersecurity, and platform teams. • Communicate product performance, risks, and roadmap to executive stakeholders and governance forums. • Drive stakeholder alignment on adoption plans, investment needs, and decommissioning of legacy platforms. • Create an environment of trust, open communication, and cross-functional alignment across business, technology, and control functions. • Collaborate closely with business units, Scrum Masters, and development teams to ensure successful sprint outcomes. • Provide technical security direction for Identity Access Management for AI to a team of developers and engineers, in partnership with architects Risk Management • Establish and maintain a strong governance framework, covering delivery tracking, escalation management, and executive reporting. • Proactively identify and manage program-level risks, dependencies, and interlocks. • Ensure adherence to ICS governance standards and contribute to shaping internal audit and risk processes. • Ensures the project follows the standards with respect to risk management as applicable to their domain. • Adheres to common practices to mitigate risk in their respective domain. Governance • Embed a strong compliance and regulatory-first mindset into program delivery for IAM initiatives. • Ensure that program decisions and outcomes align with legal, regulatory, and business conduct requirements. • Act as a role model for integrity, ethics, and responsible delivery practices. • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies (e.g., SCB Governance Standards, ESDLC etc.). Regulatory & Business Conduct • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct. • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Key stakeholders See the consolidated list of responsibilities below • Peers in IAM Threats Architecture and Controls, Hive Tech Leads, PMs and SMs ICS wide, Engineering Leads & Enterprise Security Architecture • ICS IAM Leadership Team, ICS CISOs, ICS Delivery Team partners, CPOs • Technology & Architecture & CIOs • Global Head, ICS Identity & Access Management • Global Head, Cyber Security Technology • Global Head, Cyber Security Operations • Global Technology Service Heads (Production Support, Infrastructure, Testing, SRE, Architecture) Other Responsibilities Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in ICS - Identity & Access Management domain. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats). The ideal candidate will embody the following attributes: • Strategic Thinker - connects execution with long-term organizational goals. • Independent Driver - able to lead without heavy oversight. • Regulatory Mindset - embeds compliance and governance discipline in delivery. • Trusted Partner - strong communicator with ability to engage stakeholders up to CIO level. • Delivery-Oriented - relentless focus on achieving OKRs and outcomes. • Collaborative Leader - fosters alignment, removes silos, and builds trust across teams. Skills and Experience • Agile Methodologies • Stakeholder Engagement/Management • Project and Programme Management • Agile Project Management • IT Standards, Procedures & Policies • Change Control • Information Technology (IT) Security Policies • Software Product Business Knowledge • MS Office Suite Skills including SharePoint and Confluence Qualifications • 15+ years of total experience as IT professional with at least 5 years in working on AI solutions and 5 years in designing and implementing Identity Access Management Solutions. • In-depth knowledge of identity protocols such as Oauth2, OIDC, SAML, specifically how they are extended to support non-human identity such as Agent Identity. • In-depth knowledge of management of Agentic Identity such as how to assign, verify, and revoke permissions for autonomous agents. • Deep expertise in Zero Trust Architecture and hands on experience in implementing these for AI solutions. • Implementation experience in designs using Attribute-Based Access Control and Policy as Code. • Familiar with the MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND Framework and hands on experience in using these framework to design and implement IAM and AI solutions. • Familiar with enterprise directories and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Entra and related IAM technologies • Familiar with emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligences, Agentic AI and Digital Assets from identity threats perspective • Analytical, delivery-oriented mindset with the ability to balance strategy and execution. • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with a focus on influencing without authority. • Skilled at identifying risks, driving remediation, and ensuring compliance with audit/regulatory expectations. • Proficient in creating process and solution design documents • Proficient in stakeholder management and good communication skills. Able to bridge business and technical teams. Able to communicate with senior executives while maintaining alignment with ground-level teams. • Experience working in banking, finance, or other regulated environments. Education • Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Engineering, Banking, Business, or a related field • Relevant Professional Certification – CISSP Certified NIST AI RMF Architect, AAISM, CIAM • Relevant Threat Detection Response and IAM Technologies trainings such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Cortex, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, EntraID, Okta, SailPoint About Standard Chartered We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart. What We Offer Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies. In line with our Fair Pay Charter , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing. Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations. Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum. Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits. A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning. Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description: Working at Atlassian India Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear. Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere. Your future team: KubePlat Team The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products. What we own: Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments. Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts. Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices. Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on. Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads. Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day. AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features. We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale. As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch. What you'll do Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters. Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources. Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP). Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation. Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference. Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers. 10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems. Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs. Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar. Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability. A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills. Nice to have Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments. Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore). Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

You'll also have the chance to work closely with our talented engineers and interact with our valued business partners, fostering an inclusive and respectful atmosphere. Our team is dedicated to securing the services, tools, platforms, and data that are important for powering one of the top supply chains in the world. We believe that adopting diversity and fostering an inclusive environment are key to driving innovation and achieving success. Our team is committed to ensuring that everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique ideas and experiences. Your self-motivation and resourcefulness enable you to address complex security challenges and drive innovative solutions. You thrive in collaborative settings, working effectively with stakeholders to deliver growth and value across projects. Your adaptability allows you to navigate ambiguity with ease, making you an asset in dynamic and evolving situations. You have a demonstrated ability to influence and inspire both within your team and across the organisation, contributing to strategic initiatives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. AI red-team testing, prompt stress testing, secure MCP/A2A agent validation and defining Policy Based Access Controls. Automate security: Integrate security tools and checks into the CI/CD pipeline and AI Tools to automate the build, test, and deployment process. Working closely with the Scrum master, Product owner, and global delivery teams to drive and contribute to project releases and sprint work. Fix Security vulnerabilities and keep the application secure. Mentoring and providing technical support to junior colleagues. Design, develop, and optimise in-app and role-based AI Agents with secure, scalable semantic layers, multi-agent protocols, and agent training features. Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate agents with external tools and services, giving to a robust integration framework. Minimum requirements: 5+ years of experience as a SOC Analyst, Detection Engineer, Security Engineer, or Threat Intelligence Analyst or in an adjacent IT field. Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and experience in implementing AI techniques & MCP tools in practical applications, as well as proficiency in security. Proficiency in DevSecOps principles, application security, and application security testing. Experienced in the MEAN stack, API security, and application integration. Good understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework. Collaborate across teams : Work with developers and operations teams to develop a culture of shared security responsibility. Incident response: Supervise for security threats, respond to and mitigate security incidents, and perform post-mortem/root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences. Implement security policies: Develop and carry out security policies and procedures and ensure compliance with regulations. Experience in developing microservices using any of the following technologies: Angular, GoLang, Python, Node JS, JAVA, Java/Typescript and Restful Services. Good understanding of Agile and DevSecOps practices and toolsets. Proficiency with CI/CD tools, cloud security services, and IaC tools. Knowledge of secure coding practices, scripting, and automation is also vital. Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL and Extensive hands-on experience with relational, in-memory and NoSQL databases, including Oracle, Snowflake and Mongo. Positive and self-starter demeanor, with a strong communication and time management abilities. Works independently but seeks guidance from leaders when needed and resolves the best approach to accomplish work. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. Preferred Requirements: Professional understanding of HTTP data interchange and operations, TCP ports, and anomalous action logging. Working knowledge of HTTP intercept/forwarding, proxies and mutating/poisoning data payloads. Experience with Pentesting and tooling like Caido and Burp Suite. Familiarity with cloud services such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, and Azure. Experience with REACT, Angular, Node, JAVA, Java/TypeScript, RPA technologies, Oracle, Mongo, and Snowflake. Experience with test automation strategies and tools, such as UiPath, Playwright or Fluent. Advanced prompt engineering skills. Over 5 years of experience with full-stack development, design, and technically leading application development. Certifications in Java, DB, Cloud, AWS and AI/ML are highly valued. #WeAreCisco where every individual brings their unique skills and perspectives together to pursue our purpose of powering an inclusive future for all. Job Summary AI Principle Architect Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. Were looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, youll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. Youll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. Youll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, youll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. Youll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If youve solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, wed love to hear from you. Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard s data ethics and regulatory standards. Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. All About You Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and youve solved them before. If youve started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you havent used every tool listed here. Lead AI Ops Engineer AI Ops Overview: Mastercards Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really finished. They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live - Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors - Evaluate whether the agent s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting - Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents - Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment - Embed governance within the agent s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact All About You: - Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices - Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns - Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing - Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus - Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent s post launch health -
