jobs.description: Overview Search is how people find their work. Every day, people in organizations of every size rely on it to locate the document they edited last week, the email that captured a decision, the colleague who knows the answer, or the meeting where it was all discussed. When search works, it disappears into the flow of work; when it does not, it costs time, focus and confidence. In Microsoft 365 Copilot, we are reimagining search with AI. Copilot Search understands what you mean, brings together email, files, chats, meetings and people, and composes a grounded answer with sources you can trust, right alongside the results you need to go deeper. We are looking for a Software Engineer II excited to build this experience at global scale. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Design, build and ship Copilot Search features end to end in React and TypeScript, from design review and implementation through experimentation and worldwide rollout. Build performant, accessible and localized user interfaces that work consistently across web, desktop and mobile hosts, as well as SharePoint and OneDrive. Drive web performance through server-side rendering, hydration and rendering optimization, early data fetching, service workers and bundle-size reduction, with a focus on end-to-end latency and time to first answer. Integrate AI-generated answers into the search experience, including streaming responses, citations and source attribution, and graceful handling of partial or failed responses. Instrument features with telemetry, define success metrics, and run A/B experiments and staged rollouts to make data-driven product decisions. Own the reliability of the features you build, including monitoring, alerting, automated health checks and diagnosis of client issues such as authentication and host-loading failures. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, mitigating production incidents quickly and driving root-cause fixes so they do not recur. Partner closely with product managers, designers and backend search and relevance engineers to turn ambiguous ideas into polished, shippable experiences. Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and contributions to shared components and engineering practices. Use AI-assisted development tools and LLM-based techniques, such as automated analysis of user feedback and quality evaluation, to move faster and improve product quality. Qualifications Required/Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. OR equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications: Solid experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript. Solid web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, browser rendering, web performance and server-side rendering. Experience building and operating large-scale web applications used by a broad customer base. Experience with telemetry, A/B experimentation and data-driven decision making. Working knowledge of accessibility standards and building inclusive user interfaces. Experience building LLM or AI-powered product features, such as streaming experiences. Exposure to mobile or cross-platform hosts, such as web experiences embedded in apps. Experience with live-site operations, monitoring and on-call responsibilities. Familiarity with search or information retrieval concepts is a plus. Solid problem-solving and communication skills, and comfort collaborating across time zones. #CAPIDC This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Solid understanding of CPU and GPU infrastructure design, performance optimization, and benchmarking methodologies. Experience with high-performance storage solutions, parallel file systems, and high-speed networking technologies, including InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics. jobs.description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. LET’S GO! ㅤ Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad Meet our Team Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention. Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks. We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions. About the Role As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. Roles & Responsibilities: ML System Design & Ownership Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). Modeling & Experimentation Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). MLOps & Infrastructure Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks. Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency. Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds. Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design. Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards. Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs. Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Flagship Projects You’ll Work On Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching. Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms. ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions. Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion. What You’ll Bring Required 5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.). Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records). Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery. Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda). Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization. Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders. Preferred: Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context. Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation. Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex. Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications. jobs.title: Director
jobs.description: About Rubrik Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection, and management in the emerging multi-cloud world. We are the leader in cloud data management, delivering a single platform to manage and protect data in the cloud, at the edge, and on-premises. Enterprises choose Rubrik to simplify backup and recovery, accelerate cloud adoption, enable automation at scale, and secure against cyber threats. We’ve been recognized as a Forbes Cloud 100 Company two years in a row and as a LinkedIn Top 10 startup. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Job Introduction Corporate IT has traditionally been measured by how well it works a queue: tickets raised, tickets closed, SLAs met. That era is ending. Automating a ticket only makes a broken model faster. We want to remove the ticket. We are hiring a Director of Corporate IT to lead Employee Experience globally at Rubrik and rebuild it with AI at the center. The goal is ticketless service: from hire to retirement, an employee’s access, devices, tools, and answers arrive before they have to ask. Our north star is “My Digital Twin”, an agentic layer carrying an employee’s full context alongside the organization’s memory: role, team, entitlements, assets, policy, and history. A system with that context does not need a form. It provisions, anticipates, explains, and repairs. This is a multi-year journey, starting from a real environment that thousands of employees depend on daily. You will own both halves: run the global service organization at a high standard today, and dismantle the parts of it that AI should replace tomorrow. Neither can slip. The team you will lead spans the US, India, and other regions, and the employees you serve are spread across every Rubrik site. The role is based onsite in Bangalore and forms part of the onsite management team there, while the mandate, the standards you set, and the roadmap you own are global. The environment A globally distributed estate: Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, virtual desktops, conference rooms across sites in multiple regions, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS and open source applications. Collaboration and identity tools: Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, etc. Endpoint and MDM: VMware Workspace ONE, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, etc. VDI and remote desktop environments AV and conferencing: Google Meet, Zoom, room systems, digital signage, event production ITSM: Atlassian (Jira Cloud, Confluence, Opsgenie, Jira Service Management) Public cloud provider environments: GCP, Azure, AWS, etc. Enterprise AI: Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Glean, and other LLM and agent platforms and others What you will be doing Run the business: operational excellence today Own the global end-user service portfolio: Tech Lounge, ticketing, email and Slack support channels, escalations, and reporting, delivered consistently across regions and time zones. Own endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, the VDI estate, and AV and conferencing technology including room reliability and all-hands production. Own administration, governance, and adoption of enterprise AI tooling for employees. Hire, develop, and coach a globally distributed team of support staff and systems engineers across the US, India, and other locations, and grow site and functional leaders under you. Set one global service standard while respecting local needs: follow-the-sun coverage, consistent tooling and policy, shared knowledge, and a single escalation model across sites. Run IT service management to established practice (for example ITIL), own office-wide communications for incidents, outages, and changes, and keep a continual improvement focus across every technology area. Own the procurement forecast and vendor relationships for corporate and end-user IT globally, including India, partner with Information Security on identity, endpoint, and access, and carry IT-managed systems through SOC 2, SOX, and PCI audits. Represent operations in cross-functional programs under the Global IT Strategy & Operations pillar, spanning Global Service Desk, IT Supply Chain, AVOps, and InfraOps. Change the business: build toward ticketless Own the global ticketless roadmap: a multi-year sequence with milestones that can be measured and defended, and a rollout sequence across regions rather than a pilot that never leaves one site. Re-architect hire-to-retire as event-driven rather than request-driven, so joiner, mover, and leaver events trigger provisioning, entitlements, device readiness, and access removal with no human in the loop. Build the organizational memory that “My Digital Twin” depends on: a trustworthy graph of people, roles, entitlements, assets, policies, and history, with data quality good enough for autonomous action. Deploy AI agents against the biggest sources of employee friction and redesign the service catalog around intent instead of forms, holding agents to resolution rather than deflection. Set the guardrails for autonomous IT: identity-aware authorization for agents, least privilege, human approval where it genuinely matters, and audit trails. Move the measurement model from SLAs to experience outcomes, and redeploy your team as automation lands into automation engineering, knowledge ownership, and experience design. What we are looking for Leadership and operating track record Experience leading corporate IT, end-user services, or workplace technology at global scale, including managing managers and senior technical staff in more than one region. A track record of running a demanding environment well while changing it. We will ask for specifics on both. Fluency with AI and automation applied to operations: agents, workflow orchestration, integration across identity and ITSM systems, retrieval over internal knowledge. You need to know what is achievable, what is hype, and where the failure modes are. Hands-on depth in endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, MDM platforms, VDI, and AV and conferencing across multiple sites. Depth in identity and access (Okta or equivalent), SaaS administration, and public cloud environments. Practical experience putting enterprise AI tools in employees’ hands at scale, beyond pilots. Vendor management and procurement, plus IT technical program management with globally distributed teams, and the working habits that make distributed leadership effective across time zones. Executive presence and influence in a matrix organization, with the ability to develop senior leaders and build a culture of integrity, service excellence, accountability, and best practice sharing across sites. Security and compliance are treated as design constraints rather than obstacles, with exposure to SOC 2, SOX, or PCI cycles . AI-native depth, in a CorpIT context Demonstrated hands-on fluency with current generative AI tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where they don’t. Experience with AI-powered digital employee experience management platforms and endpoint telemetry, used to fix problems before employees report them. Experience deploying AI assistants or agents inside a corporate stack of identity, MDM, ITSM, and collaboration tools, including where human-in-the-loop approval belongs. Experience automating the employee lifecycle end to end, where joiner, mover, and leaver events drove provisioning and access through agentic tooling working from organizational memory rather than from a form. Experience running a service as a product measured on employee outcomes rather than ticket counts, with knowledge treated as a maintained asset. How we will know it is working A rising share of employee needs met with a north-star goal of no ticket ever filed. New hires are productive on day one, consistently and without expediting. Role changes and departures reflected in access automatically, within minutes. Autonomous resolution measured on quality and employee satisfaction, not closure. Support capacity per employee improves while experience scores rise, with clean audits throughout. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. jobs.title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer – Storage / Backup
jobs.description: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Storage/Backup builds and runs Storage and Backup Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. Key Responsibilities Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. Education & Professional Qualifications Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). Area of Specialisation Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. Strong experience as a Storage/Backup Engineer and/or Architect Deep understanding of Storage systems, data protection software and cloud native storage services undefined Understanding of modern storage and backup technologies (Caching Services, Object Storage, distributed storage, SDS, Continuous Data Protection, Storage-as-a-service, Backup-as-a-service) undefined Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. Desirable: Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. undefined Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Storage and Backup Technologies (SAN, Netapp OnTap, Avamar) undefined Knowledge of cloud cost methodology. Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices Skills/Background Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. Skills API Management, Automation Technology, Backup Servers, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Object Storage, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Storage Services, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Inclusion at GSK: As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs. Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. This role involves owning program strategy, roadmap, execution, dependencies, risks, and customer alignment. The TPM will partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to deliver reliable, scalable infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with hands-on infrastructure knowledge. This enables them to understand technical trade-offs, drive decisions, remove execution blockers, and translate complex engineering work into clear business and leadership outcomes. Drive multi-functional execution across Storage, Backup, Restore, and Platform teams, handling dependencies and interfaces. Provide technical program leadership, understanding architecture and trade-offs, facilitating decisions, challenging assumptions, and removing execution blockers. Handle risks and customer concerns, proactively identifying issues, driving mitigation, and ensuring timely resolution. Drive partner alignment, translating complex technical progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes for engineering and senior leadership.
